Under the guise of protecting a forest that doesn't belong to them, the Alliance seeks to deny the Horde one of our largest sources for lumber.$B$BDo not let this happen, $n!  Come back to me with proof of serving the Horde in a worthy manner!
8430.objectivesText: Bring 3 Warsong Gulch Marks of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.
8430.title: Battle of Warsong Gulch

8439.description: Our conflict with the Alliance has escalated to a true war.  No longer are false pretenses to enter into battle used or expected by either side at this point.$B$BThe battle for the Arathi Basin is one of resources, plain and simple.  Either the Alliance gets the resources and uses them against us or we get them and use them to keep our war efforts going.  Help the Defilers maintain the flow of resources we need, $n!
8439.objectivesText: Bring 3 Arathi Basin Mark of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.
8439.title: Conquering Arathi Basin

8446.description: Corruption seeps from this object.$B$BThere may be a link between this object and the dragons coming forth from the Dream. You must find someone that can decipher the meaning of this item. Perhaps the druids of the Moonglade or Cenarion Hold could assist you further.
8446.objectivesText: Find someone capable of deciphering the meaning behind the Nightmare Engulfed Object.$B$BPerhaps a druid of great power could assist you.
8446.title: Shrouded in Nightmare

8461.description: There is a camp of Deadwood furbolgs directly to our southwest.  Corruption permeates the camp, and I wish to put an end to it before they become a problem.$B$BThe Deadwood tribe is evil, but it is the effects of the fel that pollutes their minds.  Their hostility is not truly an innate quality, yet they cannot be helped.  It saddens me that we must fight our own brethren.$B$BPlease, $n - I ask you to do what must be done.  Simply spare me the details; such troublesome images upset me far too much.
8461.objectivesText: Nafien would like you to kill 6 Deadwood Den Watchers, 6 Deadwood Avengers, and 6 Deadwood Shamans.  Return to him in northern Felwood near the entrance to Timbermaw Hold.
8461.title: Deadwood of the North

8462.description: Perhaps you are capable of handling a larger threat that we Timbermaw face.  You certainly have shown yourself capable here...$B$BAnother of my kind stands guard outside the entrance to Timbermaw Hold, along this road far to the north.  His name is Nafien; while he may appear to be a feral and unsavory beast, fear him not.  He only seeks aid against the malign forces that threaten our home.
8462.objectivesText: Travel north along the main road in Felwood and speak with the furbolg named Nafien.  He stands guard outside the entrance to Timbermaw Hold.
8462.title: Speak to Nafien

8464.description: The Timbermaw tend to stay to themselves, $n.  While we do allow safe passage to those we trust, we try to avoid other furbolg tribes if at all possible.$B$BThe Winterfall tribe as of late has become increasingly hostile towards us.  They seem to be in a state of rage, completely engulfed by their own fear and hatred of anything they do not understand.$B$BI must ask you to thin their numbers as to lessen the threat against us.  Seek them out in Winterfall Village, far to the east of here.
8464.objectivesText: Salfa wants you to kill $1oa Winterfall Shaman, $2oa Winterfall Den Watchers, and $3oa Winterfall Ursa. Salfa is located just outside the entrance to Timbermaw Hold in Winterspring.
8464.title: Winterfall Activity

8465.description: The threat of corruption comes not only from the Deadwood furbolgs to the south, but also from the east and the Winterfall furbolgs of Winterspring.  If you wish to further aid us, speak with Salfa on the other side of the Hold, by the Winterspring entrance.  Follow the path to the left to reach it.$B$BBe warned - if my kind inside considers you hostile or hated, they will attack.  Travel as quick as you can, avoiding conflict.  To kill a Timbermaw - even in self defense - will only alienate you further.
8465.objectivesText: Travel through Timbermaw Hold and exit into Winterspring.  Speak with Salfa, who stands guard outside the entrance to Timbermaw Hold.
8465.title: Speak to Salfa

8470.description: You have found one of the Deadwood furbolg's ritual totems.  The totem itself is of non-descript construction, but a palpable sense of despair emanates from it.  If there were any object that might best exemplify the corruption that the Deadwood furbolg suffer under, this item would clearly be it.$B$BOne of the furbolgs inside Timbermaw Hold may have a use for such an item... that is, if you've earned their trust enough for them to speak with you.
8470.objectivesText: Take the Deadwood Ritual Totem inside Timbermaw Hold and see if one of the furbolgs there will find a use for the item.  The Timbermaw will not speak with you unless you are of Neutral reputation or greater with them.
8470.title: Deadwood Ritual Totem

8503.description: So, $c, did I already tell you about all of the fabulous uses stranglekelp has? I did? Oh well... in any case we need a lot of it, and when I say a lot, I mean A LOT! Do you think that you could help us out? I know that it means going without all of those wonderful things that you can make with it, but it's for a good cause!
8503.objectivesText: Bring 20 Stranglekelp to Private Draxlegauge at the Military Ward in Ironforge.
8503.title: The Alliance Needs Stranglekelp!

8505.description: $C, the purple lotus is a flower with a plentitude of uses. I am here at the request of the Alliance as an authority on those applications, to preserve the herbs collected and to ensure that their war effort acquires enough purple lotus to sustain whatever function they plan for it.$B$BI would like for you to travel out into the world and return to me with some of these flowers. Is that something that you can do?
8505.objectivesText: Bring 20 Purple Lotus to Master Nightsong at the Military Ward in Ironforge.
8505.title: The Alliance Needs Purple Lotus!

8513.description: Yes $g sir : ma'am;, I have been charged with collecting and tracking all of the medium leather gathered for the war effort. If you have the wherewithal to gather medium leather, from whatever source, then please bring them to me here. I sure would appreciate a hand with this if you can spare the time.
8513.objectivesText: Bring 10 Medium Leather to Private Porter at the Military Ward in Ironforge.
8513.title: The Alliance Needs Medium Leather!

8515.description: Oh boy, this is going to be great! $C, the Ahn'Qiraj war effort is in full swing, and I've been put in charge of keeping track of all of the thick leather that comes in. We'll make tons of things with it, but first we need to get a ton of it. And I mean that literally! That's where you come in.$B$BSo, do you think you can go out there and bring me back a nice, fat stack of thick leather? Do yah, do yah?!
8515.objectivesText: Bring 10 Thick Leather to Marta Finespindle at the Military Ward in Ironforge.
8515.title: The Alliance Needs Thick Leather!

8517.description: The war at Ahn'Qiraj is going to be long and bloody. It is a very wise thing that the Alliance is doing by enlisting the aid of you, and those like you, to build up the materiel necessary before plunging headlong into conflict.$B$BI have been asked to head up the collection of linen bandages for the war, and I am hoping that you are going to assist me in amassing as many as we need. It is no light matter, but at least the linen bandages are the least difficult to create. Are you with us, $c?
8517.objectivesText: Bring 20 Linen Bandages to Sentinel Silversky at the Military Ward in Ironforge.
8517.title: The Alliance Needs Linen Bandages!

8520.description: With the Ahn'Qiraj War looming we need to do everything that we can to see to it that our soldiers have everything that they need. We're doing just that right here. For my part I've been placed in charge of seeing to it that we collect enough silk bandages.$B$BDo you think you can help me out, $c?
8520.objectivesText: Bring 20 Silk Bandages to Nurse Stonefield at the Military Ward in Ironforge.
8520.title: The Alliance Needs Silk Bandages!

8524.description: Hey there, friend! If I were to say to you, 'Don't you think that soldiers should have food to eat like anyone else?', you would of course reply, 'yes'. I agree with you 110%! I'm glad we're in accord. All I need for you to do is to head out there, fish up a whole bunch of raw rainbow fin albacore, and then cook it all up and bring it back to me right here. Mmm, mmm, I can taste it already.
8524.objectivesText: Bring 20 Rainbow Fin Albacore to Slicky Gastronome at the Military Ward in Ironforge.
8524.title: The Alliance Needs Rainbow Fin Albacore!

8528.description: It may not seem heroic to gather up cooked fish, but do not underestimate the value of preparation, young $c. Soldiers need to eat like anyone else, and we're here to do our part to make sure they have what they need once the war in Ahn'Qiraj commences.$B$BAccordingly, I am stockpiling spotted yellowtail, a versatile source of sustenance that stores well and can be used in many different dishes. It also doesn't have the odor of some other saltwater fish. Are you willing to aid me in this endeavor?
8528.objectivesText: Bring 20 Spotted Yellowtail to Huntress Swiftriver at the Military Ward in Ironforge.
8528.title: The Alliance Needs Spotted Yellowtail!

8530.description: $C, I need your help. In the Molten Core there are these stones, singed Corestones to be precise, that we need to harvest for the Ahn'Qiraj war effort. I'm told that our blacksmiths and engineers can put them to good use, so that's where you come in. I need you to go into the Molten Core and gather up as many of these corestones as you can. Of course, you'll want to talk thirty-nine of your closest friends along with you.
8530.objectivesText: Bring 50 singed corestones to Commander Stronghammer at the airfield in Dun Morogh.
8530.title: The Alliance Needs Singed Corestones!

8551.description: I used to sail a ship from here all the way to Ratchet, in Kalimdor.  I was a successful captain with a sterling reputation.$B$BUntil...$B$BThose cursed sea giants ruined me!  They smashed my ship, killed my crew, and set me on a lifeboat to Booty Bay.  And one of the giants, Gorlash, stole my Captain's Chest.  He said he wanted it for a snuffbox.  The nerve!$B$BI hear Gorlash wanders the coast east of here.  Find him and get back my chest!  Do that, and you'll have earned a captain's gratitude.
8551.objectivesText: Bring Smotts' Chest to Hecklebury Smotts in Booty Bay.
8551.title: The Captain's Chest

8553.description: After I lost my first ship to those giants, I bought another.  Named Smotts' Revenge, I filled it with supplies and crew, and set out to find the villains.  I found them, but...they beat me.  They smashed Smotts' Revenge, killed my second crew and set me on another lifeboat.$B$BThis time another of the giants, Negolash, stole my cutlass.$B$BFace Negolash and bring me my cutlass!$B$BSpeak with Sprogger.  He was my cook on the Smotts' Revenge, and survived the last attack.  He can help you find the giant.
8553.title: The Captain's Cutlass

8580.description: Hey, $c. Ya you, mon! There be a whole mess of firebloom the Horde thinkin' they need for this Ahn'Qiraj war effort. Maybe they put it in nice things that go boom? Maybe they give it to the Alliance as fuel for their steam tanks? Who knows? Not Pele'keiki!$B$BPele'keiki know this though... he know you gonna help him out and bring back lots of the firebloom, right, mon?
8580.objectivesText: Bring 20 Firebloom to Batrider Pele'keiki at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
8580.title: The Horde Needs Firebloom!

8582.description: The purple lotus, $c, is a reagent in a great many potions, elixirs and oils, some of which will be of use to us at Ahn'Qiraj. We're going to need to create an immense number of those potions for the war effort. And I'm going to experiment to find more uses for the lotus as well. But to do all of that I'm going to need a great quantity of the flower.$B$BThat's where you come in. Go out into the field and collect up as many purple lotuses as you can. Is this something that you are willing to do for us?
8582.objectivesText: Bring 20 Purple Lotus to Apothecary Jezel at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
8582.title: The Horde Needs Purple Lotus!

8600.description: I find that the fit of the knife in your palm is more important than the edge on it. Even the dullest blade can be made to cut if pressure is being properly applied through it, wouldn't you agree, $c? But you and I don't have such problems as we maintain the sharpest of edges, yes? $B$BWell, no matter, I have a task for you. In service to the Horde, and to do your part for the Ahn'Qiraj war effort, I want you to return to me with a number of rugged leather skins. This is something that you will do, no?
8600.objectivesText: Bring 10 Rugged Leather to Doctor Serratus at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
8600.title: The Horde Needs Rugged Leather!

8604.description: Greetings, $c. In preparation for the war at Ahn'Qiraj, I am here coordinating the Horde's efforts at gathering wool bandages. Unfortunately, out in the field, our soldiers cannot afford to rely upon the presence of a healer to keep them alive. Trust me, I know first hand. Thus, we're putting together all of these first aid kits for them.$B$BIf you have the time, I need many wool bandages. Return them to me here and I will see to it that you are properly rewarded.
8604.objectivesText: Bring 20 Wool Bandages to Healer Longrunner at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
8604.title: The Horde Needs Wool Bandages!

8607.description: I trust that you are speaking to me because you are going to help with the collection I have been entrusted to? Good! By whatever means, and I do mean whatever, I wish for you to gather up a good number of mageweave bandages. Fresh would be nice, but not absolutely necessary. Return them to me here, $c, and I will personally see to it that you are properly rewarded.
8607.objectivesText: Bring 20 Mageweave Bandages to Lady Callow at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
8607.title: The Horde Needs Mageweave Bandages!

8611.description: I'm not standing here just to get a nice tan, $c. There are war preparations to be made. If we're going to crush those bugs at Ahn'Qiraj then we need to be ready, and that includes food too!$B$BThey have me gathering and salting lean wolf steaks here for the upcoming war. But since I need to stay here to take care of all of this, I need you to go out, kill some wolves and then cook up the meat into lean wolf steaks and bring them back to me here. You got all that?
8611.objectivesText: Bring 20 Lean Wolf Steaks to Bloodguard Rawtar at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
8611.title: The Horde Needs Lean Wolf Steaks!

8615.description: The Ahn'Qiraj war effort is an immense undertaking, $c. All of the materials being gathered here, whether it is metal for weapons, or food to eat, are all as important as the other. For, if you haven't eaten in days you will not have the strength to lift your axe when it matters.$B$BThus, we gather what food we can. I am collecting baked salmon, a dish that was chosen both for its sustenance and its ability to keep well. Can you aid me with this task, $c?
8615.objectivesText: Bring 20 Baked Salmon to Chief Sharpclaw at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
8615.title: The Horde Needs Baked Salmon!

8746.description: DISASTER has struck!  Metzen the Reindeer has been kidnapped!$B$BMetzen is one of Great-father Winter's eight reindeer - and property of Smokywood Pastures.  We've received not one but TWO ransom letters from groups claiming to have Metzen.  With the holiday season well under way, we're strapped to the coin box here!  Please - find Metzen and return him to us!$B$BCheck out the ransom letters for clues, and sprinkle this reindeer dust on him - it will free him from any of his bonds!$B$BPlease, hurry!

objectives.text: Find Metzen the Reindeer and rescue him

8746.objectivesText: Find Metzen the Reindeer.  Use the notes provided to you for clues as to where he is being held.$B$BWhen you find Metzen, have the Pouch of Reindeer Dust in your possession so you can sprinkle some of the dust on him; this should free Metzen from his bonds of captivity.$B$BReturn the Pouch of Reindeer Dust to Kaymard Copperpinch in Orgrimmar once Metzen is freed.
8746.title: Metzen the Reindeer

8793.description: Hello, I'm glad that you've decided to hear me out. The Horde needs all of the help that it can get to prepare for the Ahn'Qiraj War, and that means that we need you! Even now as we speak, official collectors are gathering the necessary material needed for the upcoming war, but we won't be able to meet our goals without your assistance, $n!$B$BYou should go speak with the guy in charge, Warlord Gorchuk. What do you say, $c? Will you help out with the vital preparations?
8793.objectivesText: Speak with Warlord Gorchuk in Orgrimmar's Valley of Spirits.
8793.title: The Horde Needs Your Help!

8794.description: Hello, I'm glad that you've decided to hear me out. The Horde needs all of the help that it can get to prepare for the Ahn'Qiraj War, and that means that we need you! Even now as we speak, official collectors are gathering the necessary material needed for the upcoming war, but we won't be able to meet our goals without your assistance, $n!$B$BYou should go speak with the guy in charge, Warlord Gorchuk. What do you say, $c? Will you help out with the vital preparations?
8794.objectivesText: Speak with Warlord Gorchuk in Orgrimmar's Valley of Spirits.
8794.title: The Horde Needs Your Help!

8795.description: Hello, I'm glad that you've decided to hear me out. The Alliance needs all of the help that it can get to prepare for the Ahn'Qiraj War, and that means that we need you! Even now as we speak, official collectors are gathering the necessary material needed for the upcoming war, but we won't be able to meet our goals without your assistance, $n!$B$BYou should go speak with the guy in charge, Field Marshal Snowfall. What do you say, $c? Will you help out with the vital preparations?
8795.objectivesText: Speak with Field Marshal Snowfall in Ironforge's Military Ward.
8795.title: The Alliance Needs Your Help!

8796.description: Hello, I'm glad that you've decided to hear me out. The Alliance needs all of the help that it can get to prepare for the Ahn'Qiraj War, and that means that we need you! Even now as we speak, official collectors are gathering the necessary material needed for the upcoming war, but we won't be able to meet our goals without your assistance, $n!$B$BYou should go speak with the guy in charge, Field Marshal Snowfall. What do you say, $c? Will you help out with the vital preparations?
8796.objectivesText: Speak with Field Marshal Snowfall in Ironforge's Military Ward.
8796.title: The Alliance Needs Your Help!

8857.description: I'm looking for battle hardened adventurers willing and able to get a fresh husk sample from the fallen Colossus of Ashi to Oglethorpe in Booty Bay. No, no, I wouldn't want you to go anywhere near that thing's corpse. Just take one of my samples and make it snappy. These things are no good to him rotten!
8857.objectivesText: Take the Colossus of Ashi's Husk to Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay.
8857.title: Secrets of the Colossus - Ashi

8858.description: There ain't nothin' I'd like more than to stuff this bug husk down Oilfist's fat face... Cept, I'm stuck here collectin' samples from that overgrown cockroach. I'll be here 'till the wee mornin' hours given the size o' that thing.$B$BTake this here sample to Oilfist fer me and do it fast, $c. He's payin' BIG!$B$BYar, Thorium Point - it be in the Searin' Gorge.
8858.objectivesText: Take the Colossus of Regal's Husk to Overseer Oilfist in Searing Gorge.
8858.title: Secrets of the Colossus - Regal

8859.description: My servants were nearly killed in their efforts to recover this sample. You absolutely must hurry! Lord Maxwell Tyrosus eagerly awaits a fresh husk sample. He believes that the secrets of this Colossus could help us in the war against the Scourge!$B$BWhy are you still here!? To Light's Hope! Yes, you will be rewarded handsomely for your efforts...
8859.objectivesText: Take the Colossus of Zora's Husk to Lord Maxwell Tyrosus at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
8859.title: Secrets of the Colossus - Zora

8867.description: Every year the druids of Moonglade hold a celebration of our city's great triumph over an ancient evil.$B$BWe celebrate the wisdom of our elders, share in magnificent feasts and of course... shoot fireworks!$B$BFor a small donation you can purchase colorful rockets from our vendor.  Try using some of the launchers around here, $n.
8867.objectivesText: Launch 8 Lunar Fireworks and 2 Cluster Fireworks and return to a Lunar Festival Harbinger at any capital city.
8867.title: Lunar Fireworks

8868.description: The beast Omen was once a hero of this world.  A wolf of great strength and fortune, Omen fought beside the heroes of the War of the Ancients until he succumbed to demonic magics.  Turning against his allies, he raged across Azeroth and carried death and terror in his wake.$B$BFinally defeated here, in Moonglade, Omen now sleeps among the silt of Lake Elune'ara.  But each new year, during the festival, he stirs...$B$BGather cohorts, $n, and summon and defeat the beast Omen.  Earn the blessing of Elune!
8868.objectivesText: Summon Omen, defeat him and gain Elune's Blessing.  Return to Valadar Starsong in Nighthaven
8868.title: Elune's Blessing

8871.description: It's that time of the year, $n!  The Cenarion Circle invites all denizens of Azeroth to partake in our celebration of the Lunar Festival.  You will find the Lunar Festival Harbinger in this very city at a location marked by a blessed circle of moonlight.  She can tell you more about the holiday.
8871.objectivesText: Talk to the Lunar Festival Harbinger in the Park District in Stormwind.  You can also talk to Lunar Festival Harbingers in other capital cities.
8871.title: The Lunar Festival

8872.description: It's that time of the year, $n!  The Cenarion Circle invites all denizens of Azeroth to partake in our celebration of the Lunar Festival.  You will find the Lunar Festival Harbinger in this very city at a location marked by a blessed circle of moonlight.  She can tell you more about the holiday.
8872.objectivesText: Talk to the Lunar Festival Harbinger at the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus.  You can also talk to Lunar Festival Harbingers in other capital cities.
8872.title: The Lunar Festival

8873.description: It's that time of the year, $n!  The Cenarion Circle invites all denizens of Azeroth to partake in our celebration of the Lunar Festival.  You will find the Lunar Festival Harbinger in this very city at a location marked by a blessed circle of moonlight.  She can tell you more about the holiday.
8873.objectivesText: Talk to the Lunar Festival Harbinger in the Valley of Wisdom in Orgrimmar.  You can also talk to Lunar Festival Harbingers in other capital cities.
8873.title: The Lunar Festival

8874.description: It's that time of the year, $n!  The Cenarion Circle invites all denizens of Azeroth to partake in our celebration of the Lunar Festival.  You will find the Lunar Festival Harbinger in this very city at a location marked by a blessed circle of moonlight.  She can tell you more about the holiday.
8874.objectivesText: Talk to the Lunar Festival Harbinger in the entrance to the Undercity.  You can also talk to Lunar Festival Harbingers in other capital cities.
8874.title: The Lunar Festival

8875.description: It's that time of the year, $n!  The Cenarion Circle invites all denizens of Azeroth to partake in our celebration of the Lunar Festival.  You will find the Lunar Festival Harbinger in this very city at a location marked by a blessed circle of moonlight.  She can tell you more about the holiday.
8875.objectivesText: Talk to the Lunar Festival Harbinger at the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff.  You can also talk to Lunar Festival Harbingers in other capital cities.
8875.title: The Lunar Festival

8899.description: How to describe her beauty? Thousands of years of words and I am at a loss.$b$bThese mortals confound the mind and leave us babbling fools.$b$bI've stared at these words too long. No more eloquent meaning can I squeeze from them. No, she must have it now, or some other suitor will surely steal her eye.
8899.objectivesText: Deliver the Immaculate Letter to Colara Dean outside the bank in Stormwind.
8899.title: Dearest Colara,

8902.description: A lifetime ago, I was betrothed to marry Elenia, my childhood sweetheart. It's been years since I thought about her last, but of late, she frequently occupies my thoughts.$b$bPerhaps, even with everything that has passed, there can be some room in each other's lives for our love.$b$bI'm sure she has changed, also. Can you deliver this letter to her for me? I am too nervous to give it in person.
8902.objectivesText: Deliver the Lovingly Composed Letter to Elenia Haydon near the bank in the Undercity.
8902.title: Dearest Elenia,

8910.description: Well met, $c.  I've something that might interest you.$B$BI have in my possession a set of armor much like the one worn by those of your profession, but of much higher quality.  I'd be willing to trade the bracers for ordinary ones in exchange for a small favor.$B$BThe blood of the frostsabers and bears that inhabit Winterspring has properties I'm in need of at the moment.  Bring me a sizeable sample of it along with the bracers and a small amount of gold.  You shall find the effort worth your while.
8910.objectivesText: Acquire 15 Winterspring Blood Samples and 20 gold and bring them along with a set of Shadowcraft Bracers to Deliana in Ironforge.
8910.title: An Earnest Proposition

8912.description: Well met, $c.  I've something that might interest you.$B$BI have in my possession a set of armor much like the one worn by those of your profession, but of much higher quality.  I'd be willing to trade the bracers for ordinary ones in exchange for a small favor.$B$BThe blood of the frostsabers and bears that inhabit Winterspring has properties I'm in need of at the moment.  Bring me a sizeable sample of it along with the bracers and a small amount of gold.  You shall find the effort worth your while.
8912.objectivesText: Acquire 15 Winterspring Blood Samples and 20 gold and bring them along with a set of Bracers of Valor to Deliana in Ironforge.
8912.title: An Earnest Proposition

8920.description: Hail, $c!  I can tell by your demeanor that you've seen and done much in this world.  Yet I'm willing to wager you haven't seen a piece of armor like this.$B$BPerform a small favor for me and I'll be willing to trade it to you for an ordinary set of bracers.$B$BI'm in need of a sizeable sample of venom drawn from the spiders and scorpions that inhabit Silithus.  Bring this to me along with a few gold coins and I'll perform the exchange.
8920.objectivesText: Acquire 15 Silithus Venom Samples and 20 gold and bring them along with a set of Bracers of Valor to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.
8920.title: An Earnest Proposition

8921.description: Ah, you're in need of my latest project... the extra-dimensional ghost revealer!  Unfortunately I've run out of funds and manpower.$B$BYou're willing to help?  Excellent!  Our first task is to build a device to harvest the very fabric of death!  Building an ectoplasmic distiller won't be an easy task, $n.$B$BI'll need you to bring me an arcanite converter, some greater eternal essences and stonescale oil. I'll also need some volcanic ash from the lava pools in the Burning Steppes to build a filter.
8921.objectivesText: Return to Mux Manascrambler in Gadgetzan with 1 Delicate Arcanite Converter, 4 Greater Eternal Essence, 10 Stonescale Oil, 25 Volcanic Ash and 40 gold.
8921.title: The Ectoplasmic Distiller

8922.description: I must find a way to speak with Anthion Harmon... or more specifically, his ghost!$B$BI know of an engineer with a queer interest in the supernatural.  He claims he can build a machine that allows him to speak with the dead!$B$BThe blood you collected was intended for him; travel to Gadgetzan and bring it to him as payment for his services!
8922.objectivesText: Bring the Sealed Blood Container to Mux Manascrambler inside Gadgetzan in Tanaris.
8922.title: A Supernatural Device

8923.description: You must be quite brave to have stuck around after that.  That or I've piqued your interest with the piece of armor I gave you.  There is more from where that came from, if you're still interested in aiding me.$B$BThe venom samples you collected are for an acquaintance of mine, Mux Manascrambler, an engineer with an interest in the supernatural.  His latest project consists of a device that allows you to communicate with the dead!  My last hope is to contact Anthion and find out more about my situation.
8923.objectivesText: Take the Sealed Venom Container to Mux Manascrambler in Gadgetzan.
8923.title: A Supernatural Device

8924.description: A fine piece of engineering, if I do say so myself!  You will need to travel a bit, I'm afraid, in order to find the incorporeal undead we require.$B$BYou see, different climates lend different consistencies to the spectral fabric of the dead.  The tortured night elves of Silithus, the spirits of the highborne from Winterspring and the ghosts and banshees of the Eastern Plaguelands should give us the different types of ectoplasm we need.  Be sure to place the distiller nearby before you harvest them!
8924.objectivesText: Use the Ectoplasmic Distiller near incorporeal undead to collect 12 Scorched Ectoplasms in Silithus, 12 Frozen Ectoplasms in Winterspring and 12 Stable Ectoplasms in the Eastern Plaguelands.  Bring them along with the Ectoplasmic Distiller back to Mux Manascrambler in Gadgetzan.
8924.title: Hunting for Ectoplasm

8928.description: The core will provide us with enough juice to power our device; now we just have to build a rod that can channel that energy without melting.$B$BI met an imp in Winterspring that sold all manner of exotic goods.  He had an elemental rod that would do perfectly.  I'm kicking myself in the head right now for not having bought it.$B$BHe lives inside a cave in the entrance to Darkwhisper Gorge.  Sneak in there and try to find him.$B$BMake sure he only charges you forty gold; that's the price he quoted me!
8928.objectivesText: Search for an imp inside a cave at the entrance of Darkwhisper Gorge in southern Winterspring, purchase a Fel Elemental Rod and return to Mux Manascrambler in Gadgetzan.
8928.title: A Shifty Merchant

8929.description: Well, nothing left for us to do but try out the goblin's invention.  Word has it that Anthion was mowed down by the undead legions of Stratholme as he tried to enter its gates.$B$BTry using the device there and find out whatever Anthion knew.
8929.objectivesText: Use the Extra-Dimensional Ghost Revealer at the entrance to Stratholme and speak with the ghost of Anthion Harmon.
8929.title: In Search of Anthion

8945.description: I'll provide you the information you ask for, $n.  But more pressing matters are at hand.$B$BMy beloved wife has been taken prisoner by Rivendare's undead scum.$B$BI strongly objected to her joining the Argent Dawn's foolish crusade, yet that's not of importance anymore.  You must finish what I attempted to do, you must rescue Ysida from the clutches of the Baron!
8945.objectivesText: Go into Stratholme and rescue Ysida Harmon from Baron Rivendare.
8945.title: Dead Man's Plea

8946.description: It is the cruelest of fates that my beloved has perished while trying to rescue me.  Yet, you claim to possess the ability to converse with him.$B$BBring him this locket as proof that I am well.  He must not linger in this world; my heart would not be able to bear it.$B$BFarewell, $n.  I shall be in your debt always.
8946.objectivesText: Bring Ysida's Locket to Anthion Harmon in Eastern Plaguelands.
8946.title: Proof of Life

8948.description: Theldren is not one to willingly participate in a fair fight.  I've shaped this banner to display his family colors.$B$BWith some additional sorcery, this banner shall provoke him in a way he won't be able to resist.$B$BAn old acquaintance of mine named Falrin knows the exact procedure required.  He has a particular way of... aggravating people.  You shall find him at the library in Dire Maul.
8948.objectivesText: Take the incomplete Banner of Provocation to Falrin Treeshaper at the library in Dire Maul.
8948.title: Anthion's Old Friend

8949.description: Yes, it is true that I am familiar with this enchantment you require, $c.  Yet I'm not one to give out favors freely, even if you were sent here by an old friend.$B$BI hold nothing but hatred and contempt for our brutish ogre neighbors.  And not only them, I hate the followers of Omokk just as much as I hate those that follow King Gordok.$B$BI want you to kill them.  Kill lots of them!  Bring me the beads they carry around their neck as proof of your work.  Do this and we shall talk about your request.
8949.objectivesText: Collect 25 Ogre Warbeads from Ogres inside Dire Maul or Blackrock Spire and return to Falrin Treeshaper inside the Athenaeum in Dire Maul.
8949.title: Falrin's Vendetta

8961.description: In order to summon Lord Valthalak we're first going to need to gather the other two-thirds of the amulet. To do that we need to get a brazier and some special coals to burn in it.$B$BThere are three nobles of fire, Lord Incedius in Blackrock Depths, Pyroguard Emberseer in Blackrock Spire and Executor Asharell in the Steppes, with what we need. Collect from each a piece of their remains, and then return to me with a Hallowed Brazier, which can be purchased from the Argent Dawn if you are honored by them.
8961.objectivesText: Gather the Incendicite of Incendius, the Ember of Emberseer and the Ash of Asharell, along with a Hallowed Brazier, and return them to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.
8961.title: Three Kings of Flame

8963.description: $C, listen closely. Now that we have the brazier, and the means to light it, we still need another component to suffuse it with; something that will provide a focus strong enough to entice the spirit of my deceased, former comrade.$B$BIsalien, our priestess, grew up in Winterspring at Starbreeze Village. I need you to gather a Starbreeze Village Relic from the Frostmaul giants of Frostwhisper Gorge in southern Winterspring, who are known for raiding to the north from time to time.
8963.objectivesText: Acquire a Starbreeze Village Relic and return it to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.
8963.title: Components of Importance

8970.description: As I was saying, $c, in my living years I flirted with becoming a diviner. But, there really wasn't as much profit in it as you might imagine, mostly because it's dangerous and the reagents are rare and expensive. However, I do know enough to be able to pinpoint the final piece of the amulet, and the spirit of my former comrade along with it.$B$BThis is where you come in, $n. I need you to go to Alcaz Island off the coast of Dustwallow Marsh and collect Bloodkelp from the Strashaz naga that live there.
8970.objectivesText: Gather 20 Bloodkelp from the Strashaz naga and then return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.
8970.title: I See Alcaz Island In Your Future...

8977.description: It's been great working with you, $n.  Here is the finished product.$B$BI hope it helps you in your current endeavors.  And hey, if you don't mind, help spread the word.  I wouldn't mind having more customers!
8977.objectivesText: Bring the Extra-Dimensional Ghost Revealer  to Deliana in Ironforge.
8977.title: Return to Deliana

8978.description: It's been great working with you, $n.  Here is the finished product.$B$BI hope it helps you in your current endeavors.  And hey, if you don't mind, help spread the word.  I wouldn't mind having more customers!
8978.objectivesText: Return to Mokvar in Orgrimmar with the Extra-Dimensional Ghost Revealer.
8978.title: Return to Mokvar

8985.description: $C, listen closely. Now that we have the location of the last amulet piece, we still need another component to suffuse the brazier with; something that will provide a focus strong enough to entice the spirit of my deceased, former comrade.$B$BIsalien, our priestess, grew up in Winterspring at Starbreeze Village. I need you to gather a Starbreeze Village Relic from the Frostmaul giants of Frostwhisper Gorge in southern Winterspring, who are known for raiding to the north from time to time.
8985.objectivesText: Acquire a Starbreeze Village Relic and return it to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.
8985.title: More Components of Importance

8995.description: All is now ready, $n.$B$BWhen alive, Lord Valthalak used to inhabit what is now The Beast's chamber. Go there and use the Brazier of Beckoning to summon forth Lord Valthalak. It will reincorporate him, so he'll have to be killed again. I'd take care of The Beast first, and be sure take enough friends along to survive the upper portion of Blackrock Spire.$B$BOnce you've dispatched Valthalak, use the amulet on his corpse. With his spirit reunified, he'll likely want his amulet back, as well.$B$BGood luck!
8995.objectivesText: Use the Brazier of Beckoning to summon Lord Valthalak. Dispatch him, and use Lord Valthalak's Amulet on the corpse. Then, return Lord Valthalak's Amulet to the Spirit of Lord Valthalak.
8995.title: Mea Culpa, Lord Valthalak

8996.description: I will ignore your impertinence this time, $c, because you have done a noble thing today; returning the rest of my stolen spirit to me. Despite your obviously weak nature, $r, you have shown courage where those that stole from me did not, and probably never could!$B$BReturn to them, before I change my mind and slay you where you stand. Go back and tell them that they are safe... for now.
8996.objectivesText: Return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain and give him the Brazier of Beckoning.
8996.title: Return to Bodley

8997.description: I suppose that this is goodbye then, my friend. But, I'll always be here if you want to come back and talk with me from time to time. Probably while you're loitering around waiting for your buddies to join you for a raid on Blackrock Spire.$B$BGo, before I start to cry. Go back to Deliana in Ironforge and tell her what's happened.
8997.objectivesText: Speak with Deliana at The High Seat in Ironforge.
8997.title: Back to the Beginning

9052.description: I would ask you to help me create a toxin of sorts, to pacify a great creature living here in the crater.  It is not deadly, and only the keen eyes of a $c can hope to collect the ingredients.$b$bYou can find the bloodcap mushrooms growing within the bloodpetal sprouts all across the crater.  Gorishi stings are from the giant flying wasps inside and around the Slithering Scar, located in the southern part of the crater.
9052.objectivesText: Collect 8 Bloodcap and 8 Gorishi Stings, and return to Torwa Pathfinder in Un'Goro Crater.
9052.title: Bloodpetal Poison

9053.description: It is as I feared -- the toxin is simply too weak for such a powerful creature.$b$bIf we are to create a toxin of high enough potency, you must venture to the bottom of the Temple of Atal'Hakkar, unlock the secrets of the altar and recover a putrid vine from the guardian there.  The temple is dangerous, and it would behoove you to bring friends.$b$bReturn to me when this is done.
9053.objectivesText: Retrieve a Putrid Vine from the guardian at the bottom of the Sunken Temple and return to Torwa Pathfinder.
9053.title: A Better Ingredient

9085.description: After you bring down the defenses of the Scourge summoning circles that have appeared in the zones under attack, you will be able to confront the acolytes who protect them.$b$bIn truth, these are not men. They are shadows, some of the Lich King's most frightening creatures. They can be revealed using the necrotic runes they carry, and then destroyed with magic or strength of arms.
9085.objectivesText: Go to a summoning circle and kill a Shadow of Doom, then return to Commander Thomas Helleran at Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands.
9085.title: Shadows of Doom

9121.description: In the thick of Plaguewood lies the entrance to the dread citadel of Naxxramas. Previously, all attempts to enter had been stymied by the magical wards placed upon the rune portal. That is, until now.$B$BWe have devised a way to gain entry via arcane cloaking - an old cantrip of the Kirin Tor with a few modifications of my own. Since your dedication to the cause of the Dawn is somewhat lacking, $n, the price will be high. You may decline and choose to return when you are revered or exalted for a discount.
9121.objectivesText: Archmage Angela Dosantos at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 5 Arcane Crystals, 2 Nexus Crystals, 1 Righteous Orb and 60 gold pieces. You must also be Honored with the Argent Dawn.
9121.title: The Dread Citadel - Naxxramas

9131.description: Have you ever seen Dreadnaught armor, $c? No, of course you haven't. You're still a $g boy:girl; - a tyke. Let me tell you, it is glorious.$B$BYou're probably asking yourself what any of this has to do with you, right? I'll tell you what, scrub; I need Dark Iron scraps and I'm willing to pay to get my hands on as many as possible.$B$BI need the scraps to put together sets of Dreadnaught for our champions. Bring me scraps and get paid.
9131.objectivesText: Korfax at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 30 Dark Iron Scraps.
9131.title: Binding the Dreadnaught

9247.description: $n,$B$BIn times past you have served the interests of the Argent Dawn, always to the best of your abilities. Now, once again, we sound the clarion call in our time of greatest need.$B$B$n, please report to the Keeper of the Rolls at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands if you are willing to aid us once more.
9247.objectivesText: Take the Letter from the Keeper of the Rolls to him at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
9247.title: The Keeper's Call

9260.description: The Scourge is camped upon our very doorstep; we cannot remain idle! Surely you will step up to defend Stormwind from these accursed invaders? $b $bThere are strange runic circles outside, glowing with the same energy that surrounds the undead and the Necropolis above. They have significance, I'm certain, and I want you to find out what. Thin the numbers of those aberrations while you're at it; bring me proof of their death along with your results, and I will reward you.  Go!
9260.objectivesText: Collect three Dim Necrotic Stones from the Scourge outside Stormwind and investigate the glowing runic circles nearby their encampment.
9260.title: Investigate the Scourge of Stormwind

9261.description: The Scourge is camped upon our very doorstep; we cannot remain idle! Surely you will step up to defend Ironforge from these accursed invaders? $b $bThere are strange runic circles outside, glowing with the same energy that surrounds the undead and the Necropolis above. They have significance, I'm certain, and I want you to find out what. Thin the numbers of those aberrations while you're at it; bring me proof of their death along with your results, and I will reward you.  Go!
9261.objectivesText: Collect three Dim Necrotic Stones from the Scourge outside Ironforge and investigate the glowing runic circles nearby their encampment.
9261.title: Investigate the Scourge of Ironforge

9262.description: The Scourge is camped upon our very doorstep; we cannot remain idle! Surely you will step up to defend Darnassus from these accursed invaders? $b $bThere are strange runic circles outside, glowing with the same energy that surrounds the undead and the Necropolis above. They have significance, I'm certain, and I want you to find out what. Thin the numbers of those aberrations while you're at it; bring me proof of their death along with your results, and I will reward you.  Go!
9262.objectivesText: Collect three Dim Necrotic Stones from the Scourge outside Darnassus and investigate the glowing runic circles nearby their encampment.
9262.title: Investigate the Scourge of Darnassus

9265.description: The Scourge is camped upon our very doorstep; we cannot remain idle! Surely you will step up to defend the Undercity from these accursed invaders? $b $bThere are strange runic circles outside, glowing with the same energy that surrounds the undead and the Necropolis above. They have significance, I'm certain, and I want you to find out what. Thin the numbers of those aberrations while you're at it; bring me proof of their death along with your results, and I will reward you.  Go!
9265.objectivesText: Collect three Dim Necrotic Stones from the Scourge outside the Undercity and investigate the glowing runic circles nearby their encampment.
9265.title: Investigate the Scourge of the Undercity

9292.description: On the corpse of the fallen abomination, you discover a cracked crystal, slowly pulsing with necrotic energy.
9292.objectivesText: Bring the Cracked Necrotic Crystal to Lieutenant Orrin outside the gates of Stormwind.
9292.title: Cracked Necrotic Crystal

9295.description: You found this letter on one of the many Scourge minions you've slain. From its appearance and smell, it has been with the undead for some time. Perhaps someone at Light's Hope Chapel would be interested in examining it further...
9295.objectivesText: Take the Torn Letter to the Keeper of the Rolls at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
9295.title: Letter from the Front

9310.description: On the corpse of the fallen wight, you find a crystal that is faintly radiating necrotic energy.
9310.objectivesText: Bring the Faint Necrotic Crystal to Lieutenant Rukag in the courtyard of the Undercity.
9310.title: Faint Necrotic Crystal

9322.description: The Midsummer Fire Festival is celebrated everywhere in Azeroth, and the diverse land of Kalimdor is no exception. You look fit to travel -- perhaps a journey is in order.$b$bMidsummer cannot be truly appreciated unless you've seen the blistering blue fires abroad. The celebrants have lit fires in chilly western Winterspring, northeastern Azshara, near Valor's Rest in the wastes of Silithus, and by the entrance to lush Un'Goro. Return once your journey is complete.
9322.objectivesText: Visit the Midsummer camps located in Azshara, Silithus, Un'Goro Crater, and Winterspring, then return to the Festival Flamekeeper.
9322.title: Wild Fires in Kalimdor

9388.description: There are many flames burning throughout the world today, $n. The trickiest fires to tend are those that burn green; they do not stay lit long without supervision. Make certain the emerald fires still burn on Kalimdor for our Flamekeeper, eh?$b$bYou will find them near Ratchet in the Barrens, close to the Master's Glaive in Darkshore, in the forest of Ashenvale by the bridge near Silverwing Outpost, and near the road to Windshear Crag along the main road in Stonetalon Mountains.
9388.objectivesText: Visit the bonfires within Ashenvale, the Barrens, Darkshore, and Stonetalon Mountains, then speak with the Festival Flamekeeper.
9388.title: Flickering Flames in Kalimdor

9389.description: The Midsummer Fire Festival traditionally lights up the land with a myriad of flames. Some argue that the green fires are the finest, as they are the hardest to maintain and have such a distinctive hue.$b$bMake sure they still burn in the Eastern Kingdoms for our Flamekeeper. They sit near Dun Modr in the Wetlands, close to Pyrewood Village within Silverpine Forest, on the cliffs overlooking the lighthouse in Westfall, and by the ruined tower in Hillsbrad Foothills.
9389.objectivesText: Visit the bonfires within Hillsbrad Foothills, Silverpine Forest, Westfall, and the Wetlands, then speak with the Festival Flamekeeper.
9389.title: Flickering Flames in the Eastern Kingdoms

9422.description: For some time now, we have been tapping the crystal resources of the Silithus desert. The only dangers we faced were from the creatures that made this place their home and the oppressive sand and dust and heat.$b$bBut now the Alliance seems to have caught on to what we have found here. It is now a race between us to capture the natural resources, and keep them from the other.$b$bI need every set of hands that is available. I hope I have yours.
9422.objectivesText: Find and deliver Silithyst to the Silithyst Extractor then speak with General Kirika at the Horde encampment near Hive'Regal.
9422.title: Scouring the Desert

65597.description: The time has come at last. Bring the hearts to the summoning circle below. Place them at its center and call forth the incubus.$b$bThe demon will not be pleased when it realizes that you have tempted it into a trap. Do not fall prey to its beguilement, $n. You must subdue it fully.$b$bOnly then can I teach you the spell to bind it to your will.
65597.objectivesText: Using the Lovers' Hearts, summon and subdue an incubus, then return the Lovers' Hearts to Carendin Halgar in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.
65597.title: The Binding

76160.description: Maybe your skills lie with poisons, not disguises. The Harpies to the north nest in a tree which produces a resin of potent toxicity. Gather the fallen cones around the nests, then crush them into a salve. When applied to a blade this salve will sear your opponent's wounds into their flesh and turn their blood to salt.
76160.objectivesText: Gather 8 Windfury Cones north of Thunder Bluff, use them with the Mortar and Pestle, then return to Boarton Shadetotem in Thunder Bluff with the result.
76160.title: Stalk With The Earthmother

conditionalDescriptions.text:
<The mysterious orb you hold fills you with cold dread. You can almost hear a voice echo faintly in your mind. Low and guttural, you understand well that the language being spoken is demonic in nature. 

Even as a paladin, this magic is beyond you. Delgren the Purifier might be able to help you discern the nature of this sinister object.>

78088.description:
<The mysterious orb you hold fills you with cold dread. You can almost hear a voice echo faintly in your mind. Low and guttural, you understand well that the language being spoken is demonic in nature. 

Even as a paladin, this magic is beyond you. Find a more senior paladin here in Kalimdor who might be able to help you discern the nature of this sinister object.>
78088.objectivesText: Bring the Althalaxx Orb to Delgren the Purifier at Maestra's Post in Ashenvale.
78088.title: A Strange Artifact

78089.description:
There's a powerful darkness about this orb. Its nature is clearly demonic, but past that it is beyond my ability to discern its purpose.

Take the orb to the one known as Katherine the Pure in the Stormwind Cathedral. Consult with her for advice on the orb.
78089.objectivesText: Bring the Althalaxx Orb to Katherine the Pure in Stormwind.
78089.title: Advice From Stormwind

78090.description:
I'm not sure what to make of this orb, $n. I think we will need the help of... a specialist.

We are aware of a warlock sect operating out of Stormwind. Officially we reject the presence of warlocks in the city. Unofficially, their knowledge can be of use when dealing with demonic forces.

Find a representative of these warlocks, and seek their opinion on the orb.
78090.objectivesText: Find the warlock sanctum within Stormwind and seek advice on the orb.
78090.title: A Second Opinion

78091.description:
I will study the orb and tell you what I learn, but you must first do something for me.

The warlocks of the Blackrock clan use specially prepared salts to enhance their summoning rituals. Collect some from the orcs in Redridge.

When you return, I will share with you the results of my studies.
78091.objectivesText: Collect 14 Summoner's Salt from Blackrock Summoners in Redridge Mountains, then return to Ursula Deline in Stormwind.
78091.title: Earning Your Salt

78093.description: <The shattered remains of the orb lay at your feet. Delgren will want to see you have succeeded.>
78093.objectivesText: Return the Orb Shards to Delgren.
78093.title: Return to Delgren

78261.description:
<A note sits in the chest>

Hello, $n.

I desire a treasure known as The Horn of Xelthos, which is somewhere within Shadowfang Keep.

Venturing inside the keep usually calls for backup. However, for this job, a low profile is of utmost importance.

You must go alone.

I have a contact, by the name of Veenix, in the Stonetalon Mountains. He should be able to help you get past the courtyard gate. The rest is up to you. 

Return the horn here, and your payment will be sent soon after.

- C
78261.objectivesText: Find The Horn of Xelthos inside of Shadowfang Keep. Then, return it to C's dead drop near Pyrewood Village. You must complete the job alone.
78261.title: The Horn of Xelthos

78676.description:
<A note sits in the chest>

Glad to have you back, $n.

The latest object of my desire is an artifact known as the Eye of Bhossca. My sources tell me the eye is somewhere within the Scarlet Monastery. As with Shadowfang Keep, you must infiltrate the monastery alone.

It may behoove you to find a disguise before going in. It will make getting around a touch easier. I'm sure you could find something on the monastery's grounds.

Return the eye here, and payment will be delivered as before.

- C
78676.objectivesText: Find The Eye of Bhossca inside of the Scarlet Monastery. Then, return it to C's dead drop near Pyrewood Village. You must complete the job alone.
78676.title: The Eye of Bhossca

79007.description:
<The faint radiance of the embers darkening, you stumble across the remnants of a recent fire.

Amidst the scattered provisions, you discover a blistered note.>

"Not all that burns is lost. Find the twin land, find the place."
79007.objectivesText: Charred remains of the note serve as your only guide.
79007.title: ... and that note you found

79008.description:
<The faint radiance of the embers darkening, you stumble across the remnants of a recent fire.

Amidst the scattered provisions, you discover a blistered note.>

"Not all that burns is lost. Find the twin land, find the place."
79008.objectivesText: Charred remains of the note serve as your only guide.
79008.title: ... and that note you found

79090.description: Some of the Warsong Outriders lie defeated, but the battle still rages...
79090.objectivesText: Bring the Warsong Outrider Mark to Felore Moonray, Priestess of the Moon, at the Moonwell base in Ashenvale.
79090.title: Repelling Invaders

79098.description: This one is slain, but these infuriating alliance continue to fight... what is this charm?
79098.objectivesText: Bring the Silverwing Sentinel Charm to Kazragore, Far Seer, at the Bonfire base in Ashenvale.
79098.title: Clear the Forest!

79192.description: The note begins, "Mission said they were both making deliveries for New Plague. Looks like simple apothecary accidents to me. Find my cozy spot in the mountains between The Barrens and Desolace if you want a safe place to talk."
79192.objectivesText: You tear the note from the plank and read the scrawled writing.
79192.title: Stepping Stones

79235.description:
I've found a couple of scenes like you describe, $n. Always camps of humans and dwarves. Rumor among the caravans is a group of Horde marauders did it. Seems likely given the victims, and how brutal the attacks were.

Apparently the bandits fled Desolace once an Alliance marshal got hot on their trail.

If you're looking to track one of 'em down, I'd check Booty Bay. Ports always have shady characters coming and going. You might catch one trying to get a boat to somewhere.
79235.objectivesText: Find one of the Desolace marauders.
79235.title: On the Lam

79358.description:
Floodin' the Thousand Needles is no small feat, $n. If I hadn't felt the elements' outrage meself, I'd have never believed it. But here we are.

The quilboar aren't the first tae weaponize the elements irresponsibly, and they won't be the last. If we want to prepare our own counter-ritual, we'll need a better understanding of these twisted elements. Take this book. It details the many denizens of Azeroth and how they practice shamanism.

If you can learn from them, maybe we can find a solution.
79358.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Twisted Fire Totems, $2oa Twisted Earth Totems, $3oa Twisted Air Totems, and $4oa Twisted Water Totems for Veyric Thunderhame in Arathi Highlands.
79358.title: Storm, Earth, and Fire

79360.completionText: Bring the Tattered Note to Rau Cliffrunner in Thousand Needles.
79360.description:
Now that you have mastered the elements, you have an obligation to them, and thus to all of Azeroth herself. We call to them for aid, we do not demand their power. It is time you return the favors granted to you. And I think I know how.

The quilboar twist the elements for their own ends, and seem to be extending their reach within these borders. Go into their kraul and put an end to whatever they scheme. These lands must be protected.
79360.objectivesText: Defeat Charlga Razorflank in Razorfen Kraul and collect information on the quilboar's plans.
79360.title: Elemental Aid

79361.description:
So the quilboar mean to flood the Thousand Needles with their twisted shamanism, do they? It seems almost unimaginable, but you yourself have seen that these creatures are not to be taken lightly.

I had wished to continue your training in earnest, but there is no time for that now. These lands are home to many different creatures, friend and foe alike, and none of them deserve such a fate. We must act.

Take this tome. It was meant for study, but may now hold the key to dispersing this coming storm.
79361.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Twisted Fire Totems, $2oa Twisted Earth Totems, $3oa Twisted Air Totems, and $4oa Twisted Water Totems for Prate Cloudseer in Thousand Needles.
79361.title: Storm, Earth, and Fire

79365.description: Here mon, a Squall-breakers Potion be what you need. Drink this to protect yourself against the elements of the storm, but remember it only goin' to last for a short while.$B$BNow go, return to your friends in need. There's nothing more I can do for you.
79365.objectivesText: Return to Rau Cliffrunner in Thousand Needles at Freewind Post.
79365.title: With Wind Beneath Your Wings

79482.description: Listen... not to shatter the magic of the season here, but Smokywood Pastures could use some assistance - the kind you adventuring types are known to give.$B$BWe're missing an important shipment of treats that was restocking us for the season, and now we're missing the agent of Smokywood Pastures that we sent out to the field to find it!  Please - the shipment was last reported in the Alterac Mountains, and that's where our man went to look for it.$B$BSee if both are out there, safe and sound!
79482.objectivesText: Locate the Smokywood Pastures investigator that has gone missing in the snowy regions of the Alterac Mountains.
79482.title: Stolen Winter Veil Treats

79483.description: Listen... not to shatter the magic of the season here, but Smokywood Pastures could use some assistance - the kind you adventuring types are known to give.$B$BWe're missing an important shipment of treats that was restocking us for the season, and now we're missing the agent of Smokywood Pastures that we sent out to the field to find it!  Please - the shipment was last reported in the Alterac Mountains, and that's where our man went to look for it.$B$BSee if both are out there, safe and sound!
79483.objectivesText: Locate the Smokywood Pastures investigator that has gone missing in the snowy regions of the Alterac Mountains.
79483.title: Stolen Winter Veil Treats

79492.description: DISASTER has struck!  Metzen the Reindeer has been kidnapped!$B$BMetzen is one of Greatfather Winter's eight reindeer - and property of Smokywood Pastures.  We've received not one but TWO ransom letters from groups claiming to have Metzen.  With the holiday season well under way, we're strapped to the coin box here!  Please - find Metzen and return him to us!$B$BCheck out the ransom letters for clues, and sprinkle this reindeer dust on him - it will free him from any of his bonds!$B$BPlease, hurry!

objectives.text: Find Metzen the Reindeer and rescue him

79492.objectivesText: Find Metzen the Reindeer.  Use the notes provided to you for clues as to where he is being held.$B$BWhen you find Metzen, have the Pouch of Reindeer Dust in your possession so you can sprinkle some of the dust on him; this should free Metzen from his bonds of captivity.$B$BReturn the Pouch of Reindeer Dust to Wulmort Jinglepocket in Ironforge once Metzen is freed.
79492.title: Metzen the Reindeer

79677.description:
Other ogres laugh at Skonk because Skonk smaller than them. They say small ogre weak, so Skonk learn to cook instead of fight. This only cause more teasing, so Skonk run away to follow dream.

Skonk can make dish, but need ingredients. You take note. Find ingredients. Skonk more focused on craft; not really logistics guy.
79677.objectivesText: Gather the ingredients for Skonk's dish, then bring them to him in Arathi Highlands
79677.title: A Quick Grocery Run

79678.description:
Ok $r buddy, it time for Skonk favorite part. Skonk have fire hot and ready, and want to share new dish with new friend. You do such big favors for Skonk; it only right you get some too!

Let Skonk know when you ready for tasting.
79678.objectivesText: Taste test the recipe with Skonk.
79678.title: Taste Testing

79940.description:
<Katherine winces as she holds the shattered fragments of the broken hammer> 

I won't speak of this weapon's master in detail for the telling would fill me with shame, but I'll tell you what I can.

objectives.text: Speak with Katherine and Learn More

79940.objectivesText: Speak with Katherine the Pure and learn more about the broken hammer.
79940.title: A Lost Brother

79945.description:
This appears to be orders from the Grand Crusader of the Scarlet Crusade himself, Dathrohan. It seems that Aeonas has run afoul of the Crusade. Judging by the scene before you, it appears that the Crusade was able to follow Aeonas here and apprehend him. It appears that he did not go down without a fight.

The charges levied against Aeonas are grave, but that would explain some of the scene you came upon in Desolace.

objectives.text: Report back to Katherine the Pure

79945.objectivesText: Bring the Orders from the Grand Crusader back to Katherine the Pure.
79945.title: Orders from the Grand Crusader

79949.title: A Web of Lies: Debunking Myths and Legends

79963.description: <Aeonas needs immediate healing or he will die. Call upon the light and save him.>
79963.title: By The Light's Grace

79974.description:
"Always like to keep a reserve stash nearby in the off chance I've got to flee in a hurry.

The face of this mountainside is so beautiful you might say it was carved from the waterfalls of time. 
That's the eagles nest, that's what you're looking for."
79974.objectivesText: Dusting off a messenger bag emerging from the soil, you find a parchment nestled among the supplies.
79974.title: Wet Job

79975.description:
<You find a carefully folded letter inside of the toolbox.>

"From here, with the right tools, you call the shots. Great place to launch a parachute glider.

My loyalty to the Eagle and Fist requires distance in order to serve them best. This barricade has had better days, like the Old Kingdoms it once defended, but I'll never abandon it."
79975.objectivesText: Water spray dampens the air, the view is incredible.
79975.title: Eagle's Fist

79976.description:
"So, I've decided to take my work back underground. To stop it falling into the wrong hands."

<The paper is torn just large enough to fit the message. You aren't sure if these are the last words you'll read from the author, or if they're a clue to the next hideout. An inadequately secured sleeping bag is unrolling itself onto your feet...>
79976.objectivesText: Whoever was here, you just missed them.
79976.title: This Must Be The Place

79980.description: "Not so bad, eh? Since you're reading this, it means my stash is still there. Take a hundred paces due north and don't break your ankles going down the steep cliffside. There should be enough to keep you going."
79980.title: Scramble

81570.description: I have cutting to do.  I can't tell you what I'm going to cut, but... I need myself a blade.  A certain blade...$B$BSome people call it a moonsteel broadsword.  I call it a swing blade.$B$BYou help me?  Maybe you find it in town, maybe you talk to a blacksmith and he'll make it special.$B$BBut don't sleep on this.  What I'm cutting won't keep forever...
81570.objectivesText: Bring a Moonsteel Broadsword to Jarl in Dustwallow Marsh.
81570.title: Jarl Needs a Blade

81730.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion in the Rotting Orchard. Defeat worgen there and return to me.
81730.objectivesText: Defeat 10 Nightmare Runners and 10 Nightmare Weavers in the Duskwood Nightmare Incursion in the Rotting Orchard and return to Field Captain Palandar.
81730.title: Duskwood Mission I: Defeat Worgen

81734.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Rotting Orchard. Retrieve an intelligence report from Dreamwarden Dorilar there and return to me.
81734.objectivesText: Gather intelligence from Dreamwarden Dorilar in the Duskwood Nightmare Incursion in the barn at the Rotting Orchard and return to Field Captain Palandar.
81734.title: Duskwood Mission V: Worgen Intelligence

81736.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Rotting Orchard. Retrieve a powerful artifact known as the Shadowscythe and deliver it to me.
81736.objectivesText: Recover the Shadowscythe in the Duskwood Nightmare Incursion upstairs in the farmhouse at the Rotting Orchard and return to Field Captain Palandar.
81736.title: Duskwood Mission VII: Recover Shadowscythe

81737.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Vul'gol Ogre Mound. Retrieve an Ogre Magi Text and deliver it to me.
81737.objectivesText: Recover an Ogre Magi Text in the Duskwood Nightmare Incursion within the Vul'gol Ogre Mound and return to Field Captain Palandar.
81737.title: Duskwood Mission VIII: Recover Ogre Magi text

81738.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Yorgen Farmstead. Retrieve an Unhatched Green Dragon Egg and deliver it to me.
81738.objectivesText: Recover an Unhatched Green Dragon Egg in the Duskwood Nightmare Incursion from the Yorgen Farmstead near the large stump in the fields and return to Field Captain Palandar.
81738.title: Duskwood Mission IX: Recover Dragon Egg

81739.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove and collect Nightmare Moss from within the Nightmare Incursions. We can harness its magic to reverse the damage. You will need the assistance of an herbalist.
81739.objectivesText: Gather 10 Nightmare Moss in the Duskwood Nightmare Incursions and return to Field Captain Palandar.
81739.title: Duskwood Mission X: Nightmare Moss

81746.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Yorgen Darmstead. Find the sleeping Druid of the Claw Alara Grovemender there and escort her to safety. Then return to me.
81746.objectivesText: Rescue Alara Grovemender in the Duskwood Nightmare Incursion in the stable at the Yorgen Farmstead and return to Field Captain Palandar.
81746.title: Duskwood Mission XVII: Rescue Alara Grovemender

81762.description: Greetings, $n. I have good news. I've made contact with my friend, and I am leaving soon to meet with him. What's more, another orb has surfaced in Kalimdor.  I cannot be in two places at once so if you are willing, I'd like for you to go in my stead to follow up on this new orb. Speak with Katherine for further instructions.
81762.objectivesText: Speak with Katherine the Pure at the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind.
81762.title: Some Good News

81765.description: <The Paladin standing before you is not known to you. Speak with him to determine what he knows of the merchant and the current situation.>

objectives.text: Speak with Elrick and learn more

81765.objectivesText: Speak with Elrick to learn more.
81765.title: Elrick, Paladin of the Silver Hand

81790.description:
Each of the Echoing Orbs is attuned to a different aspect of its master. The method you used in Ashenvale to destroy the Althalaxx Orb will not be effective on the orb we possess. I know of a ritual that may be able to destabilize the orb and allow us to destroy it, but it requires components with specific magical significance. We already possess some of the required materials, but you'll need to retrieve the rest. 

Take this, it should help you in your search.
81790.objectivesText: Use the hints in Gregory's Note to determine where to find the magical components needed for the ritual. You will need help from allies for this.
81790.title: Materials of Significance

81900.description:
<The carving before you depicts a two-headed beast emerging from the Dark Portal. Fel-fire spews forth from its mouths. A plaque beneath the image reads: "Calefactus the Unleashed". 

Intuition tells you the Twilight cultists may have plans to harness this creature's destructive power for their own aims.

You reason that the next step in your hunt is towards the Blasted Lands. Someone there may know more of this hellish beast.>
81900.objectivesText: Find an expert on the beasts of the Blasted Lands.
81900.title: The Burning Beast

81917.description:
I have seen this creature you call "Calefactus" many times in my field studies. By all accounts, it appears to be a nigh-invulnerable core hound made from Fel energies.

However, if what you say is true, and the Twilight's Hammer were planning to enslave it, then there may be a way to subdue the beast.

The Shadowsworn, to the south-east, are known to perform dark rituals, including the enslavement of Fel creatures. Perhaps members of their order carry a clue to weakening Calefactus?
81917.objectivesText: Bring 5 infernal chain links to Bloodmage Lynnore in the Blasted Lands
81917.title: Chains That Bind

84135.description: Lying on the shore, half-lost in the afternoon spray, is a strange metal contraption. It looks like some kind of mech, but you have never seen anything like it before. You notice a label on its side that reads "Property of D.E.L.T.A.: Deepsea Exploration and Liquefaction Technologies Alliance". You also spot a small compartment that you might be able to open.
84135.objectivesText: Use a rock or something to dislodge parts of the mech.
84135.title: Beach Bot

84137.description: You wonder why this mech was crashed here, and what this liquid is for. Maybe you can use it to reach the nearby islands and oil rig that seem to be connected to this mysterious organization. Opening the vial, a mildly intoxicating fruity aroma greets your nose.
84137.objectivesText: Find a use for the Guided Buoyancy Accelerant
84137.title: Mechanical Romance

84138.description:
I'm the chief engineer, founder and lead researcher of the Deepsea Exploration and Liquefaction Technologies Alliance. I've nearly finished my latest experiment, and I need your help! I am working on a special device to geolocate resource-rich dimensions.

To complete my construction, I need something back: a book of arcane formulas that I lent to an old colleague of mine, Nami, who continues her work in Winterspring.

Retrieve the book for me and you'll be included as a published contributor!
84138.objectivesText: Explain the book situation to Doctor Jurgens' colleague, Nami, in Winterspring.
84138.title: Frosty Favors

84147.description: Well met, $c.  I've something that might interest you.$B$BI have in my possession a set of armor much like the one worn by those of your profession, but of much higher quality.  I'd be willing to trade the bracers for ordinary ones in exchange for a small favor.$B$BThe blood of the frostsabers and bears that inhabit Winterspring has properties I'm in need of at the moment.  Bring me a sizeable sample of it along with the bracers and a small amount of gold.  You shall find the effort worth your while.
84147.objectivesText: Acquire 15 Winterspring Blood Samples and 20 gold and bring them along with a set of Wildheart Bracers to Deliana in Ironforge.
84147.title: An Earnest Proposition

Yet I'm willing to wager you haven't seen a piece of armor like this.$B$BPerform a small favor for me and I'll be willing to trade it to you for an ordinary set of bracers.$B$BI'm in need of a sizeable sample of venom drawn from the spiders and scorpions that inhabit Silithus.  Bring this to me along with a few gold coins and I'll perform the exchange.
84156.objectivesText: Acquire 15 Silithus Venom Samples and 20 gold and bring them along with a set of Beaststalker's Bindings to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.
84156.title: An Earnest Proposition

84161.title: An Earnest Proposition

84166.description: You kept your word and brought the device built by Mux.  I believe a reward is in order if I'm to keep you interested in saving my skin.  Bring me the belt and set of gauntlets that you wish to upgrade.  I promise the ones I give you in return will be far superior.
84166.objectivesText: Bring a Lightforge Belt and a set of Lightforge Gauntlets to Deliana in Ironforge.
84166.title: Just Compensation

84170.description: You kept your word and brought the device built by Mux.  I believe a reward is in order if I'm to keep you interested in saving my skin.  Bring me the belt and set of gauntlets that you wish to upgrade.  I promise the ones I give you in return will be far superior.
84170.objectivesText: Bring a Belt of Valor and a set of Gauntlets of Valor to Deliana in Ironforge.
84170.title: Just Compensation

84172.description: You've proven to be a very reliable individual, $n.  As much as I trust that you'll help me through this predicament, it would be wise of me to reward you according to your performance.$B$BFor now I will exchange your belt and gloves.  If we both see this through I shall make the rest of the pieces available to you.
84172.objectivesText: Bring a Beaststalker's Belt and a set of Beaststalker's Gloves to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.
84172.title: Just Compensation

84173.description: You've proven to be a very reliable individual, $n.  As much as I trust that you'll help me through this predicament, it would be wise of me to reward you according to your performance.$B$BFor now I will exchange your belt and gloves.  If we both see this through I shall make the rest of the pieces available to you.
84173.objectivesText: Bring a Magister's Belt and a set of Magister's Gloves to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.
84173.title: Just Compensation

84179.description: Valthalak's soul was stored in this amulet.  In our greed we foolishly split it into three parts, not knowing the curse that would await us.$B$BThe only way to stop Valthalak's spell is to put the medallion back together.  Return to Deliana and tell her that Bodley is her only hope for finding the remaining pieces.  Speak to her about any rewards you've arranged for.$B$BI, for once, shall rest in peace.  I wish you the best of luck; you shall need every bit of it!
84179.objectivesText: Return to Deliana in Ironforge with a set of Wildheart Boots, a Wildheart Kilt and Wildheart Spaulders.
84179.title: Anthion's Parting Words

84192.title: Anthion's Parting Words

84202.description: That's an amazing story, $n! You have my thanks, and the heartfelt gratitude of all who were involved. Now maybe I'll be able to sleep at night with both eyes shut.$B$BAs to your reward, I believe I have a few things that you'll really enjoy.
84202.objectivesText: Give Deliana your Helm of Valor and Breastplate of Valor.
84202.title: Saving the Best for Last

84210.description: A truly amazing story, $n! You have my thanks, and the heartfelt gratitude of all who were involved, I can assure you. Through your efforts we are delivered from the mistakes of our past.$B$BAs to your reward, I believe I have a few things that you have definitely earned and will truly enjoy.
84210.objectivesText: Give Mokvar your Helm of Valor and Breastplate of Valor.
84210.title: Saving the Best for Last

84212.description: Nami hands over Jurgens' book. With it safely stowed, you begin the long journey back to the other side of the world.
84212.objectivesText: Return to the D.E.L.T.A lab with the book Jurgens was looking for.
84212.title: Bookin' it Back

84213.description:
Join me in this historic experiment and witness the wonders of my invention! I've calculated two locations with suitable geothermic bioflux energy. With manual-auto-locking phasers, I'm ready to send us to the coordinates within compatible regions.

Once you're at compatible coordinates, use this remote transponder to send the signal to me. I'll configure the warp transmitter to fold the space between here, and there.

What I'm saying is, I'll meet you there when you say you're ready!
84213.objectivesText:
Use the Distant Communication Device to send the signal to Jurgens at either Tirisfal Glades or Westfall
Then, assist him in demonstrating the capabilities of his elecro transmitter.
84213.title: Rift Away

84414.description:
<You hear the disembodied voice of Orthas in your mind>

'Ere we are then. Let's get on with it, shall we?

objectives.text: Send Orthas' Spirit On His Way

84414.objectivesText: Observe Orthas as he moves on from this world.
84414.title: Send Me On Me Way

86585.description:
The fallen mountaineer bears a standard of Ironforge. Perhaps she was scouting, or making a doomed charge. Either way, the standard has been cast down and trampled. The mountaineer was hit on the head so hard that her helm was knocked off and she was killed outright by a trogg, likely with a spiked club.

The trogg that killed her is probably still nearby, and likely remembers the banner. Raising the banner of Ironforge once more may call it out.
86585.objectivesText: Raise the standard of Ironforge, call out the trogg Headsplitter and kill it, then report to Captain Rugelfuss.
86585.title: Banner of the Fallen

86613.description: The excavation's tools, left behind when the dwarves fled from the troggs, seem mostly untouched. Returning them to the excavators will surely aid their work.
86613.objectivesText: Return $1oa Excavation Tools to Magmar Fellhew.
86613.title: Excavation Tools
