86614.description: <Among the fishing knickknacks in the debris are some rusty hooks, broken spools of wire, and a slightly corroded but ornate silver hair clip with the monogram "K.D.">
86614.objectivesText: Return the Monogrammed Silver Hair clip to its owner.
86614.title: Silver of the Waves

86615.description:
Ach! Here I am serving as ambassador to the Wildhammers, and I left me satchel of the latest diplomatic missives somewhere in Wildhammer Keep. I must've left it in the tavern... or maybe I misplaced it by the steam tanks... or was it upstairs? I can never keep track!

I need those papers! If you have a better eye for the keep than I do, see if you can spot my missing diplomatic satchel!
86615.objectivesText: Find Ambassador Redstone's missing diplomatic satchel in Wildhammer Keep.
86615.title: Treaty Obligations

86667.description:
My old mentor, Norric, sent a minor elemental with an odd request. He needs a jar of snow for some of his shamanic workings! I don't know what he's going to do with that, but I learned a long time ago not to question his ways with respect to magic.

I'm busy learning about the local elementals, so I can't leave to help him. Go to the tunnel entrance at South Gate Pass where there's snow year-round. Scoop some up in this ceramic jar and bring it to him before it melts. The jar should keep it cold.
86667.objectivesText: Deliver a Jar of Snow to Norric Lochthane at his house on the northwest coast of the Loch.
86667.title: Snowbound

86746.description:
My people are struggling, $n. 

The Legashi satyr have invaded our den, corrupting many of the Blackmaw and separating us from our Timbermaw allies. Those of us who survive their attacks are huddled in makeshift camps. Worse still, the satyr's corruption is spreading across the land, and poses a threat to my already vulnerable tribe.

The Legashi lurk among the ruins northeast of here. I must ask you for help in defeating them.
86746.objectivesText: Kill $1oa Legashi Satyr, $2oa Legashi Rogues, and $3oa Legashi Hellcallers for Ekkal at the Ruins of Eldarth.
86746.title: The Legashi Threat

86757.description:
Orcs have taken over the eastern forest, and their scouts and grunts now lurk throughout the woods! It's not safe for our kind to move about Ashenvale any more.

We need to push back the orcs and secure the forest. We've been able to pick off some of the grunts and scouts by carefully sneaking around the edges of their camp.

Fight the orcs and bring me the jagged swords and curved knives that they use. I'll make sure their weapons are salvaged and repurposed, so nothing goes to waste.
86757.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Jagged Orc Swords and $2oa Curved Orc Daggers to Shandrina.
86757.title: Slowing the Orc Advance

86758.description:
Did I ever tell you how I almost lost me hand to a crocolisk? Managed to jam me knife into its jaw, and scrambled out real quick. I thought I had the knife around here somewhere, but I can't seem to find it.

Anyway, that croc is probably still out there hunting along the edge of the lake. That nasty brute probably needs to go, for the safety of the other hunters, if nothing else.

I've taken to calling it Daggerfang. If you see it, give it a friendly hello from me! And by "hello" I mean "stab."
86758.objectivesText: Find and defeat the crocolisk Daggerfang and bring back Marek's knife.
86758.title: Twisting the Knife

86776.description:
Thelsamar's a great place to live, but we don't have all of the amenities of Ironforge. I'm always running out of bronze! I need more bronze if I'm going to keep making tools and kettles and pots!

I can tell you have a little experience at the forge. Think you could smelt me some bronze bars? I can pay you well for it!
86776.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Bronze Bars to Morhan Coppertongue.
86776.title: Ingredients for the Forge

86784.description:
My associate Eleanor Shackleton prides herself on traveling the wilds, surviving against weather and monsters. She is currently camped not far from here, in the hills to the west, and I remember a piece of advice that she once gave me: "When you think you have enough firewood, gather five times more."

If you have some spare time, you could collect some wood in this basket and take it to her camp. I'm sure she could give you a few tips about the existence of a traveling adventurer.
86784.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Dry Branches and bring them to Eleanor Shackleton.
86784.title: Sticks and Bones

86792.description:
The satyr within the Legashi stronghold are even more fearsome than those of the outer camps. When our party was discovered, we found ourselves overwhelmed.

One of us was slain, and another captured. I was the only one able to successfully retreat. I cannot return to Rageroar with my head hung in shame, but I cannot fight the Legashi alone, either.

I ask you, then, to assist me in weakening the satyr's forces. Go into their stronghold and slay them.
86792.objectivesText: Kill $1oa Legashi Hellraisers, $2oa Legashi Soulstealers, and $3oa Legashi Blackguards for Korsa outside Legashi Stronghold.
86792.title: Thinning Their Forces

86796.areaDescription: Help Graal break out of Legashi Stronghold
86796.description:
You there, $r!

These fiends ambushed my scouting party, and have taken me captive. I don't know what plans they have for me, but I don't intend to find out. I must escape and return to Ursolan; no doubt Korsa is worried about me.

While I would love to break out of this cage and leave a trail of satyr corpses in my wake, I'm afraid I'm slightly outnumbered.

Perhaps you share my hatred for the fiends, and would help me escape?
86796.objectivesText: Help Graal break out of Legashi Stronghold, then inform Korsa outside Legashi Stronghold.
86796.title: Later, Satyr

86799.description:
<Furze lets loose an ugly, hacking, cough.>

Hear me, $r, I haven't much strength to speak. I am stricken by an illness unlike any I have ever known. It is as if my blood itself is aflame, and my very essence is coming undone. I can hardly move, much less fetch help.

Please, go find Elder Bramblesnap. Her tent is just northwest of here. She will know what to do.
86799.objectivesText: Speak to Elder Bramblesnap about Furze's illness.
86799.title: Encroaching Corruption

86804.description:
Furze is not the first with his affliction. Since the Legashi's attacks against us began, many Blackmaw have presented with a similar illness. Each one eventually fell to corruption, becoming mindless and destructive.

I have been working towards a cure. My studies indicate that one could possibly be made by transmuting the Legashi's own firewater, but I cannot acquire it myself.

You might find firewater, or a way to brew it, in the Legashi camps to the east. You would be a great help in doing so.
86804.objectivesText: Find a way to get Legashi Firewater in the Legashi Encampment.
86804.title: An Unlikely Source

86927.description:
As the satyrweed and fel mote splash into the boiling liquid, a plume of noxious gas emerges.

Best to hold your nose, quickly grab a sample, and bring it back to Elder Bramblesnap.
86927.objectivesText: Bring the Legashi Firewater to Elder Bramblesnap at Ursolan.
86927.title: Running Firewater

87295.description:
You may have seen the Redstone basilisks wandering the wastes outside while you were on your way to Nethergarde Keep. They're tough creatures, well adapted to survival in the Blasted Lands. One of their key qualities is their sturdy scales, which reflect heat, protect against sand and wind, and even deflect weapon blows!

They're a perfect material for making shields, and if you can bring me a bundle, I'll compensate you well. Only bring ones in good condition!
87295.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Redstone Basilisk Scales to Bernie Heisten.
87295.title: Deflective Surface

87346.description:
When the Legashi overran the Blackmaw, the rest of the Timbermaw sealed their passage to the hold to keep out the satyr. We had no idea they lived on as refugees.

I would gladly aid my brethren, but we are fighting our own battles. Like the Legashi threaten the Blackmaw, the Deadwood do likewise to us. We haven't many warriors to spare.

The Deadwood chieftain, Bloodmaw, is in Felpaw Village to the south. Eliminating him would greatly ease our struggle. Bring me his mace, and you will have our aid.
87346.objectivesText: Kill Chieftain Bloodmaw and bring his mace to Gorn One Eye in Timbermaw Hold.
87346.title: Chieftain Bloodmaw

87760.description:
I have received word back from Darnassus, $n!

From the animal samples, we learned that the naga dominated these sea creatures to use as unwilling mounts and beasts of burden. The ones that were too obstinate, or too old or badly injured, they drove out for sport. Monstrous!

It is our sacred duty to put a stop to this!

The naga have forces in the Ruins of Mathystra, and they must be seizing threshers from off the shore. Find their beastmistress, slay her, and bring back her tools of domination!
87760.objectivesText: Find a Stormscale Beastmistress, slay her, and bring back her Rod of Deep Dominion.
87760.title: Holy Diver

88807.description:
Azshara may appear beautiful, but it is a cursed place. There are horrors deep beneath its waters, waiting to emerge and tear the world asunder.

All we can do for now is fight the horrors that have already surfaced.

The Spitelash Naga occupy the Ruins of Eldarath to the north east. The ones within the ruins are well-fortified, so we must pick off the weaker ones along the outskirts first.

As you can see, we could always use another fighter here, if you are up to the task.
88807.objectivesText: Kill 8 Spitelash Warriors and 8 Spitelash Screamers for Commander Truesong in Azshara.
88807.title: Slay the Spitelash

88821.description:
While scouting along the cliffs of the Shattered Strand, one of our sentinels noticed a kaldorei woman on the beach.

Clearly, she is not with our expedition, and she did not have the makings of a fighter. I wonder then, what she could be doing in such a hostile place as this.

If you can, try to make contact with her. I would like to know her purpose for being here, and if our interests are perhaps aligned.

She was last seen on the eastern coast, along the north side of the Bay of Storms.
88821.objectivesText: Find the Kaldorei woman last seen on the Shattered Strand.
88821.title: Making Contact

88884.description:
Just south of here, along the beach, there are some tablets of highborne writing. They document the highborne's investigations into the laws and powers of the arcane. 

The tablets are being kept in pagoda-like structures, guarded by naga, so I wouldn't dare attempt to procure them myself.

Fortunately, I've found myself a new assistant! 

So, what do you say? Think you could be of further use in the pursuit of knowledge?
88884.objectivesText: Find the three highborne tablets among the ruins of Southridge Beach, then bring them to Saria Fairmoon in Azshara.
88884.title: Highborne Tablets

88917.description:
I came here in search of highborne artifacts. You could call me an archaeologist of sorts.

The ruins of Eldarath to the west hold many of them, although the naga are looting the ruins as we speak.

A naga called Lady Sesspira leads the pillaging; no doubt keeping the best finds for herself. 

If my research is correct, I believe she may be in possession of the staff of Archmage Selwyn, a fallen highborne mage.

I need your help to get that staff, $r. Scholars like me are ill-suited for combat.
88917.objectivesText: Find the Staff of Archmage Selwyn among the Ruins of Eldarath, and bring it to Saria Fairmoon in Azshara.
88917.title: Slithering Looters

89015.description:
If ye fancy yourself a real angler, there's bigger fish out here than ye can catch with a rod.

Mammoth Sharks lurk in the deepest waters of the northern an' southern coasts. They swim far out, right before the sea floor drops away into the great ocean.

They're mighty big; I'd advise ye take a group of anglers with ye. 

Dwarf like me? I prefer dry land. Those sharks'd swallow me in one bite.

If ye do go hunting one, bring me a cut o' the meat. I'd be mighty thankful.
89015.objectivesText: Bring a Mammoth Shark Steak to Berdun Cliffbrew at Talrendis Point in Azshara.
89015.title: Deadliest Catch

89037.description:
On the beaches of the northern peninsula, east of here, I came upon the Tower of Eldara. While surveying the site, I noticed a large orange murloc wielding a spiked club, and carrying a peculiar glowing crystal. Given the location, it was likely the kind that the highborne used to store their history and memories.

We must recover that crystal, $r. Who knows what secrets it could contain?

The best route to the tower is along the cliffs, with the nearest way up being just west of here.
89037.objectivesText: Take the Memory Crystal from Razorgill near the Tower of Eldara, and bring it to Saria Fairmoon in Azshara.
89037.title: Murloc Thieves

89038.description:
It is said that Queen Azshara once bestowed a gift upon the kaldorei of House Ravencrest; an emblem of great beauty and magical power. This mark was given as recognition of the Ravencrests' unwavering loyalty to the queen. 

The mark was last seen near the Ravencrest Monument, atop the cliffs of the southern peninsula. Securing such a relic would be the discovery of a lifetime.

As always, the ruins of the monument are crawling with Spitelash, but I trust you're rather adept at handling them by now.
89038.objectivesText: Search for the Mark of the Queen among the ruins of the Ravencrest Monument, and bring it to Saria Fairmoon in Azshara.
89038.title: A Monumental Task

89053.description:
I know you were initially sent here on reconnaissance, $n, but you've done a great deal for the field of archaeology.

Surely, after all of your toil, you'd like to know what fruits my studies will come to bear.

To that end, before you return to your camp, I'd like to show you something. Would you oblige me?

objectives.text: See what Saria has to show you

89053.objectivesText: See what Saria has to show you.
89053.title: Your Final Reward

90487.description:
$n, I have little more to offer. If you mean to make the long trek up the mountain, you might do well to speak with some of its ancient caretakers.

Follow the road to the west. Look north, toward the foot of the mountain. You will eventually see an outpost, a remnant of the guardians that once roamed the slopes. There is an ancient there named Fraxinus. He and his friends can assist you.
90487.objectivesText: Travel west from the hermit's cave to find an outpost of ancients and dryads on the lower slopes of Mount Hyjal.
90487.title: Ancient Allies

90789.description: There isn't much time, $n!  My scrying spells have revealed a powerful source of magic.  I cannot leave the tower, and would ask you to kill the vile creature in possession of this artifact.$b$bThe beast is known as Scalebeard, hiding in a cave among the Bay of Storms. Burn him to ashes and take the prismatic shell from his den.
90789.objectivesText: Retrieve the Prismatic Shell for Archmage Xylem.  The Archmage resides in a tower atop the cliffs of Azshara.
90789.title: Scalebeard

90854.description:
Livin' out in da wild for five years done take a toll on our supplies. We had to make dis place from scratch! We could use your skills as a leatherworker.

I need to repair some of da tents and buildings, and patch up some armor. You bring me a pair of Rugged Armor Kits and a Cured Rugged Hide, I help you turn it into something special.
90854.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Rugged Armor Kits and $2oa Cured Rugged Hide to Zet'gan in Elderwild on Mount Hyjal.
90854.title: Leather for Inclement Weather

90902.description:
I am proud to welcome another newly risen paladin to our ranks. As you begin to reconnect with the light you may notice that certain abilities that were once second nature to you may cause you considerable pain to use now, particularly those involving channeling the light to heal yourself or others. 

The only way around this problem is--unfortunately--to go through it. Like any other muscle that has atrophied, you must push through the pain and exercise the flesh for it to return to full function.
90902.objectivesText: Heal $1oa Injured Deathguard with your Holy Light ability.
90902.title: Rediscovering the Light

91208.description:
Not all of our fellow Paladins who rise again are quick to acclimate to our new reality. Some struggle to reconcile that they are now, in a way, the very thing they spent their lives fighting against.

These individuals often simply need a kind gesture and a sympathetic ear. Unfortunately, many others are quick to turn violent. Find the frightened paladin who fled into the hills directly west of this chapel. Extend a hand in friendship. Lead them back into the light if you can.

objectives.text: Offer aid to the Frightened Paladin

91208.objectivesText: Find the Frightened Paladin in Deathknell.
91208.title: Coming to Terms

91209.description:
Lordaeron may not be what it used to be, but our home still needs protection from all manner of threats and it's time for you to go out and face the world. Your next stop should be the town of Brill in central Tirisfal Glades. Go and meet with Shari Stilwell there. She can see to your continued training. 

One last bit of advice before you go--take extra care as a paladin traveling through Forsaken lands. There are many in the Dark Lady's service who distrust us and our proximity to the light.

objectives.text: Report to Shari Stilwell in Brill

91209.objectivesText: Follow the road east out of Deathknell to find the town of Brill. Report to Shari Stilwell to continue your training.
91209.title: Continue Your Training

91282.description:
It is encouraging to see my newly risen brothers and sisters thrive as you have. It is only through community and shared faith that we can truly realize our full potential however, and to that end we've begun to form a new paladin order right here in Tirisfal. 

If you wish to learn more, you should visit our monastery on the edge of the Whispering Woods. It is called Bandarion Keep. It's on the bluffs just northwest of the Solliden Farmstead, and should be hard to miss.
91282.objectivesText: Find the fortress of Bandarion Keep and report to Breton Samuels there.
91282.title: A Second Home

91285.description:
Normally we'd show our newcomers a bit more hospitality, but we've got a bit of a murloc problem at the moment.

A tribe of murlocs used to use the keep as their spawning grounds. They've been a problem since we moved in and kicked them out, but now it's starting to get out of hand. You look like you've seen some action. Do you think you could help us drive back some of these pests? You'll find them lurking in the bluffs along the road to the east, and in the camps around the lake to the west.
91285.objectivesText: Slay $1oa Vile Fin Attackers and $2oa Vile Fin Seers and report back to Breton Samuels when it is done.
91285.title: Murlocs at the Gates

91294.description:
Now that the immediate threat of the murloc attacks is under control, I'd encourage you to show yourself around our stronghold. It isn't much yet, but it's home.

When you are done exploring, seek out Danitha Morr, our leader. She can help you get settled in.

I'm very glad to have met you, $n. May the light be your guide.
91294.objectivesText: Speak to the residents of Bandarion Keep.
91294.title: Touring the Grounds

91316.description:
This far from the Undercity, logistics are challenging and we have a dire shortage of building materials needed to help restore this fortress. I'd like your help with that.

The ruined village of Shadowvale can be found in the Whispering Forest, just southwest of here. One of the buildings has an old root cellar used to store all sorts of things. There are likely to be usable materials down there. Scavenge what you can and return to us.
91316.objectivesText: Collect 12 pieces of Sturdy Lumber from Shadowvale in Tirisfal Glades.
91316.title: Making Repairs

91317.description:
Not all risen paladins have acclimated well to our new existence, as you may have seen yourself already. Some have carried forward their prejudices from life, and continue to visit violence upon their fellow Forsaken.

As it stands we are mistrusted by our people who remember well the persecution inflicted by the living in the name of the light, and these attacks do not help. A number of these tarnished have taken up residence at Shadowvale to the southwest. End them and bring me their leader's head.
91317.objectivesText: Slay 8 Tarnished Drudges, 6 Tarnished Zealots, and collect the head of Commander Rudolph Gelhardt in Tirisfal Glades.
91317.title: The Tarnished

91488.description:
During our last skirmish with the blood elves, my tent was badly damaged. For three nights, I have been at the mercy of the elements.

It can be repaired with a few mosshoof hides, but a lack of sleep has left me unable to hunt them myself.

The easiest mosshooves to hunt are west and south of here, but the hide of any mooshoof will do.
91488.objectivesText: Bring 5 Mosshoof Hides to Kurll at Valormok in Azshara.
91488.title: Home on the Range

91500.description:
<Seeing how the energies of the crystals are attuned to the seals, you reason that destroying a seal, thereby releasing its energy all at once, could cause its crystal to do the same.

The explosive results would certainly draw Rimtori's ire. It would also present the perfect opportunity to attack her while she's flustered.>
91500.objectivesText: Break the Seals of the Sin'dorei, then bring Magus Rimtori's head to Ag'tor Bloodfist in Valormok.
91500.title: An Explosive Gambit

91568.description:
What the beaches here lack in looks, they make up for in value!

Most of the ruins here have been picked clean, but there's some serious loot under that sand. Problem is, it's all scattered, and the naga make a long search a bit impractical. So, what's a girl to do?

Enter the Treasure Trowel 3000! The all-in-one treasure detecting shovel! A personal invention of mine.

Take this baby down to the eastern shore, and bring back whatever you find. Then, we can split the profits!
91568.objectivesText: Dig up $1oa Highborne Treasure Fragments with the Treasure Trowel 3000 for Izvi Glidfizz in Valormok.
91568.title: Long Walks on the Beach

91569.description:
Listen kid, everyone out here's scramblin' for the same thing. Belgrom, the elves, the naga, they all wanna piece 'a that ancient highborne magic.

Me? Couldn't care less, but I know a seller's market when I see one.

I've seen blood elf arcanists carrying special wands. They're used to extract magical energy from artifacts the elves find. The arcanists stay at a camp east of the elves' base camp, along the cliffs. Get me one of those wands and I'll put you on to the score of a lifetime!
91569.objectivesText: Bring a Mana-Siphoning Wand to Izvi Gildfizz at Valormok.
91569.title: Blue Gold

91607.description: <The large hunk of crystal is even heavier than it looks. While it appears to be quite the prize, its true nature is unknown to you. Someone with an eye for valuables could say what you've really found.>
91607.objectivesText: Find someone to appraise the Humongous Crystal.
91607.title: Pay Dirt!

91685.description:
When we first got here, I did some surveying for any untapped resources. Y'know, typical prospector stuff.

I didn't see nothin' special 'til I searched Lake Mennar, to the south. There, I saw a huge rift floating above the water's surface. I couldn't get close, but I think it was an open leyline.

If I'm right, we can use this wand to siphon magic straight from the source! Bottle that up, sell it to the highest bidder, and bam! I'm rich!

If you go and siphon that rift for me, I'll cut you in.
91685.objectivesText: Use the Mana-Siphoning Wand on the Leyline Rift in Lake Mennar and bring the Tear of Mennar to Izvi Gildfizz.
91685.title: Ley of the Land

91696.areaDescription: Escort the Furbolg family out of Deadwood Den
91696.description:
Deadwood set on my pup and his sire. He stood fast, fought to the death as our guard. We must go home, but the way is dark and full of jaws.

Stay near, guard us well. I will lead, you will fend, and we will see den safe.
91696.objectivesText: Escort the Barkskin Matriarch out of Deadwood Den and return to Barkskin Burrow.
91696.title: Open Season

91697.description:
Thank you for helping gather bear berries. Small steps build trust! With the aroma of berry resin on you, the Elders should be more welcoming of you. 

Go and speak with Elder Mistpaw and Elder Pinespeaker.
91697.objectivesText: Find and speak with Elder Mistpaw and Elder Pinespeaker within Barkskin Burrow.
91697.title: Meet the Elders

91698.description:
<A matriarchal furbolg speaks to you from within the cage>

"Deadwood trap me and my cub in tough cage. Key hang on Deadwood Warden belt. You hunt them, take key, lift latch, set us free. Do this, and Barkskin know your heart true."
91698.objectivesText: Recover a Deadwood Key from a Deadwood Warden and return to the Barkskin Cage.
91698.title: Barkskin Breakout

91723.description:
Blast it! Every time I try to calibrate these sensitive arcane instruments, they get thrown off again by a surge of energy.
The surges seem to be coming from the north, where those primitive Kobolds have been practicing their crude magic. Could you clear some of them out, so I can continue my work?
91723.objectivesText: Kill 8 Kobold Geomancers in Jasperlode Mine, then return to Hamish Bergwort in the Tower of Azora.
91723.title: Delicate Instruments

91725.description:
I was sent by Master Theocritus to pick up some enchanting supplies from the trading post, but on the way back I was ambushed by a pack of gnolls!

I dropped the package and escaped, but if I return without it, I'll be cleaning up after the polymorph experiments for weeks as punishment! Do you think you could find the supplies for me?
91725.objectivesText: Collect 5 Stolen Enchanting Supplies from gnoll camps around Stone Cairn Lake, then return to Blixie Fitzwink near the Tower of Azora.
91725.title: Stolen Enchanting Supplies

91732.description: Good steel is in short supply after the war, and our tools have suffered for it. The Jasperlode miners used finely-crafted picks, and I imagine some of them are still there in the depths of the mine. Could you retrieve some for me, and I'll see if I can repurpose the steel?
91732.objectivesText: Collect 4 Mining Tools from Jasperlode Mine, then return to Hagar Lowe in Eastvale Logging Camp.
91732.title: Good Steel

91733.description:
I was bringing back a supply shipment from the trading post, but my wagon tipped over and the supplies fell in the river! Before I could catch them, they had already washed downstream.

Between the murlocs and wolves down there, I don't stand a chance of retrieving the supplies on my own. You seem like the hardy sort. Do you think you could find them for me?
91733.objectivesText: Collect the Waterlogged Axe, Waterlogged Saw, and Waterlogged Toolbox that have washed downstream from Eastvale Logging Camp, then return to Ormin Pelford.
91733.title: Downstream

91735.description:
Listen, $c, you'd best not be hangin' round here for long. But since you are, perhaps you can do a little favor for me?

I be expecting a certain something from a Jediga, in Azshara. She and some orcs be havin' a camp out there. Go and tell her Jes'rimon sent you, and I'll owe you one.
91735.title: Remote Contact

91740.description: This murloc has no doubt been terrorizing the local roads for some time. You suspect the nearby watch guards will want to know of its demise.
91740.objectivesText: Deliver Croaky's Head to Merell Ross at Ridgepoint Tower.
91740.title: Croaky's Head

91741.description:
<One of the kobolds dropped this book. It looks like the kobold might have tried to eat it.

Brother Paxton inside the abbey has a small library he maintains. The book must have come from there.>
91741.objectivesText: Return the book to Brother Paxton.
91741.title: Nibbled-On Book

91745.description: Go talk to the new mining apprentice, Kelsey Fargo. She works right outside the mine and has probably seen what the kobolds are up to. Maybe she can teach you a thing or two about mining while you're at it.
91745.objectivesText: Talk to Kelsey Fargo outside the Echo Ridge Mine in Northshire Valley.
91745.title: Mining Consultant

91746.description: The trophy serves as an impressive reminder of your victory over Elmpaw. A local hunter or skinner might be interested to hear the story.
91746.objectivesText: Deliver Elmpaw's Head to Helene Peltskinner near Goldshire.
91746.title: Elmpaw's Head

91751.description: Are you looking for an opportunity to practice skinning? My husband usually helps with hunting wolves, but he's busy up by the abbey. I could use a hand collecting more pelts to finish the orders I'm working on.
91751.objectivesText: Skin wolves around Elwynn Forest to obtain $1oa Rough Wolf Pelts, then deliver them to Helene Peltskinner near Goldshire.
91751.title: Rough Wolf Pelts

91753.description:
Academic rigor is of course essential to the enchanter's craft, but a practical foundation can pay dividends. Consider, as an example, the lowly Kobold. Lacking formal education, they nevertheless demonstrate a sort of innate aptitude for simple cantrips and enchantments.

Obtain some of their wax effigies and deconstruct the enchantments bound within them. You may find it elucidating.
91753.objectivesText:
Kitta Firewind in the Tower of Azora wants you to collect 3 Luminous Residue.

Luminous Residue can be obtained by disenchanting Crude Wax Effigies dropped by Kobold Geomancers.
91753.title: An Enchanting Lesson

91755.description:
Have you seen those nasty tainted shrubberies wandering around this valley?

Those plants are mean, but some of them are not entirely toxic. Their leaves can have medicinal purposes.

Would you be so kind as to fetch me some Verdant Leaves? You'll have to do a little pruning, of course.
91755.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Verdant Leaves from Tainted Shrubbery in the foothills of Mount Hyjal.
91755.title: Leaves to Ligatures

91775.description:
While you're investigating the Fargodeep Mine, see if you can find any of Brother Paxton's books to return. In particular, Paxton is very concerned about a book titled, "Fun with Elementals". He thinks even a kobold could use it to summon an elemental servant. Be warned, the depths of the mine are fairly dangerous. You should bring friends.

Take this book bag to protect the books when you find them!
91775.objectivesText: Find 6 Lost Books and "Fun with Elementals" and return them to Marshal Dughan.
91775.title: Book Return

91777.description:
There are just two books left missing on Brother Paxton's list: "Geomancy for Curious Young Wizards" and "Arcane Explainer: Magical Stuff in Simple Words".

The kobolds must have taken them to the Jasperlode Mine. Please track down those two books and bring them back to Brother Paxton.

But I'm afraid it will be quite dangerous. If the "apprentice" kobold was summoning an elemental, who knows what the master can do. I'd bring some friends if I were you.
91777.objectivesText: Recover "Geomancy for Curious Young Wizards" and "Arcane Explainer: Magical Stuff in Simple Words" and return them to Brother Paxton inside Northshire's Abbey.
91777.title: Rare Books

91794.description:
We been stuck up here for years, always fighting against de Scourge, but we never lose hope. We fight to survive. We fight for da Horde. Da Alliance shares dis fight, but we never forget dat we still got history. Still got blood.

Far to da east, at Dae'gun, dere are Horde flags from da war. Da demons carry scraps and remains as trophies from da battle, especially da tough ones. Bring me a flag and some heraldry so I can put it up and show da Alliance dat da Horde is still strong!
91794.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Horde Flag and $2oa Scraps of Horde Heraldry for Kal'tinzan at Elderwild.
91794.title: Flags of Our Forebears

91858.description:
A most unfortunate turn of events in Silverpine has presented a unique opportunity for us to prove our worth in the eyes of the horde.

A pair of dignitaries from the Earthen Ring went missing in Silverpine Forest en route to Tarren Mill. We don't know much else but rumors say that this is becoming quite the diplomatic incident. If we can recover these missing persons, it could help gain us the legitimacy we so dearly need.

We have a man at The Sepulcher, Trevan Rol. Travel there and speak with him.
91858.objectivesText: Travel to The Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest and speak with Trevan Rol about the missing Earthen Ring travelers.
91858.title: Diplomatic Incident

91859.description:
Cutting straight to it, these "dignitaries" are no ordinary diplomats. One was a Tauren. Ordinary enough for the Earthen Ring, but the other--and you'll scarcely believe this--was an elf. A *high* elf. They were cloaked, but I've seen quel'dorei before and I'd bet my good pinky finger that's what I saw.

Why was an elf accompanying a Tauren through horde territory? Well, your guess is as good as mine. That's as much as I know, so I'd suggest speaking with Deathguard Baldren near the entrance to town.
91859.objectivesText: Speak with Deathguard Baldren about the mysterious Earthen Ring travelers who recently passed through The Sepulcher.
91859.title: A Curious Pair

91860.description:
Out on patrol last night I spotted a group of gnolls dumping a very large body onto a pyre on the shores of Fenris Isle. I didn't see an elf or any smaller corpses, but I'd say this doesn't bode well for them.

If you are brave or stupid you are welcome to charge into Fenris Isle to learn more, but if you ask me, it's a lot of work to find some snooty elf that's probably long dead.

I know you paladins love swearing oaths and taking on lost causes, but this one isn't worth it. Trust me.
91860.objectivesText: Investigate Fenris Isle to the east and learn the fate of the Earthen Ring traveling party.
91860.title: A Grim Fate

91861.description: <The fact that you found only one body is a hopeful sign. Perhaps the High Elf that Trevan and Hadrec described is still alive somewhere deeper inside the nearby fortress?>
91861.objectivesText: Investigate Fenris Keep to the north and attempt to locate the missing member of the Earthen Ring party.
91861.title: Into Fenris Keep

91862.description:
Quel'dorei? No, I am no "quel'dorei". I am Lumina Windsinger and I am shen'dorei. One of the Windshaper Skyborne.

I came to these lands as a guest of the Earthen Ring. My companion Banon and I were passing through Silverpine to reach the Arathi Highlands so that we could study the elemental convergences there. Clearly, we didn't make it.

We have no time for this now though. Kill the gnolls nearby. Retrieve the key to this cage and free me. I will tell you the rest once we are safely away.
91862.objectivesText: Retrieve the Fenris Isle Key from the Rot Hide Gnolls and use it to free Lumina Windsinger.
91862.title: Lumina Windsinger

91877.description:
Not many demon hunters remain on Azeroth now, but a few of us continue to hunt the most dangerous or hidden threats.

A colleague of mine, Maerion Thaelemaches, headed to Hyjal to investigate rumors of demons there. While there are many demons in the dangerous Darkwhisper Gorge, there is suspicion that the demons that assaulted the mountain during the last war might not be completely defeated.

This bears investigation.
91877.objectivesText: Find Maerion Thaelemaches somewhere on Mount Hyjal.
91877.title: Demon Hunter's Hunter

91881.description:
With the warlocks under control, I'd say this area's well in wing.

<The crow nods sagely, looking pleased.>

Though our work here is done, there are other areas that could use your help and as an underwing of mine I would like you to go see what all the fuss is about.

Follow the path northwest up the road to the old tern outpost. An old friend awaits!
91881.objectivesText: Meet Sefira Everbright at the outpost.
91881.title: The Western Post

91882.description:
Years ago, the Horde and the Alliance put aside their differences to fight a greater threat--the Legion. On Mount Hyjal, the Grand Alliance forces battled Archimonde and his minions to a halt.

The retreat from the mountain was perilous, however, and some brave fighters were left behind.

Now that the way up the great mountain is again open, perhaps some of these heroes remain alive in the wilds? Go to Mount Hyjal and brave its dangers. Find what became of our forces there.
91882.objectivesText: Search Mount Hyjal for remnants of the Grand Alliance.
91882.title: The Grand Alliance

91920.description:
I wouldn't dare to question the effectiveness of Apothecary Renferrel's formulae, however I would be lying if I said that the potion made any noticeable difference.

Along the shore of Lake Lordamere are a swarm of murlocs, and of note, murlocs have eyes. I suspect the apothecary's willingness to try new things is suppressed by his recent obsession with hearts. Bring him a few.

If my choice is to inevitably die a second death or have Renferrel kill me for questioning his methods, I choose the latter.
91920.objectivesText: Gather 3 murloc eyes and bring them to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher.
91920.title: Wild Eyes

91921.description:
Here is the new potion to aid in Quinn's recovery, made with love extracted from six whole hearts.

Now, please excuse me before your presence necessitates more paperwork.
91921.objectivesText: Bring Quinn's potion to Quinn Yorick at the Ivar Patch, north of the Sepulcher.
91921.title: Return to Quinn (Again)

91923.description:
The mountain is overrun with wild growth, inflamed by the fel energies that rained down so long ago. Now the weeds and plants are angry, corrupted, poisoned.

There is a great thorn-bush called Celastrus that lurks about the slopes to the east. It kills animals, lashes out at other plants, feeds on the bodies of the dead. It must be destroyed!

The weeds must be cleared so that the mountain may regrow.
91923.objectivesText: Find and destroy Celastrus the Bitter, and return to Thylaen with its broken frond.
91923.title: Celastrus the Bitter

91952.description:
So much corruption rains down into Felwood from above. When the waters run high from Hyjal, they are filled with fel taint. It soaks into the ground and diseases the trees and plants.

There was a druid who lived in the wild, a hermit named Ketharas, who had a deep knowledge of the mountain. If anyone knows what has happened on Hyjal, it is he.

I think that Felwood cannot heal until the problem on Hyjal is resolved.
91952.objectivesText: Find the hermit Ketharas on Mount Hyjal.
91952.title: The Source of the Corruption

92008.description:
Another new face? 

I shouldn't be surprised with the strength of our so-called wards these days. How's the fel down there? I haven't been away from this workshop in weeks. Say, while you're here, I do have some favors you may be able to help me with if you find yourself in the mood for errands.

You wouldn't believe how tricky it is to get proper parts all the way up here, let alone general building material for engineering. Nami in Everlook has a parts order waiting for me - care for a winter sprint?
92008.objectivesText: Retrieve Kaylaena Springbolt's parts order from Nami in Everlook.
92008.title: Premiere Parts

92009.description:
There's something you should know about this order. There's a few inverted mana cells padded as well as I could at the bottom of the box. The cells have a tendency to discharge when they get bumped, and when not stabilized in time. It takes about two hours for the contents to fizzle.

Kaylaena will know what to do when she receives them, but I suggest going slow if you're going to ride saddled up Mount Hyjal.

If you need a refill, come back and I'll top off the canisters. Be careful, you know?

objectives.text: Shipment delivered to Mount Hyjal before it expires

92009.objectivesText: Gently transport the crate of parts and baubles to Kaylaena Springwhisper in Mount Hyjal.
92009.title: Crate Expectations

92014.description:
Every time I take my attention off the supplies I've lugged up here for more than a few minutes, one of nature's finest thieves is pilfering and rummaging through it.

The damned foxes seem to have made a burrow beneath the boulders nearby. Apparently, me digging out this hole gave them an idea of their own.

I'm working on a solution. Tell you what, bring back some of their fox tails. That'll teach them a lesson, and I'll hang the tails around the perimeter to scare the others off!
92014.objectivesText: Return $1oa Rustleaf Fox Tails to Johun "Punchy" Dillas in Hyjal.
92014.title: Fox Hole

92015.description:
You say you want to help? Alright, I've got a task for ya.

Ever been skunked on a hot day? Nothing worse, I tell you. Bloody things cover everything within spittin' distance in the most vile lingering stench!

A family of skunks have started making their home behind my equipment crates. Help me gently expel them from our perimeter and I'll think about sharing some of this gear, once we can get to it...

I can't stress this enough: don't attack them - they WILL spray you!
92015.objectivesText: Make skunks leave the area around Johun's equipment without killing them.
92015.title: Area Denial Skunks

92016.description:
The roots of Nordrassil stretch far and deep, thicker than riverbanks and older than memory. Such great size carries a great hunger. In healthy times, they drink of decay and renewal alike, drawing strength from the endless turning of the natural cycle.

But Hyjal has been wounded, its soil fouled by demonic venom.

Descend into the deepest depths of the Well of Eternity. Study the roots there closely. We must know whether they have drawn in too much corruption... or if the World Tree may yet endure.
92016.objectivesText: Enter the Well of Eternity and examine the roots of Nordrassil.
92016.title: Rootwork

92020.description:
I've been taking notes and making drawings in my sketchbooks of all of the creatures living in Un'Goro Crater, and I made a few copies so that I can send them to people who might be interested!

I have a sketchbook copy here that I've been meaning to get into the hands of the druids on Mount Hyjal, since I know that they love to study the natural world.

Hyjal's a bit of a trip, though. Do you think you could take it along in case you go there?
92020.objectivesText: Take Hol'anyee's Big Book of Big Lizards to a druid at the summit of Mount Hyjal.
92020.title: Hol'anyee's Big Book of Big Lizards

92065.description:
Will you aid us in our final battle, $r, and be a savior to the Blackmaw?

Varrox Bleakhoof, bane of the Blackmaw: a demon whose appetite for destruction will never be satisfied. His corruption consumes all that it touches. Even now, he and his underlings continue to lay waste to our burrows.

We've come far in our fight against the Legashi, but for the Blackmaw to ever have a future, Varrox must fall.

Find him in Blackmaw Hold, and strike him down. Only then can the Blackmaw finally be at peace.
92065.objectivesText: Bring Varrox Bleakhoof's Head to Gatekeeper Rageroar at Ursolan.
92065.title: Blackmaw Reclamation

92066.description:
When the Legashi invaded, many precious things were left behind in the commotion. Of particular value to me are two totems. They depict legends of our twin gods, Ursoc and Ursol.

I know our immediate survival is of greatest concern, but we must also think of saving our people's history.

Those totems are likely still in our former hold. If they are, you would be doing a great kindness by returning them to me.
92066.objectivesText: Find the Totem of Ursoc and the Totem of Ursol inside Blackmaw Hold. Then, return them to Lorekeeper Nok at Ursolan.
92066.title: The Twin Bears

92069.description:
Two behemoths patrol the place the Blackmaw once called home: Bonesnout, the Unbroken and Withermaw, the great bear. Generations of hunters have tried to fell them, and all have failed.

I take no joy in asking you to slay these magnificent beasts, but my people need to be able to return home. The least I can do is ensure their deaths are not in vain. If you bring me their remains, I will fashion a weapon in memory of their strength.
92069.objectivesText: Bring the Claws of the Great Bear and the Tusks of the Unbroken to Ogtinc, in Azshara.
92069.title: Claws That Rend, Tusks that Gore

92070.description:
The necklace is adorned with miscellaneous charms: scraps of feathers, acorn shells, and colorful pebbles. Its leather strap is torn. The ornamentation suggests it belonged to a Furbolg, while its small size and rough quality indicate a child's handiwork.

There's a chance the necklace is of some sentimental value to one of the Blackmaw. It may be good to find the owner and return it.
92070.objectivesText: Find the owner of the Feathered Charm Necklace.
92070.title: A Lost Memento

92100.description:
<A spirit materializes before you, recovering from a full-body yawn.>

You have no ranks with you... and you are not dressed as a soldier. We repelled Archimonde then?

It's been so long. I had almost forgotten what I once was, but you... you must be one of the first to walk these craters in years.

<The veteran glances at his surroundings.>

Let us continue our conversation at an overlook with a view I remember vividly, just west of here. Long ago, I left my scabbard to rest there.
92100.objectivesText: Find the Veteran of the Third War's scabbard near Elderwild.
92100.title: Anywhere But Here

92109.description:
Erm... 'Ello, $Gmister:miss;. I'm not supposed to talk to strangers, but... Hey, what are those shiny bottles sticking out of your backpack for? Are you an alchemist? That's so cool!

When I grow up, I want to be an alchemist too. Daddy won't let me play with any of his herbs; too dangerous, he says.

Well, I want to start learning now. Could you maybe get some supplies for me, pretty please?
92109.objectivesText: Bring 5 Empty Vials, 5 Silverleaf, and 5 Peacebloom to the young, aspiring alchemist inside the barn of Moonbrook in Westfall.
92109.title: My First Alchemy Set

92110.description:
Wow, my very first potion! Did you know that mixing those two herbs together would change the potion to a bright red color when you first started?

That was fun, but mixing a few flowers doesn't seem like the kind of alchemy Daddy does. He uses other ingredients too.

I don't know what else to use, so let's try the first thing that comes to mind! Let's see... maybe murloc eyes? That sounds so gross, but I bet something will happen.
92110.objectivesText: Gather 3 Murloc Eyes for the young, aspiring alchemist inside the barn of Moonbrook in Westfall.
92110.title: My First Real Potion

92111.description:
I see you try, and try is more than most. We give you good will with time, if you do the same.

Enter our den and talk to Osi. She has open paws, will give you more chance to help.
92111.objectivesText: Enter Barkskin Burrow and find the furbolg they call Osi.
92111.title: Of Friend and Fur

92171.description:
To defeat Ve'han,  we require a touch of the sky. A bit of the divine, where one's upward-turned face yearns to fly.

Head to the Shrine of Aviana and seek out Skylord Omnuron. As the leader of the Druids of the Talon, he can assist in adding a touch of Aviana's grace.
92171.objectivesText: Travel to the Shrine of Aviana on Mount Hyjal and seek out Skylord Omnuron for aid.
92171.title: Taking to New Heights

92317.description:
So, the hermit druid seeks a force to balance the 'life' in this magic of his? Then the answer is death, naturally. You have come to the right place for such a thing.

No doubt you've seen the undead crawling all over my domain. They are fueled by stolen power that animates them even in death.

That stolen power is exactly what is needed in this spell you speak of. Kill the undead and search through their skulls for a coalesced Drop of Stolen Life. Return it to Ketharas once you have it.
92317.objectivesText: Acquire a Drop of Stolen Life from the Scourge in the ruins on Mount Hyjal, then return to Ketharas.
92317.title: Stolen Life

92329.description:
There is a fel chimaera terrorizing beasts and travelers along hills. It is known to the Cenarion Circle as Ghansurok. I'll handle the aim and firing of the glaive thrower. Go to that drum by the cliff side. Let's see this blight driven from the mountain for good.

I'll only have a chance of shooting it down if you can draw its attention. Once you have the beast by the ridge, find some place to hide!

Yes, I promise I have a full bag of maple seeds!

objectives.text: Ghansurok drawn towards the Glaive Thrower

92329.objectivesText: Walk to the ridge south of Kaylaena's workshop and find a way to make a loud distracting commotion to draw the chimaera Ghansurok in range to be attacked.
92329.title: Drum Up Trouble

92344.description:
The burrow you speak of is a tunnel to Blackmaw Hold. In the past, the furbolg have guarded it fiercely, making it inaccessible to outsiders. With this satyr situation, however, we can get inside.

So close to Nordrassil, there would be actively growing roots. Older roots can be seen on the world's surface, but newer ones can only be found deep underground. Little is known of their magical properties.

If you were to bring me some samples to study, the Cenarion Circle would be in your debt.
92344.objectivesText: Gather 10 Nordrassil Root Caps inside Blackmaw Hold for Mathrengyl Bearwalker in Darnassus.
92344.title: Get to the Roots of It

92401.areaDescription: Investigate the disappearance of Edward Heartweaver in the Ruins of Lordaeron.
92401.description:
It's my husband Edward...

He has not returned from his weekly journey to the graveyard in the Lordaeron ruins. Our son was lost when Arthas razed the city, and my dear Edward is still filled with guilt and sorrow that we never found his body. I've tried to warn him against searching those overrun ruins, but he refuses to give up. I try not to worry, but it's been days.

There are things there I cannot contend with but if you are willing, I need to know the fate of my husband.
92401.objectivesText: Investigate the disappearance of Edward Heartweaver in the Ruins of Lordaeron.
92401.title: A Frightened Request

92415.description: <A torn and stained bundle of parchment has barely survived the undead trodden grounds of the graveyard. It mentions a missing child of the Heartweaver family. Perhaps the orphan matron in Stormwind City will know more.>
92415.objectivesText: Bring the Blood-Stained Letter to Orphan Matron Nightingale in Stormwind City.
92415.title: Remember That I Love You

92421.description:
As a paladin of the Forsaken, it is my duty to exact the will of our Dark Lady while tending to our people's needs. We are fortunate with an opportunity to accomplish both.

Above the Undercity, the scourge still roam unchecked in great numbers. Our forces dwindle trying to reclaim our land, and decaying flesh cannot be reknit. Not without replacements.

Would that our glorious captain Garek Bandarion still be with us, I know what he would wish. To finish what he started and heal our kin. For Lordaeron!
92421.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Intact Limbs within The Ruins of Lordaeron for Morbin Lightbane in the Undercity.
92421.title: Light's Justice

92422.description:
Reports have come in from the Lordamere Overlook deep within the Ruins of Lordaeron. An unholy fog has taken over the streets and graveyard, affording the scourge up there some measure of stealth. 

Our scouts indicate they're being conjured by a new power within their ranks, a necromancer known as Rath'mael. We do not have the luxury of waiting this one out, $n.

If you have allies, summon them and their aid to the Forsaken. Drive this creature out of our lands.
92422.objectivesText: Kill Rath'mael in the Ruins of Lordaeron for Deathguard Kristof in Brill.
92422.title: The Wrath of Rath'mael

92432.completionText: Report to the Image of Archmage Modera near the City of Dalaran.
92432.description:
I bring ill tidings from Dalaran. Something has disrupted our leylines, causing erratic and destructive behavior from our constructs in the city.

We know not yet what is causing this mayhem. The high council has ordered us to keep this matter private so as to not bring shame to our order. But we cannot keep up this charade forever. The city is being overrun as we speak!

Archmage Modera has dispatched me to solicit outside aid. Seek her image out near Dalaran beside Lordamere Lake.
92432.objectivesText: Report to the Image of Archmage Modera near the City of Dalaran.
92432.title: An Alarming Request

92433.description:
Hey! I'm pretty busy trying to turn these scraps into something edible. You wanna help out? I could really use some more variety for this meal! It sure would be nice to have something different on the menu.

There's a goblin in Everlook who has this recipe for Savory Stag Sliders... perfect for tiny hands like mine. If you could cook up some of those, that would be great! You can get stag meat from the stags here on the mountain.
92433.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Savory Stag Sliders to Hnaz Blunderflame in Elderwild.
92433.title: Now We're Cooking

92446.description:
South of here, among da forests where I sometimes hunt, dere is a great and cunning bear. We call him Head Scratcher, as his paws have caught more dan one unsuspecting villager. He ambushes hunters who are returning with prey, striking da heads by surprise and knocking dem unconscious, then stealing da catch and running back into da forest.

He is wise to me, he knows dat I track him. But he may not know your scent yet.

Take dis carcass and lure him out. Finish him and bring back his claws.
92446.objectivesText: Take the rabbit carcass into the woods to the south, lure out Head Scratcher, defeat him, and bring his claws back to Zet'gan.
92446.title: Head Scratcher

conditionalDescriptions.text:
If I have to teach you herbalism you can at least make yourself useful. I have an errand I need run.

For a city of mages, Dalaran has a surprising interest in botany. The Kirin Tor keep to themselves, but I would love a sample of their mana-infused vegetation.

You're clearly someone who is comfortable being where people don't want you, maybe you could find a way into the city. If you do, bring me back whatever is growing in their central garden.

92456.description:
If you're going to bother me you can at least make yourself useful. I have an errand I need run.

For a city of mages, Dalaran has a surprising interest in botany. The Kirin Tor keep to themselves, but I would love a sample of their mana-infused vegetation.

You're clearly someone who is comfortable being where people don't want you, maybe you could find a way into the city. If you do, bring me back whatever is growing in their central garden.
92456.objectivesText: Collect a Fel Infused Blossom from the City of Dalaran for Shylamiir in Stormwind City.
92456.title: A Green Sample

92457.description:
The breach has affected many of our factotums and enchantments throughout the city, including many that are seeing to our defenses. This fragmented arcane energy has spoken to rogue elementals who seek to saturate themselves in this free flowing magic.

While we are busy tending to the wards and other major incidents, it would be a favor to the Kirin Tor if you could cull this elemental throng.
92457.objectivesText: Defeat $1oa Seeking Remnants, $2oa Saturated Remnants, and $3oa Mana Echoes inside the City of Dalaran for Archmage Modera outside of Dalaran.
92457.title: Starving Arcane

92458.description:
Whatever disturbed the leylines, it started at the top of the Violet Citadel. A thunderous crash rang out from the parlors above, and now we are overrun with rampant arcane power. It's taking all we have just to keep the wards in place.

We cannot afford to stall any longer. We need help.

The Kirin Tor are busy inside, but you will still need a less public approach to gain entry. Take this key and meet me in the citadel once you've made your way into the city. We must put an end to this disruption.
92458.objectivesText: Collect the Arcane Mote for the Image of Archmage Modera near the City of Dalaran.
92458.title: Heart of Disruption

92460.description:
Look at you, bright eyed and ready for adventure! We need all the help we can get here in Thendal Village and your arrival is most welcome. I imagine you are brimming with nerves for what is to come. After all, you only get to come of age once in a lifetime.

Go, seek out our village leader Rorian the Dayseeker at the entrance to the greatfather tree just west of here. He will get you started on your journey.
92460.objectivesText: Speak with Rorian the Dayseeker in Thendal Grove.
92460.title: Coming of Age

92461.description:
We live in times of great uncertainty for our people. We face unprecedented challenges that may require bold solutions, but we also must contend with the ordinary and mundane here in Thendal Grove. Take, for example, the recent unsustainable rise in the vuldren population.

The vuldren are a vital part of our ecosystem. However, imbalances must be corrected to maintain the delicate harmony that all creatures in Thendal Grove share.

Head east and cull some of the vuldren there.
92461.objectivesText: Slay 8 Vuldren Juveniles in Thendal Grove.
92461.title: Harmony in Balance

92463.description:
If the forest is as thick with these insects as it sounds, simply killing the workers won't be enough.

Go deeper into the forest and find the queen. She'll be close to the hive and surrounded by bigger and more aggressive soldiers, so be careful.

Put her down and return here when it's done. That'll be one less problem to think about around here.
92463.objectivesText: Destroy the Cirrusfly Queen in Thendal Grove.
92463.title: The Cirrusfly Queen

92464.areaDescription: Learn more about the agitated winds.
92464.description:
Ever since our elemental benefactors left us, it seems that we are simply moving from one unrest to another. The problem we face now is that the manifestations of the winds near the standing stones to the northeast are agitated.

Not truly self-aware like the sentient wind spirits that once lived here, these simple sprites respond in kind to forces, emotions, and intentions of the creatures around them. 

My apprentice Yala Windwatcher went to observe them. Seek her out and discover what she's learned.
92464.objectivesText: Speak to Yala Windwatcher in Thendal Grove.
92464.title: Elemental Unrest

92466.description:
While we owe much of our prosperity to the elements of wind, the path we walk requires that we obey the call of all four of the primary elements and undertake a trial for each. Before you begin your first trial in earnest however, you must prove the strength of your resolve.

Travel to the standing stones to the east. A force of Al'Aketh converts has been spotted there and they must be driven off. Confront the cultists there and bring me one of their signets as proof of your deeds.
92466.objectivesText: Bring a Signet of Akir to Windshaper Boro.
92466.title: Call of Earth

92467.description: A sapta is a drink created to bind our spirits to the elements. Fused with magic, the potion will allow the strong willed to see the elements as no one else can. Your spirit will be connected to the element the sapta was created for, and only a select few shaman know the recipe.$B$BThe sapta is always drunk in a sacred place, and never anywhere else--remember that.$B$BSeek out the Rise of Spirits up the pass east of here. Drink your sapta there, and... well, you will see what you need to see.
92467.objectivesText: Find the Rise of Spirits and drink the Earth Sapta.
92467.title: Call of Earth

92469.description:
You've done enough here, $c. I'll stay and clean up any stragglers down there.

Head back to the Village and tell Rorian about the cult's presence. He will not be pleased.
92469.objectivesText: Bring word of the Al'Aketh to Rorian the Dayseeker in Thendal Grove.
92469.title: Return to Rorian

92471.description:
You may not realize this but everything you've done has been a trial of sorts. A test for what is to come for you. It's a big island out there, and Zephras needs spirited young adventurers such as yourself if we are to survive the trials our people face.

The one called Aetheen of the Gales is one of the leaders of our people here on Zephras Isle, and she has been watching you. She has a task that you must complete. Speak with her to learn more.
92471.objectivesText: Speak with Aetheen of the Gales in Thendal Grove.
92471.title: Aetheen of the Gales

92472.description:
One of the most pervasive threats on Zephras Isle is the Al'Aketh Cult. They are religious zealots devoted to the worship of the supposed elemental ruler of Skywall, Al'Akir the Windlord. They are brutal, single-minded, and their power and ambitions are growing more deadly by the day.

Your path will soon take you to Shen'dar Village to the south. Present yourself to Constable Aonda when you arrive. The cult threatens Shen'dar and they are in need of aid. Tell Aonda that I sent you.
92472.objectivesText: Report to Constable Aonda in Shen'dar Village.
92472.title: The Next Step

92473.description:
The ursera den to the southwest is rapidly becoming a problem. Just last week the rangers had to kill an adolescent ursera who wandered too close to the village and attempted to attack a boy playing near the base of the elder tree in the center of the village.

We were fortunate that the boy escaped with his life. Hunger and desperation makes these beasts too dangerous to be left unchecked. Go south and put the scrawniest among the ursera down. Bring me their claws as proof when it is done.
92473.objectivesText: Collect 6 Scrawny Ursera Claws from Scrawny Ursera in Thendal Grove.
92473.title: Aggressive Encroachment

92479.description: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from the kobold camps, $n. It appears to be a letter sealed with the mark of Tordrin Stemblade, our local hunter trainer. Take a moment to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.
92479.objectivesText: Read the Scribbled Letter and speak to Tordrin Stemblade in Northshire Abbey.
92479.title: A Scribbled Letter

92480.description: The cultist you just killed dropped what appears to be orders from a high priestess of the Cult of Al'Akir. It makes mention of a spy in Shen'dar Village and cult operations in a place called Falaath Village. The authorities at Shen'dar Village will want to learn of this.
92480.objectivesText: Bring the Orders from the High Priestess to Shen'Dar Village and present it to whomever is in charge there.
92480.title: zzOLD UNUSED Cult Ambush

92484.description: While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident Shaman trainer--Windshaper Boro--left this recall crystal for you. Please examine it, then speak with Boro just over yonder near the center of the village.
92484.objectivesText: Examine the Humming Recall Crystal then speak with Windshaper Boro in Thendal Grove.
92484.title: Embracing the Elements

92485.description:
While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident druid trainer--Xyton Silverwind--left this note for you. Read it as soon as you can, and then seek out Silverwind on the ground floor of this great tree just behind me.

Heed his words and his counsel, he can teach you much.
92485.objectivesText: Read the Folded Parchment then speak with Xyton Silverwind in Thendal Grove.
92485.title: A Student of Nature

92489.description:
The Kirin Tor have long been allies of the Alliance. With the destruction of their city at the hands of the arch demon Archimonde, the once proud city of mages has now become reclusive and distrusting of outsiders.

In recent years they have begun reconstruction efforts to bring the city of Dalaran back to its former glory. However, reports show they are struggling to contain an outbreak of wayward arcane energies.

We must help them disperse these attacks lest we lose one of our most powerful allies.
92489.objectivesText: Slay the Mana Elemental in the City of Dalaran for High Sorcerer Andromath in Stormwind City.
92489.title: Power Overwhelming

92514.description:
You've got that "Windshaper" air about you. Something about how I can feel a tiny bit of static on my skin when near someone spirit-touched that gives it away. Before I properly put you to work around here, you should check in with our resident Windshaper elder, Illaya Amberwind. She's just outside, near the center of town.

Oh, and check in with Coriella Calmbreeze as well, she runs the local inn and can provide lodging and supplies, should you need them.
92514.objectivesText: Speak with Illaya Amberwind and Coriella Calmbreeze in Shen'dar Village.
92514.title: Welcome to Shen'dar Village

92519.description:
Apothecary Jorell was supposed to bring us a case of antidotes and elixirs days ago, but we're still empty handed. That fool has probably poisoned himself again by brewing in that poorly-ventilated shack he calls his lab.

If you want to further help our ward, you would be a far more reliable individual for this job.

Follow the road to Go'shek farm, south and a bit west of here. You'll likely find it packed and ready to go, with Jorell either missing or unconcerned with his obligations.
92519.objectivesText: Pick up a case of Packaged Tonics at Jorell's lab in Go'shek Farm and return to Doctor Gregory Victor in Hammerfall.
92519.title: Ward Restocking

92521.description:
You know I'm a warlock, right? Now reduced to squalor and meat-cutting, but once a mighty magician!

My imp keeps wandering off and while I could just call him back, I'm kinda curious about what he's doing. He's been sneaking off to talk to a bound satyr at a tower to the southeast of here. If you wouldn't mind, I'd like to know what they're talking about.

I'm sure it's nothing to worry about, but you can never tell with demons, right?
92521.objectivesText: Spy on Hnaz's imp at the tower with the captive satyr.
92521.title: The Demon Tower

92528.description:
The faithful of Al'Akir grow ever stronger with each eager new recruit like yourself. As you can see, our strength gives form to the storm itself!

Normally I'd send you straight to Skypriest Aanders for assessment, but he is occupied at present receiving a guest at the inn on the north side of town. Please avoid that place for now. An unshaven recruit like yourself in the presence of such a guest would be inappropriate.

For now, just don't get in anyone's way.
92528.objectivesText: Look around Falaath Village to learn about the cult's intentions in the Shen'dar Highlands.
92528.title: Among the Faithful

92550.description:
Our best defense here might just be a strong offense. The advantage we now have is that we expect an attack is coming. What they won't expect is for us to hit them first.

I've already asked a lot of you, but please head back over to Falaath Village. Kill as many cultists as you can and if you can get close enough, kill the commander and bring me his head. I'll stay here and organize the citizens and our few peacekeepers to prepare a defense... just in case you don't return.
92550.objectivesText: Travel to the ruins of Falaath Village and slay 6 Al'Aketh Stormcallers, 4 Living Lightning and take the head of Commander Cyclas.
92550.title: Havoc in the Highlands

92551.description:
I overheard you might be going to Falaath Village? While you are there, please keep an eye out for our stolen supply caches.

The Al'Aketh have been raiding our supply caravans carrying various goods such as food and windstones to and from the lowlands for months. They've been blaming the bandits, of course, but we all know that it all ends up in the same place. If there's any of that stuff left in Falaath, it would be a huge help if you could recover it.
92551.objectivesText: Collect 10 packs of Stolen Shen'dar Supplies from Falaath Village in the Shen'dar Highlands.
92551.title: Stolen Supplies

92579.description:
For now it seems the pylon and the village are safe, so I'd like you to deliver this report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar, at the southeastern edge of the island. Valennia is the leader of the peacekeepers on the island and she needs to know what happened here.

The cult is expanding rapidly and the peacekeepers have avoided direct conflict until now, but those days are over. Valanaar will need to be ready for a fight.

At any rate, thank you. You'll always have friends in Shen'dar, $n.
92579.objectivesText: Deliver Aonda's Written Report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar.
92579.title: To Valanaar

92592.description:
We've tried to get off da mountain, but da Scourge always stop us. A powerful lich reanimates da remains of da ones we destroy and sends dem against us again. Dat lich is da reason we can't win!

Da lich has a pile of bones dat it uses to rebuild skeletons. Take dis torch, go to da ruins, and burn da bone pile. Da lich be sure to respond.

Bring me its amulet, and we destroy it and get rid of it for good!
92592.objectivesText: Use the Survivor's Torch on the Bone Pile, then collect the Reanimator's Amulet.
92592.title: Final Death

92594.description:
While you're traveling around the mountain, I can't resist asking for another small favor...

Did you see all those fel shrubberies and plants littering the hills down below? It turns out they burn rather well, which is both good, and bad. Handy for feeding into a small furnace, but also a risk when it twists together and binds up gears...or bootstraps!

Thin their numbers on your way down, and I'll pick up the weeds myself once they've dried out.
92594.objectivesText: Destroy $1oa Tainted Shrubbery for Kaylaena Springwhisper at the workshop in the Tainted Foothills.
92594.title: Kindling, Kinda

conditionalDescriptions.text:
The aura of arcane energy that surrounds you is strong, even for a mage such as yourself. 

Come, let us sit and speak some on the nature of the arcane and the plight of our homeland.

92596.description:
The aura of arcane energy that surrounds you is strong, even though you are not initiated as a mage. I am quite sure that you are going to be a capable adventurer, and your connection with our ancient magic will only ever be a boon to you even if you were to never utter a single word of power in spellcasting.

Come, let us sit and speak some on my order, the nature of the arcane here on Zephras, and the plight of our people.
92596.objectivesText: Have a seat and speak with Rathiril Sunlance.
92596.title: The High Order

92609.description:
We been tryin' ta leave many a time, but keep gettin' pulled back ta defend our brothas an' sistas. Wit our defenses dwindlin', it's time we get ta restockin'.

Today we be needin' arrows. Lots an' lots o' dem.

Find dem big, beautiful birds and bring us back dem long feathers for da straight shootin' arrows.
92609.objectivesText: Gather $1oa Hyjal Owl Feathers for Zet'gan.
92609.title: Feathers in Flight

92643.description:
There is a turncoat amongst the Al'Aketh. They claim to know the cult's true intentions for the island and want to come in, but will only do so with assurances of protection.

This defector is hiding at a secluded residence just northwest of Valanaar inside the highlands. I need someone who can discreetly go there, find the traitor, and escort him back to us. This might be a trap, but if this information is as important as this traitor claims, it's worth some risk.

objectives.text: Find the secluded house in Shen'dar Highlands

92643.objectivesText: Find the cultist turncoat at the house just inside the highlands northwest of Valanaar.
92643.title: The Turncoat

92645.description:
This attack is going to be hard to repel unless we can take out the cult commander. Belguilos "the Breaker" they call her, and she's a veritable terror. She used to be a peacekeeper before the cult got out of control, and even then she was... off. As a cultist I can only imagine how much worse she could be now.

I might just be sending you to your death, but someone needs to take Belguilos out if we are going to survive here. You can find her at the villa at the hill's base. Good luck, $c.
92645.objectivesText: Slay Commander Belguilos in the Gustberry Lowlands.
92645.title: Breaking the Breaker

92646.description:
Lorthuna fled up to the spires above using some sort of portal. Ayessa and Elaadrin went in after her. That was just a few moments ago.

I'm afraid I took one too many hits and this is where I stay. Go through the portal, find Ayessa and help them stop Lorthuna.

Unless that help that Elaadrin and Ayessa said they sent for arrives soon, you are on your own from here. Good luck, $c.
92646.objectivesText: Take the portal to the Rohashi Spires overhead and join Elaadrin Evengale and Ayessa Dawnsinger in their confrontation with the High Priestess Lorthuna.
92646.title: Confront Lorthuna

92679.description:
H--Hello, stranger. You have the look of a capable adventurer about you. I...

<The Skyborne man winces, clearly suffering terrible pain>

...I was wondering if you were seeking employment? I came here to Valanaar to recruit fighters to help save my farm. If you are interested, please go find my wife Aamelia Windfield at our orchard to the west of Valanaar, in the lowlands.
92679.objectivesText: Listen to what Alvarion Windfield has to say and find Aamelia Windfield at the Windfield Orchard.
92679.title: Blood Tithe

92682.description:
Oh, so you've got more courage than sense, then? Fine, I won't argue.

Ferauu and his goons aren't due to pick up their take of the harvest just yet, so I'm going to put you to work for your meals until they arrive.

Head outside and gather today's batch of stormapples for me. Oh, and the bandits lurking around the stormapple trees... They think they are sneaky. They aren't. Kill them for me. 

Let's see what you've got in a fight.
92682.objectivesText: Gather 10 Ripe Stormapples and slay 5 Hungry Bandits at the Windfield Orchard.
92682.title: Make Yourself Useful

92684.description:
As if the harvest wasn't light enough this year already, the galestriders in the area have been getting into the orchard and stealing my stormapples. Think you can head out to the fields and cull them for me?

Take care though stranger, these lowlands galestriders are bigger and angrier than the highlands variety. Watch yourself. A well-timed kick is all it takes to put you down for good if you aren't paying attention.

Bring me some of their meat and I can make us a hot meal with it as well.
92684.objectivesText: Gather 7 Lowlands Galestrider Tenderloins from the Ornery Galestriders found throughout the Gustberry Lowlands.
92684.title: Ornery Ornery Galestriders

92685.description:
The bandits have camps all over and there's a small one in the hills just north of here. Head up there and start cracking skulls. If we can catch them off guard and take them out before they come for us, we might just even the odds enough to stand a chance.

Bring me their masks. The bloodier the better.
92685.objectivesText: Loot 7 Blood-Stained Bandit Masks from Highwayman Bandits in the Gustberry Lowlands.
92685.title: The Hills Have Eyes

92700.description:
Now that you've arrived in Valanaar, you'll likely want to check in with the other members of the Windshapers here. The current Grand Skyseer and her people operate out of the lodge near the center of Valanaar.

You should also be aware, the Windshapers and High Order don't get along very well in these parts. Be careful and give the High Order a good, wide berth. We've got enough to worry about with the cult, I won't tolerate faction violence in the streets of Valanaar.
92700.title: The Grand Skyseer

92706.description:
Calling all anglers!

A giant shark has been circling the waters near the shipping dock, attacking sailors and small boats. Dockworkers have given it the nickname "Bruuz". A hefty reward will be given to whoever brings me its fin!

-- Gazlowe
92706.objectivesText: Bring Bruuz's Dorsal Fin to Gazlowe in Ratchet.
92706.title: WANTED: Bruuz

92707.description:
Wrenched from its hulking corpse, the goliath's bracers are massive. Your whole arm, up to the shoulder, can fit through one without touching the sides.

You should bring these back to Hammerfall, as a warning. Drum Fel ought to know what he's up against.
92707.objectivesText: Bring the Goliath's Wristguards to Drum Fel in Hammerfall.
92707.title: The Giant in the Den

92708.description:
The Windshapers have been hard at work trying to respond to the current crisis on Zephras Isle. We have made several surprising discoveries in our search for the missing wind spirits, and we are developing a plan of action that could help us gain the means to save the island.

We'll need strong young adventurers like yourself for this to work however. Please, if you have a moment, let us speak on this further.
92708.objectivesText: Listen to what Ayessa Dawnsinger has to say.
92708.title: A Grand Adventure

92709.description: Your highborne lineage shines as clearly in your eyes as the sky above. You are one of us, and it's youths like yourself that will help us save our home. But first, let me tell you more of our mission and plans here on Zephras... and beyond.
92709.objectivesText: Listen to what Elaadrin Evengale in Valanaar has to say.
92709.title: A Grand Adventure

92742.description:
We must determine the source and nature of the poison corrupting this land. Let us begin with the groundwater under the farms in the area.

Go to the Jansen Stead in the north and the Molsen Farm northwest of here, and collect samples from the wells there.
92742.objectivesText: Use the Well Water Sample Kit to collect samples from the wells at the Jansen Stead and the Molsen Farm.
92742.title: Testing the Wells

92748.description:
The supplies you found point to a massive industrial operation somewhere in the Deadmines. There's no question that this is the source of the toxins plaguing the farmland of Westfall. We need to stop it, quickly.

Whatever's down there will be difficult to destroy. Go to the Dwarven District of Stormwind, and find an engineer who can supply us with some explosives.
92748.objectivesText: Travel to the Dwarven District in Stormwind and find an engineer who can help.
92748.title: Explosive Consultation

92750.description:
I assume you want a "controlled" explosion? Not as much fun, but a good choice if you want to keep all your limbs.
I'm afraid I don't have a remote detonator--why don't you go check with the sneaky folks down at Stormwind Intelligence? They should be able to find us something.
92750.objectivesText: Talk to someone in Stormwind Intelligence about acquiring a remote detonator.
92750.title: Detonation at a Distance

92752.description: That's it--the bomb's ready to go! Careful with that detonator, now.
92752.objectivesText: Return to Alba Fairmoon in Westfall.
92752.title: Explosive Consultation

92753.description:
