The source of the poison is likely a large metallurgical forge of some kind. Find a way into the Deadmines and locate the forge, then place the explosives.
I will wait for you in the hills behind Moonbrook. Once you return, we can detonate the explosives. Hopefully, with the forge gone, the land can begin to heal.
92753.objectivesText: Find the forge hidden in the Deadmines, and plant the Extra-Destructive Explosives nearby. Then, meet up with Alba Fairmoon at the Deadmines exit.
92753.title: Destruction in Deadmines

92814.description:
My mate, Halea, is tasked with ensuring our armaments are empowered with appropriate magical energy.

The whole concept of enchanting is far beyond my understanding, but as the centaur whose job is to keep our village well supplied and equipped, I know that Halea is often behind on her duties--to no fault of her own.

I would like to gift her some simple clothes to practice her craft on. I see some adventurers wandering through sandstorms with simple facemasks. Could you get me a few of those?
92814.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and bring a White Bandit Mask to Molkar in the Gelkis Village in Desolace.
92814.title: I Need a Tailor

92817.description:
Convincing my Gelkis clanmates to put on armor is nigh impossible, despite the numerous losses we have suffered with blades or bolts through the chest.

I have been tasked with designing a vest that offers some reasonable protection, without the supposed 'itchiness' that they complain about. Supplies are scarce, so I dare not waste precious leather on junk.

Outsider, would you bring me a harness fit to a brutish centaur? I would like to learn from your technique.
92817.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and bring a Barbaric Harness to Talra in the Gelkis Village in Desolace.
92817.title: Leather Technique

92819.description: We are almost finished. Use the detonator, and end this.
92819.title: Destruction in Deadmines

92834.description:
When the cult began their campaign of violence, the Peacekeepers and Windshapers responded with posturing. I saw this as foolish escalation so I advocated for peaceful dialogue. Yesterday I dispatched my friend Belathaan Brightwish to the Shrine of Akir, hoping to establish that dialogue.

A box just arrived containing Belathaan's tongue, dipped in silver pigment. 

It's clear to me now that there is no reasoning with the cult. Kill any cultists you see, and bring me the prayer charms that they carry.
92834.objectivesText: Collect 10 Al'Aketh Windstone Charms from Al'Aketh cultists found north of Valanaar at the Gustberry Fields or Shrine of Akir.
92834.title: Avenged Tenfold

92840.description:
Fillion was sent to the Overlook Standing Stones with a special device used to measure and study the elemental energy there.

Take this--an Index Esoteria--and use it to extract data from the massive windstone formations that form there. Be on your guard however, as the Windshapers are likely to be jealously guarding this site now.

Should any attempt to obstruct you, well... do what you need to do. I have no more patience for their interference.
92840.objectivesText: Take the Index Esoteria to the Overlook Standing Stones in Shen'dar Highlands and use it on the Windstone Formations in the area to gather data.
92840.title: Catching Wind

92859.description:
Folks have been trying to get onto Mount Hyjal since the end of the war, but there's one big problem... all the demons in Darkwhisper Gorge!

I think I have the solution. A concoction made from locally-sourced ingredients might be able to make the drinker blend in with the Winterspring surroundings so that creatures here can't see you as easily.

I'd love to test this theory, if you're game for bringing me a few small things!
92859.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Winterspring Chimaera Fur and $2oa Winterspring Owl Feathers to Evie Whirlbrew.
92859.title: Shroud of the Winter Wilds

92860.description:
The High Order have done our best to avoid direct conflict with the cult, but that is clearly no longer an option. Their hostility has been clearly demonstrated, and now there are rumors of larger-scale cult movements around the island. They are clearly gearing up for something and whatever it is can't be good for the people of Zephras.

Report to Valennia Stormfist and inform her that the High Order offers our full support in Valanaar's efforts against the Al'Aketh, should the need arise.
92860.objectivesText: Report to Valennia Stormfist and let her know that the High Order is with them in their fight against the Al'Aketh.
92860.title: In Service of Zephras

92881.description:
The attacks on both the western and eastern watchtowers are not a coincidence. Based on what you told us about what occurred at the western watchtower with that skypriest, our best guess is that the cult is trying to do something to the anchor pylons.

Please speak with High Elder Shadowsong. He will tell you about a lead that could prove to be promising.
92881.objectivesText: Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.
92881.title: The High Elder's Request

92893.description:
As you tread further into the Valley of Bones, you will find Gelkis wanderers that dared to enter our territory. I instructed they be kept alive so they could feed the bone worms burrowing about, but they seem uninterested in their prey being alive.

This task is simple. Find the prisoners, then snuff out their life. Don't give them a brief glimmer of hope for freedom.
92893.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram Clan, and slay $1oa Gelkis Captives scattered around the Valley of Bones. Return to Orgrul after the task is complete.
92893.title: No Mercy for the Weak

92894.description:
I can see the excitement in your eyes, outsider. Do you grasp the potential of necromancy yet?

Of course you do. And that is why I am ordering you to hone your skills further.

As you venture deeper into the Valley of Bones, you will see the remains of failed attempts at raising the dead. Gelkis attempts, no doubt. Hardly able to claw out from the dirt. Funny, were it not so pathetic.

I have imbued your staff with greater power. Use this to grow our army, and crush the ones that fight back!
92894.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram Clan, and use the Enhanced Necromancy Staff to fully raise undead that are struggling to emerge throughout the Valley of Bones. Return to Orgrul once the Magram army has grown.
92894.title: Bone Raising

92910.description: The part you managed to salvage from the harvester appears mostly intact. Someone interested in harvest golems may want to see it.
92910.objectivesText: Bring the Precessive Autocognition Assembly to Ozwin Ironsprocket at Saldean's Farm.
92910.title: Harvesting the Harvesters

92911.description:
I see... this gives me some insight into what makes those monsters tick. I have an idea how we could override their systems, at least momentarily.

I'll continue tinkering with the assembly you brought me. In the meantime, could you scrounge up some parts for the device?
92911.objectivesText: Ozwin Ironsprocket at Saldean's Farm wants you to bring him 8 Golem Isosprings, 4 Copper Modulators, and a Crude Scope.
92911.title: Harvesting the Harvesters

93016.description:
You will have to forgive me for sending you on such a series of tasks without providing any context. I hadn't considered how suspicious this may have seemed, more so now that the skies have taken on such a dramatic appearance.

I will gladly answer your questions.
93016.objectivesText: Speak with Mordent Evenshade in Shen'dralas for information about the crystals you repaired.
93016.title: A Brief History Lesson

93030.description:
I once was a knight like you--bound to the service of the light. Then, I died. It seems that we both have that much in common.

Unlike you, however, I am bound to this place by a purpose unfinished, an oath unfulfilled. If you would listen, I would tell you of my quest... and my failure.
93030.objectivesText: Speak with the Knight of Mourning to learn more about his unfinished quest.
93030.title: The Knight of Mourning

93041.description:
This discovery is devastating for our clan, but it is in our best interest to keep this only to those who need to know. Uthek is one such person who needs to be aware of what is going on here. I suspect she will know how to proceed.

Take this to show her. For good measure, we should also bring evidence of the necromancy itself to her. Find a skull that looks recently cursed. I suspect they may be hoarding them in the maws of one of the goliath's skeletons.
93041.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis Clan, and bring an Accursed Skull and Gelkis Necromantic Garb to Uthek the Wise in Gelkis Village.
93041.title: Facing the Truth

93044.description:
When you return to Nerlokh in the Valley of Bones, it will not be empty-handed.

Go inside the cave at the heart of our village and seek out Mulara. Ask for Tears of Theradras on my behalf. Our supply is low, but it is our best hope against the Magram's foul necromancy!

I will prepare a ritual. We will create a weapon to disrupt their spells.
93044.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and bring Tears of Theradras back to Uthek the Wise in Gelkis Village.
93044.title: A Cleansing Cry

93066.description:
On the other side of the valley, we have established a small foothold to prepare to march into the forest nearby. Before you head straight there, I want you to deal with a recent Bristleback intrusion along the way. They seem to have arrived right around the same time we did, but managed to secure an artifact from the nearby temple that has kept us at bay.

This task is simple. Look for the thorns and the pigs. Kill a bunch, indiscriminately. Then report to Hagiak at the camp I mentioned.
93066.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and slay quilboar at Bristleback Retreat. Then report to Hagiak at the Magram Front on the other side of Valley of Bones in Desolace.
93066.title: Bristleback Retreat

93089.description:
Please extend my thanks to Elaadrin for all that the High Order and your new friends from this "Kirin Tor" have done for Zephras Isle. I'm aware of the High Order's plans to leave the island, and your order has my blessing and well-wishes in this expedition.

I can only hope that whatever arcane solution the High Order finds can truly provide us with the stability we've lacked these past years. If you plan to go with them... well, this mission will be all the stronger for it.

Winds be with you, $n.
93089.objectivesText: Speak with Elaadrin Evengale when you are prepared to leave Zephras Isle.
93089.title: What Comes Next

93128.description:
As much as I would like Uthek or Khan Shaka to give the order, I fear our window of opportunity is short. Too short to consult those at Gelkis Village.

I believe with the situation unfolding here at the Valley of Bones that the Magram have left Khan Jehn with minimal defenses. If there was ever a time to attack another clan's Khan, it is now.

But $n, a Khan is not to be trifled with, least of all Jehn. If you are brave enough to make your move, you must be swift but do not underestimate him.
93128.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and slay Khan Jhen at Magram Village. Once you have succeeded, report to Uthek the Wise in Gelkis Village in Desolace.
93128.title: Khan Jehn

93159.description:
Uh, um... h-hello, I mean to say, hi! Greetings, even! I'm sorry... it's um, been so long since I've actually spoken to another person. I'm afraid I'm a bit rusty at this.

<The strange hooded figure shifts uncomfortably before you.>

So er, um... how is your day going?

objectives.text: Learn more about the Strange Hermit

93159.objectivesText: Speak with the Strange Hermit in the Shadowgale Forest and learn more about him.
93159.title: The Strange Hermit

93160.description:
I do appreciate you stopping by to talk with me! I-If you do want to help out, I could use a bit of help gathering up acorns from the forest floor. I've gathered most of the ones close by but there sure are a lot of raptor-bird things in the forest. It's dangerous out there and I'd rather not become a giant bird's lunch!

So if you want, you could maybe gather them for me? I'll make us something tasty if you do!
93160.objectivesText: Gather $1oa Shadowgale Acorns in Shadowgale Forest.
93160.title: The Forest's Bounty

93161.description:
In the faint illumination of your torchlight, you can make out a small glint of metal. Upon further inspection, it's clear that this is the broken hilt of an ancient sword.

Despite missing a blade, you can clearly see that this hilt is a product of masterful workmanship. This is a precious heirloom, and there may be those who are interested to learn more about this.
93161.objectivesText: Find someone who would be interested in the Ancient Hilt you found in the ruins of Ban'aethal.
93161.title: The Ancient Hilt

93165.description:
The Al'Aketh have visited great tragedy upon our enclave, and blood must be repaid with blood.

I have an offer for you, stranger. Should you find conflict with these accursed cultists, bring me the ears of those you kill. I will reward you for each that you return with in both coin and, in time, access to the Nightclaw's secrets should you prove yourself to be a true friend.
93165.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Al'Aketh Cultist's Ears from the Al'Aketh cultists in Shadowgale Forest, the Shrine of Akir, or Gustberry Lowlands.
93165.title: Mercy Falls on Deaf Ears

93176.description:
Admiring my little menagerie, are you? They are my un-life's work. I've spent countless hours studying them: their anatomy, their diets, even their social rituals.

Do you wish to join me in the hobby? Here, take this package. The notes and materials contained within should get you started. If you lose it, you'll have to purchase another one from me for a small fee.
93176.objectivesText: Use the items contained in the Entomology Starter Kit to find and catch an Arbor Tarantula, Hay Weevil Specimen, and a Flesh Picker.
93176.title: My Little Friends

93196.description:
The leader of our clan, Khan Jehn, was slain by a band of outsiders much like you. They were acting on behalf of the Gelkis Clan.

You can stop feigning your surprise. An assault on Magram Village while our attention was elsewhere is a predictable war strategy, especially for the Gelkis.

Do you know why I am showing no rage or remorse, outsider?

<Orgrul hands you a familiar weapon, imbued with even greater power than the last time you held it.>

This is why.
93196.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram and perform a necromancy ritual to resurrect Khan Jehn. The ritual site can be found in a tent at the central lake of Magram Village.
93196.title: Khan Jehn

93224.description:
It likely comes as no surprise to you that both of the centaur clans are hesitant to accept aid from anyone outside of their clan. This is especially true for folks like you and me - you know, non-centaurs.

One thing we all have in common is an understanding that money is power, and we have learned that the local centaur barter with carved wood. If you bring me a few samples of their designs, I can put in a rush order for similar etchings. Perhaps we can buy ourselves an advantage.
93224.objectivesText: Acquire $1oa Carved Centaur Totems by slaying centaur of any clan throughout Desolace, then return them to Captain Pentigast at Nijel's Point.
93224.title: Carved Centaur Totems

93226.description:
Siding with the Magram would be my choice. There is no question that they are the dominant clan in the present day, regardless of their previous struggles. I have heard reports that they are brutally hostile against the Gelkis.

I sympathize with both warring clans and especially the Gelkis, but this is their war; not ours. We ought to side with the faction that poses the least risk to our cause. I believe that to be the Magram.

Bring this to their quartermaster in Magram Village to the southeast.
93226.objectivesText: Bring the Totem Tote to the Magram Quartermaster at Magram Village in the Desolace to significantly increase your reputation with that clan. You must be of at least Neutral standing with the Magram Clan Centaur.
93226.title: Buying Friendship: Magram

93227.description:
At first glance, I would wager that the Gelkis are struggling. Their numbers are far fewer than the Magram, and I rarely hear of them stomping around from our scouts.

Nonetheless, they are one of the dominant clans in the Desolace and survive to this day. They must be doing something right.

If you want to make peace with the Gelkis, take this tote of totems with you to Gelkis Village far to the southwest. Primitive as they may be, they are likely to have a treasurer of some kind.
93227.objectivesText: Bring the Totem Tote to the Gelkis Quartermaster at Gelkis Village in the Desolace to significantly increase your reputation with that clan. You must be of at least Neutral standing with the Gelkis Clan Centaur.
93227.title: Buying Friendship: Gelkis

93269.description:
Now that you've recovered all the mail, you can take it all back with you to Mount Hyjal!

Should be no problem, right?
93269.objectivesText: Take mail from Everlook up to Innkeeper Sebelia on the summit of Mount Hyjal.
93269.title: Top of the Post

93317.description:
Are you familiar with Windsong Crawlers? You see, these crabs are native only to Windsong Lake here on Zephras, and they are only able to be harvested a few weeks of the year.

With all of the cult activity of late, I've not been able to get out to the lake to harvest them, and our window is rapidly closing. I'd be appreciative if you could go and gather some for me. They can generally be found along the shorelines around the lake and in rivers.

Do be careful though, they are meaner than they look!
93317.objectivesText: Collect 6 pieces of Windsong Crawler Meat.
93317.title: Crab Season

93318.description:
By order of Constable Aonda of the Peacekeepers, a bounty is hereby placed upon the scourge of the highlands, Vulgara the Insatiable. Last spotted on a hilltop rise just southwest of Shen'dar Village, the winged vuldren terror is highly dangerous and should be approached with caution.

Deliver the beast's head to Danarii Bellowveil to receive your reward.
93318.objectivesText: Kill Vulgara the Insatiable in the Shen'dar Highlands and bring her head to Danarii Bellowveil.
93318.title: WANTED: Vulgara the Insatiable

93320.description:
I've just received word that the cult is attacking the pylon watchtower just outside of town! I've sent the few extra peacekeepers we have here to try and break through the enemy back line to relieve the defenders, but any additional help could mean the difference between our people there living or dying.

Please leave immediately for the east watchtower and provide whatever aid you can.

My lieutenant Yorana Windyreed led the relief force. If she still lives she can tell you how best to help.
93320.objectivesText: Report to Yorana Windyreed at the eastern watchtower in the Gustberry Lowlands.
93320.title: Tower Defense

93362.description:
Please spare the details of how the life may have been twisted there. My heart is broken enough with the loss of my necklace.

But while I weep, the plants suffer.

$n, I would like you to go back to the garden and cull some of the angered flora. Please be swift and merciful; they can feel pain, and they have been hurt enough. If you intend to go hunting for my necklace as well, I would ask you to prioritize that before visiting the gardens again... in the unlikely chance you find it.
93362.objectivesText: Cull plants in the Forlorn Garden and then return to Mithera at Shen'dralas.
93362.title: What They've Done to My Peonies

93394.description:
I suspect your curiosity is luring you toward the grand structure now, yes? Good!

The Shen'dralar there are unlikely to welcome you with open arms, but so long as you tread respectfully, I do not think you will run into any trouble.

With any luck, my old friend Kirandis might be easy to find. Of everyone, he is the most likely to be amicable to your presence.
93394.objectivesText: Locate Magister Kirandis inside the temple of Shen'dralas.
93394.title: Meeting the Magister

93404.description:
I am the ancient. Towering above us. That which still burns despite many rains. I feel its flames in death. Forever burdened by my last mistake.

I do not know why I am cursed to haunt this place. I do not understand why death was not the end.

Please put out the flame. Seek pristine water from a sacred ravine. Such a place exists across Mashan'she. I have heard murmurs of the place in the wind.

Maraudon.
93404.objectivesText: Venture to Maraudon and recover a Vial of Earth Song Water and return it to Woodwyrd at the Forlorn Gardens in Desolace.
93404.title: Rot and Regret

93407.description:
We need to improve our defenses here, and we lack the resources to construct fortifications. We do, however, have all of the bounty of nature.

Search the forest for thorn bushes and bring their seeds back to me. With the power of nature, we will grow our own defenses.
93407.objectivesText: Find thorn seeds in the forests at the summit of Mount Hyjal and bring them back to Tiala Whitemane.
93407.title: A Thorn in the Paw

93429.description:
Although they are our kin, the Lost Ones of Fallow Sanctuary have become beings of pure violence and hatred.

There can be no redemption or salvation for them. They are doomed to wander this swamp as mindless, hateful creatures for all their lives.

Their suffering must end. Someone must put them out of their misery. A grisly task, I know, but would you do it to protect those of us who remain?
93429.objectivesText: Slay 10 Lost Ones in the Fallow Sanctuary.
93429.title: Blood of My Blood

93430.description:
Now they've really done it! As if those wretches weren't already enough to deal with, one of them has stolen my lucky lure!

I was just out fishing this morning, when one came up out of the muck, cut my line, and ran off with it. The thief is almost certainly one of the Lost Ones' own fishermen, hoping to use the lure themselves.

Well, our supply of fish depends on that lure, so I need it back. The Lost Ones fish along the banks east of here. Find that thief, $r!
93430.objectivesText: Find the Lost One Fisherman who stole Pelluk's lure, and take it back.
93430.title: Taking the Bait Back

93444.description:
The most vicious fel chimaera of Hyjal is known as Ghansurok. It likes to swoop in and prey on wildlife caught out of their burrows. Not only that, it's making hippogryph travel in and out of Hyjal more stressful than usual!

First, hunt down one of the Nightsabers hiding in the Summit's shadows. Next, place meat from the fallen cat somewhere on the northern ridge where chimaeras feed.

Lure Ghansurok towards it. Slay the beast and return with its heart. Marn will study it to help heal Hyjal.
93444.objectivesText:
Kill a Nightsaber Guardian, then bait out and kill Ghansurok using the Nightsaber Guardian haunch on the northern ridge of the summit.

Return with the heart of the chimaera.
93444.title: Bait the Beast

93464.description:
Allow me to admit something, $n. While draenethyst is sacred to us, and keeps us sane, none here fully understand it.

I recall a mage who once came to the Harborage, from Desolace. A human by the name of Azore. He feared the power of the draenethyst; said it shouldn't fall into the wrong hands. 

At the time, we drove him away to protect what was ours. Lately, however, I find myself wondering what exactly he knew.

I ask that you find this mage, $r. His knowledge could be of immense value to us.
93464.objectivesText: Find the mage in Desolace who knows about the power of draenethyst.
93464.title: The Visiting Mage

93546.description:
Finally, FINALLY I can use this anvil for something other than a monumentally heavy table. I am delighted to finally hone my craft again after centuries of missed practice.

Now, you are probably thinking, "Vindael, this sounds like you are setting the stage for another request." And you would be correct!

I need to replenish my supply of iron, but your iron has a similar predicament to my blade. Fortunately, the solution is MUCH simpler.

<He hands you a ghostly pickaxe, without a chance to refuse.>
93546.objectivesText: Search for Spectral Iron Deposits around Shen'dralas and collect $1oa Spectral Iron Ore. Return to Vindael in Shen'dralas once you have found enough.
93546.title: Spectral Iron Ore

93547.description:
We are constantly under threat here, both by the Blackthorne Pact and by the hostile creatures of Hyjal. But we can use the thorns to our advantage! With a little help from the power of nature, we can grow new thorn bushes to help protect our enclosure.

Plant thorn seeds near the road to help create barricades by the inn, the storage tower, and the grouping of trees near the road.

objectives.text: Thorn seed planted near storage tower
Thorn seed planted near group of trees

93547.objectivesText: Plant thorn seeds near the inn, the storage tower, and the grouping of trees at the loyalist druid camp.
93547.title: A Thorny Solution

93572.areaDescription: Protect the draenei refugees as they pass through Kum'isha's rift
93572.description:
You may have brought Kum'isha a draenethyst sphere, but that only shows Kum'isha you are lucky, not skilled. If you wish to earn your reward, you will aid Kum'isha's brethren in returning home.

Kum'isha will use this sphere to open a rift, while other draenei will go through. Whatever dangers come out, you will fight. If any of Kum'isha's brothers and sisters are harmed, you can forget about that reward.

Are you ready, $r?
93572.objectivesText: Protect the draenei refugees as they pass through Kum'isha's rift to Outland. None of the refugees may die.
93572.title: To Serve The Draenei

93584.description:
The lands surrounding the Well of Eternity are overrun with followers of the Wild King. Many once stood beside us, bound by the same oaths, but their devotion has curdled into reckless zeal. They actively hinder our efforts to tend Nordrassil and protect the Well.

I will not pretend this is easy, nor that my hands will be clean. Still, we cannot allow them to harm our land or strike our flank when the greater incursion begins.

Thin their ranks swiftly, and may Elune forgive what necessity demands.
93584.objectivesText: Kill $1oa Blackthorne Adepts and $2oa Wild-branded Cultists.
93584.title: Cult Closure

93594.description:
Among the treants borne of the necklace, one in particular stood above all the others to have received the gift of life and sentience. I suspect if they have fallen, he may be the only one that remains.

He spent his days tending to each and every bloom and bud, and his evenings rooted in the ground to serve as a nest for the smaller critters.

If he is alive, and I pray that to be true, then he may know what happened.

I am holding out hope for my good friend, Woodwyrd.
93594.objectivesText: Find Woodwyrd in the Forlorn Gardens at Shen'dralas in the Desolace.
93594.title: Word of the Woods

93604.description:
Big $R heard of Razorfen Downs? <Snort.> Of course not! Big place in Barrens. Lots of thorns. Can't miss it.

Agamaggan died there. Important place for all quilboar. Now bristleback not allowed. Belong to sniffle-snorting Razorfen. Razorfen disrespect quilboar history!

Agamaggan's blood feeds the valley. Grow thorns. BIG ones. Bigger than puny elf necklace ever could!

Go to the Downs. Fetch Kog'thug blood. Stale blood from the kraul won't work. Need GOOD blood!

Give blood, get necklace, win.
93604.objectivesText: Venture to Razorfen Downs and acquire Virulent Blood of Agamaggan, then return it to Kog'thug the Brave at Bristleback Retreat in the Desolace. Kog'thug felt it worth reminding that the Blood of Agamaggan inside Razorfen Kraul would not be sufficient.
93604.title: Agamaggan's Blood

93609.description:
<The necklace you have been seeking is at last in your possession, but unfortunately the magic contained within has been entirely depleted. While not ideal for your current situation, at least it made its acquisition from the quilboar relatively easy.

It is probably best to bring this back to Mithera.>
93609.objectivesText: Bring the Forlorn Necklace to Mithera at the temple of Shen'dralas in the Desolace.
93609.title: Forlorn Necklace

93615.description:
Oh, a tasty morsel...

Fear not, I jest. Though I could snap your spine like a dry branch. I am a demigod of the wilds, after all.

If you would gain my favor and avoid my appetite, perhaps I could burden you with a task?

My litter of young have wandered off to entertain themselves. Little on this mountain could threaten them directly, but there are dark things afoot near the summit, and I'd leave nothing to chance.

Would you check on them? In return for my not eating you, of course.
93615.objectivesText: Find Shalla'kal's kittens in the wilds of Mount Hyjal.
93615.title: Kits and Cats

93644.description:
<Found near Shen'dralas, this dirty old tome no longer holds most of its knowledge.

Of the text that remains, individual letters are difficult to distinguish from words. It may prove challenging to read at first, but one of them appears to be a surname.

Perhaps its author, "Evenshade", may be found nearby.>
93644.objectivesText: The text suggests the author of this journal may be somewhere in Shen'dralas.
93644.title: Tattered Journal

93679.description:
It is good to see you again, $n. I have been reading the notes you brought to us, and speaking with Onku, our eldest seer, about the matter.

He has recently been granted a vision that may lead us to the draenethyst sphere. We would like to share the revelations of that vision with you, if you'd join us for a moment?
93679.title: Visions of Another

93680.description:
The Alliance had an army of mages known as the Kirin Tor. While they were powerful, the demonic Burning Legion proved to be even more so. In one fell swoop, the arch demon Archimonde flattened their city like it was a child's plaything. Those who remained were reduced to merely dispossessed vagabonds.

That is, until they rebuilt Dalaran. And on the Dark Lady's very doorstep, no less!

While in their camps, search for something that can get us into the city unnoticed. I must know more.
93680.objectivesText: Acquire the Dalaran Sewer Key for Magus Wordeen Voidglare in Tarren Mill.
93680.title: Key to the City

93684.description:
While I know of no other settlement like ours, I have seen lost ones south of here in the Blasted Lands. They are much like the ones of Fallow Sanctuary--hostile and mindless. I assumed that was the fate which befell all of our kind there.

However, if Onku's vision points to a lone draenei wandering a wasteland, then perhaps I was wrong.

I am calling on you once again, $n. Find this draenei and aid them however you can.
93684.objectivesText: Find the draenei searching for draenethyst in the Blasted Lands.
93684.title: The Found One

93685.description:
Can your miniscule brain comprehend the rarity of a flawless sphere of draenethyst, $r? Draenei have spent lifetimes in search of just one of these crystals, only to meet horrible fates, their purpose unfulfilled.

So you stand before Kum'isha, knowing what Kum'isha has requested and still wish to assist? Very well, $r... At any time during your travels across these lands, should you find a flawless sphere of draenethyst, return it to me and I shall reward you with riches beyond your wildest dreams.
93685.objectivesText:
Find a Flawless Draenethyst Sphere in the Blasted Lands, and bring it to Kum'isha the Collector.

Be warned, this gem is one of the rarest crystals in all of Azeroth. Any creature in these lands could be holding a Flawless Draenethyst Sphere.
93685.title: To Serve Kum'isha

93689.description:
This is excellent news! With Dalaran returned to peace, I can see no reason the Kirin Tor would not welcome you with open arms!

Please, report to the council with great haste. I'm sure they will be looking forward to meeting the city's savior.
93689.objectivesText: Speak with Archmage Celindra in the City of Dalaran.
93689.title: Friend of the Kirin Tor

93735.description:
Historically, the Windshapers have seen to the tending of the magical instruments and devices that were gifted to us by the spirits of the wind. This includes the myriad of magical constructs around the island. Since the spirits left us, only a scant few of these are still functional.

One of the few remaining working constructs in Valanaar has become damaged. One of our artisans was dispatched to help, but he may be in need of aid. Travel to the west end of the city and offer any assistance you can.
93735.objectivesText: Find Riaani Nightwind on the west side of Valanaar.
93735.title: The Broken Construct

93736.description:
The paramount concern of the Windshapers is to better understand why the spirits left us, and what we may be able to do to bring them back. One curious fixture of Shadowgale Forest to the north is the presence of a curious form of wind sprite that some call "hollows". We know little of them and why they are there, but we do know that they first started to appear after the spirits of the wind left us.

I need you to go there and disperse them. Gather the remains and bring them back here.
93736.objectivesText: Gather 10 Wind Hollow Essences from Wind Hollows in the Shadowgale Forest.
93736.title: Unwelcome Spirits

93737.description:
Oh, hello. Ayessa sent you to assist me? Very well then. 

Not sure what an obvious novice like yourself can do, but if you give me a moment to pull my head out of this construct's innards I might have a few ideas of things you can do to help.

objectives.text: Listen to what Riaani Nightwind has to say
Obtain Crystallized lightning from the Shriekling Cave
Obtain Enchanted Gyrozephyr from Windsong Lake
Obtain Air Construct Core from the Bandit Camp

93737.objectivesText: Speak with Riaani Nightwind and listen to what he has to say.
93737.title: The Broken Construct

93738.description:
Brightwish, eh? So the High Order wanted to remove these components for some reason. But why though?

The High Order has always been meddlesome, constantly wanting to experiment with the wind spirits' magic. They are too bold by a mile, and we've strictly forbidden them from meddling with knowledge under Windshaper purview, but lately they've been testing our patience.

I think you should report what you've learned back to Ayessa Dawnsinger. She can instruct you further on what to do.
93738.objectivesText: Report back to Ayessa Dawnsinger in Valanaar.
93738.title: The Broken Construct

93773.description:
It seems that Ve'han has successfully stolen at least a portion of the power of a Wild God. Such a thing seems beyond belief to me, but here we are.

And what is this "Pact" Ve'han spoke of? $n, you must return to Ketharas. Tell him what you've learned.

I'm sorry to say but it is likely well beyond your abilities to put a foe such as Ve'han down. Only the power of--well, the Wild Gods themselves may be able to counteract this magic.
93773.objectivesText: Report back Ketharas on Mount Hyjal.
93773.title: The Pact

93787.description:
Humans within these lands have long enjoyed the warmth, comfort and sustenance these lands provide. It's time we start denying these humans such pleasantries.

Seek out the supplies of our enemies at the farm to the southwest. Take whatever you find.

It won't bring pleasure like bloodying a blade, but slowing them buys us time to plan our next move.
93787.objectivesText: Steal $1oa Feed Satchels from the Alliance farm in Meadowsbrook then return to Krom'rosh.
93787.title: Food for the Taking

93797.description:
It is a time-honored tradition for young mages to create their own spell focus when they have shown a certain degree of magical proficiency. This is typically done by gathering a fallen branch from our oldest trees, as they have some lingering traces of elemental wind.

I have found the most ideal ones to be near the wind shrine, just south of Falaath Village. Go and bring me back a large branch and I will teach you about the traditions as we create your spell focus.
93797.objectivesText: Bring a Wind-Infused Bough to Belann Windwood in Valanaar.
93797.title: Boughs in the Wind

93825.description:
You wish to learn from us? The trees of Hyjal speak to us. Their bark holds life, and on it grows the moss we call Moonveil. It is soft, green, and strong with the mountain's soul. We need this moss to heal our hurt and bless roots.

Go, gentle one. Seek the old trees where the mist clings and the sun hides. Take Moonveil moss from their bark and bring it back to me. With it, we will mend what pains us.
93825.objectivesText: Gather $1oa clumps of Moonveil Moss and return to Suma Mossmane.
93825.title: Barkbound Blessings

93830.description:
The Deadwood dwell by a pond born of Mount Hyjal's snow melt. That water is pure, strong with the mountain's breath. We use it for our draughts and to save roots from death.

Here, the springs run slow. Our source must be saved, and used with care. But their pond flows with life, it could fill our den twice over. Bring me a skin filled with that water, friend. Spirits will bless your steps, and our den will drink deep of the mountain's gift.
93830.objectivesText: Fill a waterskin provided by Fennar Mossmane at the pond outside of the Deadwood Furbolg den.
93830.title: Water of Hyjal

93833.description:
The owls of Hyjal are more than feathers and flight. Their talons, their plumes, even the bones whisper of the wild. We use these gifts to craft talismans, charms that bind the spirits and shield our kin.

But the owls do not give freely. You must take what the mountain offers. Kill $1oa owls and bring their carcasses to me.

Yes, we ask you to return the whole body to us, as we waste nothing provided by such graceful creatures.
93833.objectivesText: Bring $1oa owl bodies to Elder Pinespeaker in Barkskin Burrow in Hyjal.
93833.title: Wicked Wisdom

93834.description:
Burrow beetles! They're a bane... and now they dig in our den more than their own. We beat them back and swing clubs when we see them skulk by, but they are quick, and to hide in the dark is their shield.

If you spot them as you climb our den, squash them! We will take their crushed shells and make a meal, so it is not all bad.
93834.objectivesText: Gather $1oa Burrow Beetle Bits for Dala Fairmaw.
93834.title: Burrow Beetles

93835.description:
Lorthuna fled up to the spires above using some sort of portal. Ayessa and Elaadrin went in after her. That was just a few moments ago.

I'm afraid I took one too many hits and this is where I stay. Go through the portal, find Elaadrin and help them stop Lorthuna.

Unless that help that Elaadrin and Ayessa said they sent for arrives soon, you are on your own from here. Good luck, $c.
93835.objectivesText: Take the portal to the Rohashi Spires overhead and join Elaadrin Evengale and Ayessa Dawnsinger in their confrontation with High Priestess Lorthuna.
93835.title: Confront Lorthuna

93848.description:
The magic that Ketharas was able to craft to counteract this threat was vital to this victory. Our druids should be able to replicate the magic and use it to dispel the wards empowering the Blackthorne Pact at scale.

You should go back to Ketharas and let him know what transpired here. Tell him that he has the thanks of the Guardians of Hyjal and the Cenarion Circle. He should know that he is always welcome amongst us should he desire a place alongside his fellow druids once again.
93848.objectivesText: Return to Ketharas and inform him of what occurred at the Summit of Eternity.
93848.title: Work Well Done

93926.description:
Whatever reason the cult has for attacking the tower, it's not worth losing our people over.

I'd like for you to head to the southwest and check in on that watchtower for us. Find the peacekeepers there and tell them to head back to the village. Holding that tower is not worth the lives it would cost and I'd rather concentrate the defenders we do have here to protect our citizens.

Peacekeeper Vaaniel is in charge; let him know to head back here as quickly as possible. Hurry!

objectives.text: Check in on the Western Watchtower in the Shen'dar Highlands

93926.objectivesText: Find Peacekeeper Vaaniel at the western watchtower.
93926.title: The Western Watch

93927.description: <As you inspect the body of the dead peacekeeper, a bloody note falls free of his hands. Picking it up and reading it may give you a clue as to how to proceed from here.>
93927.objectivesText: Collect the note you found near the dead peacekeeper and read it to determine your next steps.
93927.title: A Last Request

93948.description:
Since you are going to Valanaar anyway, please deliver the signet ring you recovered from the tower to Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar. 

He will want this back, and more importantly, he will want to learn the fate of his nephew. Talaanis is the High Elder of Zephras Isle and more importantly, he is a good man who is well loved by the people, despite our current hardships. It pains me to think of how he will react to this news. Please express my condolences for his loss.
93948.objectivesText: Deliver the Shadowsong Family Signet to Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.
93948.title: Deliver the Signet

93949.description:
We've been bugged.

It's skyhopper season in the lowlands, which means the pests are everywhere. One of the High Order mages reported that one of the insects that they killed had an enchantment of some kind placed upon it. When we inspected it closely it seems to be some sort of listening spell.

We suspect that the cult is using these enchanted insects as spies. Go and exterminate them for us. You won't be able to tell which are enchanted by looking at them, so you'll just have to kill them all.
93949.objectivesText: Kill Skyhoppers in Valanaar until you've eliminated $1oa Enchanted Skyhoppers.
93949.title: Bugged

93952.description:
Barkskin stand on weak roots. Deadwood claw at our land, each day their rot digs deep, sinks more. We cannot hold alone. 

Deadwood Den guards are the brunt of their strength. If you seek our trust, strike down those who foul the wood. When their Guardians fall, the rest of their tribe will weaken. We even our odds.

Bring them down, for balance, and help keep Hyjal whole.
93952.objectivesText: Defeat $1oa Deadwood Den Guardians and return to Brerufa.
93952.title: Balance Through Strength

93963.description:
Stormwind, Ironforge, and Darnassus all have unique peoples and cultures. As a guest of the Alliance here on Azeroth, you should take some time to visit each of our capital cities in turn. 

Speak with Randal Emerson in the southern antechamber for directions to get you started.
93963.objectivesText: Speak with Randal Emerson in Stormwind Keep to receive further instructions. Use the instructions received to locate and speak with King Magni Bronzebeard, High Tinker Mekkatorque, and Tyrande Whisperwind.
93963.title: Exploring the Alliance

93976.description:
While Gur'dok and I continue our work, we did fashion a particular blade for a friend--perhaps friend is too strong a word--for an acquaintance down at the docks. This particular individual is well known and connected all across the Kingdoms and beyond.

Take this. When you deliver it, let her know I sent you. And tell her we're even.
93976.objectivesText: Deliver the blade to Kreza Darkthorn's acquaintance at the docks east of Rog'mar.
93976.title: The Goblin Trader

94003.description:
I am all that remains of the line of Skybreakers here on Zephras Isle. The rest were murdered by the Al'Aketh.

The only thing that outweighs my sorrow is my shame. My family's ancestral shield--the Skybreaker Bulwark--is now in the hands of a cultist named Zaal Stormshield. Family lore holds no harm may befall a worthy wielder of this shield.

Zaal is not worthy, of that I am sure. Find this man at the Shrine of Akir and reclaim my shield from him. Do this and I will teach you the Skybreaker Defense.
94003.objectivesText: Reclaim the Skybreaker Bulwark from Zaal Stormshield at the Shrine of Akir.
94003.title: The Skybreaker Bulwark

94004.description: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Elixir of Ogre's Strength, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94004.objectivesText: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
94004.title: Craftsman's Writ: Elixir of Ogre's Strength

94006.description:
Greetings, $n. You have progressed in your druidic studies far enough that I think it is time for you to meet one of the great spirits that reside here on Zephras. Urs'endris is a wise and noble spirit, who has taught druids how to take on the ursera shape for generations. Unfortunately his domain has begun to wither and fall into the sky like many other areas of Zephras.

To find him, travel northeast near the waterfall in the shadow of the Shrine of Akir. He should be able to instruct you further.
94006.objectivesText: Speak with Urs'endris near the falls northeast of Valanaar.
94006.title: The Great Ursera Spirit

94007.description:
Now that you've gained a level of comfort in the wilds of the highlands, I believe it is time for you to seek your very own animal companion.

Go to the port of Valanaar to the southeast, and speak with Quel'ana Quickgale there. He will instruct you in the art of beast taming.
94007.objectivesText: Report to Quel'ana Quickgale in Valanaar.
94007.title: Taming the Beast

94050.description:
You now have the power to tame a pet, but you must also gain the skills to train it. For this, there is none better than my sister, Quel'dora. She will give you the ability to train your new pet. 

Go with the winds, young $c.
94050.objectivesText: Speak to Quel'dora Quickgale in Valanaar.
94050.title: Training the Beast

94369.description:
Ansirem has told me much of the elemental lords and I am afraid that we have good reason to fear Al'Akir now that the wards that have hidden Zephras are down. If the Windlord chooses to attack us, we stand no chance to defend ourselves while we are here in his domain.

High Elder Shadowsong needs to know of the danger we are in, and more importantly, what our intentions are for our mission to Azeroth. We will find the means to save our home. I swear it.
94369.objectivesText: Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.
94369.title: The Fate of Zephras

94373.description:
Aye, the time's come, young shaman. Ye've grown stout and sturdy, like the stone beneath our boots. Takin' up the shaman's path shows ye've got the wisdom o' the mountain, even before ye've proven yerself. Ye've the grit of stone to walk the earth's path.

But to earn its favor, ye must face it proper. South o' here, the Frostmane trolls live in a cave.

Bring me two of the necklaces they wear, crafted from the Iceclaw bears. Then we'll speak more of yer future.
94373.objectivesText: Bring 2 Frostmane Bear Pendants to Teo Hammerstorm in Anvilmar.
94373.title: Call of Earth

94427.description:
A key tenent of being a paladin is the pursuit of divinity. This is not the pursuit of godhood, but merely the pursuit of good itself, for good's sake. We've all arrived at this place due to tragedy of one form or another, and it would be easy to lose that grace that defined us as paladins in life.

Go to the Undercity and seek out Tanis Alderwood in the Trade Quarter. They are in need, and they could benefit greatly from some grace.
94427.objectivesText: Speak to Tanis Alderwood in the Undercity.
94427.title: A Lesson in Divinity

94434.description:
Wait, you want to... help? Why would a paladin want to help a beggar like me?

Well, I suppose that you could be of some assistance. 

It's my wife you see. She, well... she's falling apart. I mean that literally. The apothecaries can stitch her back together right as rain, but they are about the Dark Lady's business and none are available to help. If you could perhaps bring me some fresh cloth then I could at least make her a wrapping to hold her together while we wait for the apothecaries.
94434.objectivesText: Bring 10 Linen Cloth to Tanis Alderwood in the Undercity.
94434.title: A Lesson in Divinity

94435.description: I don't know why you'd go out of your way to help me, but I appreciate it. If someone sent you my way, tell them I appreciate them too. You'll always have a friend in Tanis Alderwood, $c.
94435.objectivesText: Return to Danitha Morr at Bandarion Keep.
94435.title: A Lesson in Divinity

94436.areaDescription: Speak with Deathguard Billmuth at Tyr's Watch.
94436.completionText: Speak with Deathguard Billmuth at Bandarion Keep.
94436.description:
It's time to demonstrate your ability to channel one of the light's greatest gifts.

The item I just gave you is called the Symbol of Life. Take care, as it may cause you some discomfort to handle a talisman of the light such as this. The light may be anathema to the force that created us, but it is still our guide and ally. The pain reminds us of this.

Go see Deathguard Billmuth downstairs. He just arrived and he has petitioned us for aid. Show him and the Forsaken what a true paladin can do.
94436.objectivesText:
Speak with Deathguard Billmuth at Bandarion Keep.

Should you misplace your Symbol of Life, return to Danitha Morr for a replacement.
94436.title: A Lesson in Divinity

94438.areaDescription: Take the Symbol of Life and use it to resurrect Deathguard Falgan at Venomweb Vale.
94438.completionText: Take the Symbol of Life and use it to resurrect Deathguard Falgan at Venomweb Vale.
94438.description:
Falgan and I were sent on a mission to scout out scarlet activity in Venomweb Vale. We managed to sneak close enough to one of their camps to hear about new orders involving an attack on Brill. Before we could decide what to do next, I stepped on a twig and the noise alerted them to us.

Falgan yelled at me to run, so I ran. By the time I realized he wasn't with me, I was halfway to Brill. That brave idiot probably stayed behind to hold them off for me.

Please, find my friend and help him if you can.
94438.objectivesText:
Take the Symbol of Life and use it to resurrect Deathguard Falgan at Venomweb Vale. 

Should you misplace your Symbol of Life, return to Danitha Morr for a replacement.
94438.title: A Lesson in Divinity

94440.description:
These Scarlet Crusaders often carry satchels with their deployment orders. We know an attack is coming, but if we can recover their orders, we can warn the rest of the Deathguard and prepare an ambush. 

You are clearly an impressive paladin. Kill these scarlet animals and retrieve a copy of their orders and bring them back to Deathguard Billmuth. He'll take it from there.
94440.objectivesText: Retrieve the Scarlet Crusade Attack Plans from the Scarlet Crusaders at Venomweb Vale, and return to Deathguard Billmuth at Bandarion Keep.
94440.title: A Lesson in Divinity

94441.description:
Please give my thanks to Danitha Morr and tell her that the rest of the Deathguard will hear about the service that the paladins of Bandarion Keep performed for us. 

You have a lot of promise as a paladin, and I am proud to have those like you among the ranks of the Forsaken. Dark Lady watch over you, $n.
94441.objectivesText: Speak with Danitha Morr in the keep at Bandarion Keep.
94441.title: A Lesson in Divinity

94465.description:
Aye, ye've the strength to bear the totem o' fire, lad--but strength alone won't make ye ready.

Beyond the Valley o' Kings, in the crags of Loch Modan, lies a hidden path to one o' our sacred peaks. There, Braldir Ashmantle guards the Shrine o' the Dormant Flame. 

Take this torch to him--it shows yer intent. Return it burnin' by the shrine's brazier, and I'll see ye earn the totem proper.
94465.objectivesText: Bring the Torch of the Dormant Flame to Braldir Ashmantle in Loch Modan.
94465.title: Call of Fire

94467.description: The fire sapta's ready, $n. Now ye face the flame. Use it at the shrine, then climb to the peak. There, ye'll see the spirit--he'll not strike 'til ye do, but he'll know ye see him.$B$BStrike fast, lad. The longer ye wait, the stronger he burns. When he falls, take his glowing embers and place 'em in the brazier. Light the torch and earn the fire's favor.
94467.objectivesText: Defeat the Minor Manifestation of Fire, and place the Glowing Ember in the brazier atop the Shrine of Eternal Flame.
94467.title: Call of Fire

94479.description:
Picking up the rusting metal, you see another, shinier, engineering component. It looks like anything else of use has been picked clean.

Perhaps somebody nearby recognizes this part or who might want to salvage it.
94479.objectivesText: Search the Tainted Foothills for someone interested in the metallic piece you found.
94479.title: One Person's Trash

94481.description:
This hearty stew keeps our trainees fed, enough so that our enemies remain at a distance.

Bring this and feed our trainees to the west. Don't listen to any complaints. With how difficult defending our supply lines has become, they should be so lucky we're not feeding them dirt.
94481.objectivesText: Feed $1oa Rog'mar Trainees at the training grounds.
94481.title: A Serving of Strength

94483.description:
Our scouts have reported training camps by the river to the south. If I'd received word sooner, it would have saved us both the hassle of locating and removing the human filth in a timely manner.

Continue your efforts, $n. Holding back the humans to their precious little keep will buy us time to focus on other matters at hand.

Be swift about it.
94483.objectivesText: Slay $1oa Farholde Priests and $2oa Farholde Scouts south of the river.
94483.title: Show Them How It's Done

94484.description:
A moment if you will, $n. Are you headed towards Shadowgale Forest? There is a druid conclave there in a cave to the northeast. I have been waiting on word from them but their correspondence is long overdue.

With Ban'aethall in ruins and all the unrest lately I worry something dire may have happened. Please, if you are able, go seek out Elegael Thornpaw and put my mind at ease.
94484.objectivesText: Find and speak with Elegael Thornpaw in the northeastern part of Shadowgale Forest.
94484.title: Unnerving Silence

94495.description:
If there's one truth ye need to learn about water, it's this: water means rebirth. It carves stone, cleanses filth, and heals the weary -- but only when it's pure. Taint it, and it'll ruin all it touches.

If ye seek the water sapta, find Hervdana Saegrund in the Wetlands. Her family dwells in a cave beneath the southern falls.

Go on then, don't let the river outrun ye.
94495.objectivesText: Find Hervdana Saegrund in the Wetlands.
94495.title: Call of Water

94497.description:
Ah, so ye've come seekin' the sapta, have ye? Well then, listen close, love. To find understandin' and earn the sapta, ye must seek water in its various forms. As ye gather the samples, keep yer eyes open. Watch the beasts that guard it, the land it nourishes, and how it changes lives.

We'll start simple: fill this skin at the base o' the falls, where the fresh meets the brackish. Go on now, and mind the marsh.
94497.objectivesText: Fill the Empty Brown Waterskin at the bottom of the waterfalls below Hervdana's cave and return it to her in the Wetlands.
94497.title: Call of Water

94499.description:
Aye, Redridge drinks deep from Lake Everstill, but by the time the waters tumble down Stonewatch Falls, somethin' has seeped in. The murlocs down there are big, twisted brutes. Not like the ones ye find here or in the Loch. Lucky for the townsfolk they keep to the base o' the falls.

Bring a sampling to me. I've a mind to find out if it's magic, venom, or somethin' worse that's taintin' the waters near that old fort.
94499.objectivesText: Fill the Empty Red Waterskin at Stonewatch Falls near the Nightcrawler Murlocs and return to Hervdana Saegrund in the Wetlands.
94499.title: Call of Water

94504.description:
Some may speak with you now, but not all. For more of our tribe to be what you know as friend, you must not rush.

Stay by our side, work with our young and old, and guard us from those who wish us harm.

When you have more to bring to us, we will have more to share.
94504.objectivesText: Raise your reputation with the Barkskin Burrow to Neutral.
94504.title: Barkskin Beginnings

94532.description:
Though the gnoll presence has dwindled with the Twilight's encroachment, the threat remains.

The hills to the southwest are infested with their kind, disrupting trades and travelers alike.

Clear a path for our allies by removing the threat.
94532.objectivesText: Kill $1oa Redridge Mystics, $2oa Redridge Trappers, and $3oa Redridge Brutes for Neza Bloodsnout at Rog'mar.
94532.title: Gnoll Infestation

94533.description:
Among the cackling inhabitants of the Bristle Hills southwest of here is an elder gnoll by the name of Snargl. The sounds emanating from this particular gnoll are quite unpleasant. Their presence inspires those around, creating a problem for allies and scouts who enter the area.

A trophy as a memento of our having dealt with this most unpleasant gnoll fiend would fit nicely with my collection.

Be swift about it, $n.
94533.objectivesText: Locate Snargl in the Bristle Hills, kill him, and retrieve his snout for Neza Bloodsnout.
94533.title: Snargl's Snout

94535.description:
Our allies mining ore from the hills to the south reported several attacks by gnolls in the area.

Travel south, locate their camps and retrieve the stolen ore. Take it from their dead bodies if need be.
94535.objectivesText: Gather $1oa Stolen Ore from gnolls in the Bristle Hills for Kreza Darkthorn.
94535.title: Bristle Hills Bandits

94615.description:
I've got no idea what happened to our horses. I got up one morning to feed 'em and they were all gone, just like that.

Life outside Farholde's a bit rougher. Anything could've got 'em--animals, murlocs, orcs, you name it.

If we wanna narrow down our list of culprits, we oughta search around the stables for clues.
94615.objectivesText: Search near the stables at Wheeler's Grange for evidence of the missing horses' whereabouts.
94615.title: Foal Play

94672.description:
Humans are not our only adversary within the Riverglades, $n, nor are they our most dire.

A cult known as the Twilight's Hammer has begun a campaign against those they deem heretics in the eyes of their twisted gods. The ravaged remains of a human settlement to the west are but the first to fall to their conquest. No doubt Rog'mar will be next.

We cannot afford to let them establish a foothold so close to our doorstep. Go to this so-called Sunnyglade and thin their numbers.
94672.objectivesText: Defeat $1oa Twilight Raiders and $2oa Twilight Neophytes within Sunnyglade for Tran'gul in Rog'mar.
94672.title: Encroaching Twilight

94678.description:
The gnolls have been a thorn in our side ever since we arrived. While less a threat than the Twilight's Hammer, they are aggressive, persistent and, worst of all, numerous.

The hills beyond this post are infested with them, making passage to the north dangerous, and posing a threat to those living outside the walls of Farholde Keep.

If we are ever to make these lands safe, removing the gnoll threat is imperative.
94678.objectivesText: Kill $1oa Redridge Mystics, $2oa Redridge Trappers, and $3oa Redridge Brutes for Cedric Dalton at Southern Watch.
94678.title: Gnoll Infestation

94679.description:
Gnolls value strength above all else. By killing their strongest, we not only lessen the threat they pose physically, but also strike fear into their hearts.

In a den among the Bristle Hills is a notorious gnoll by the name of Snargl. His death would no doubt sow panic among the Redridge's ranks.

Bring me his snout, and be quick about it.
94679.objectivesText: Locate Snargl in the Bristle Hills, kill him, and bring his snout to Cedric Dalton at Southern Watch.
94679.title: Snargl's Snout

94733.description:
Alright, so you won a few battles. I think you might have what it takes to make it here after all.

Before I convince our next combatant to jump into the ring with you there's something I need from you first--food for Chub'chob's pet boar, Snufflesnout.

I promised I'd look after it, and, well, this gig here's keepin' me quite busy. Trust me, this'll benefit the both of us.

Mosey on over to the east of Clugfist's clubhouse. You're lookin' for a shy fella who goes by the name Gobam.
94733.title: Our Ogre Friend

94737.description:
Ok friend. Here is treat. Snufflesnout snort and be happy when she see this.

And tell goblin please stop talk so much.
94737.objectivesText: Deliver the bundle of goods to Jezap Jinglesprocket in Bolder'ok.
94737.title: A Treat for a Friend

94744.description:
You did well slowing the Twilight's Hammer. Their foothold in Sunnyglade has weakened and you've turned their ogre warriors against them. Now we take the fight to them.

My brother, Dag'rosh, has already gone ahead with a scouting party. I would have preferred he waited for you, but he is impulsive and overeager--like a true warrior. I'd be honored if you joined him in battle at their stronghold to the west.
94744.objectivesText: Find Da'grosh in the hills west of Rog'mar.
94744.title: The Wayward Warrior

94745.description:
Do you see the fortress just west of here? The Twilight's Shroud, they call it. Filled to the brim with Twilight's Hammer cowards.

They may have walls and numbers, but their pitiful reliance on devilry and ancient gods makes them weak. Show them how vulnerable they really are!
94745.objectivesText: Defeat $1oa Twilight Fanatics, $2oa Twilight Corrupters, and $3oa Twilight Champions within the Twilight's Shroud for Da'grosh.
94745.title: Carving a Path

94774.description: You've caught the attention of our superiors, $n. They've asked you to travel to the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind as soon as possible. Apparently they feel you've proven yourself already and are prepared to further your training. When you get there, find High Priestess Laurena. She will be able to guide you further. Good luck, and may the Light be with you.
94774.objectivesText: Speak to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind.
94774.title: Divine Grace

94775.description: Elune bless you, good $r. I hope your Light finds you and protects you well this day.$B$BOne of your priests was here not long ago looking for you. He mentioned you returning to the Cathedral of Light as soon as possible to speak with High Priestess Laurena. It seems you've done well to garner such attention. I wouldn't spend too much time here--your people have need of you.
94775.objectivesText: Speak to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind.
94775.title: Divine Grace

94776.description: Time's come for you to head to Stormwind, $n. High Priestess Laurena in the Cathedral of Light wants to speak to you. Gotta be somethin' really good or really bad for the High Priestess to want you there personally, but I'm guessin' you've only done well for yourself and it's a good thing that she wants to speak to ya.$B$BBut don't waste too much time 'round here. I'd head there as soon as you can.
94776.objectivesText: Speak to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind.
94776.title: Divine Grace

94778.description: You're needed in Stormwind, $n. The High Priestess there, Laurena, says it's time for you to prove you're worthy of the next level of your training. Don't waste too much time finding your way there. You can find her in the Cathedral of Light in the center of the city. Give her my regards, and prove how worthy you are of such a calling. The Light be with you, $n.
94778.objectivesText: Speak to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind.
94778.title: Divine Grace

94779.description: Praise be to Elune, and to your Light, $n.$B$BAbout this time, many of our order learn abilities reflecting their faith in Elune. If knowledge serves me, I believe the same holds true for your order also.$B$BWhen your business in Darnassus is complete, I would seek out one of your High Priestesses for further training.
94779.objectivesText: Speak to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind.
94779.title: Divine Grace

94792.description:
Many hunters prefer to travel with animal companions. With a beast at your side, you will find that you can survive even the most dangerous of circumstances. As they say, everything is easier with a friend. However, obtaining an animal companion is something that must be done with care. The balance of nature is delicate, and must always be respected.

Take this Taming Rod with you to the forest. With it, you will be able to tame a Rockhide Boar and practice your skills as a hunter.
94792.objectivesText: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Rockhide Boar. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Josephine Carson.
94792.title: Taming the Beast

94793.description:
You now have the power to tame a pet, but you must also gain the skills to train it. For this, there is none better than Isaac Chan, a lifelong woodsman. He will give you the ability to train your new pet.

Go with the winds, young $c.
94793.objectivesText: Speak to Isaac Chan in Goldshire.
94793.title: Training the Beast

94819.description: $n, your High Priestess Mims would have an audience with you in Ironforge. Make haste, my clever friend, your next test quickly approaches. Although I wish I could bear witness to your race's own special rites, my place is here. But may the Light go with you in your travels. Mims should still be in the Mystic Ward once you reach the city. She will be waiting.
94819.objectivesText: Speak to High Priestess Mims in Ironforge.
94819.title: Contingency Plan

94824.description: Time's come for you to head to Ironforge, $n. High Priestess Mims in the Hall of Mysteries commands you to come speak with her. Gotta be somethin' really good or really bad for the High Priestess to want you there personally, but I'm guessin' you've only done well for yourself and it's a good thing that she wants to speak to ya.$B$BBut don't waste too much time 'round here. I'd head there as soon as you can.
94824.objectivesText: Speak to High Priestess Mims in Ironforge.
94824.title: Confounding Flash

94825.description: Just a short time ago, one of your priests was here looking for you, $r. He said that if I were to see you, I should direct you towards the Hall of Mysteries. He said it was very important, but I would not be overly concerned if I were you. His demeanor seemed positive... as though it were good news. I wouldn't take too long in making my way there if I were you.$B$BElune be with you, good $r.
94825.objectivesText: Speak to High Priestess Mims in Ironforge.
94825.title: Confounding Flash

94826.description: Praise be to Elune, and to your Light, $n.$B$BAbout this time, many of our order learn abilities reflecting their faith in Elune. If knowledge serves me, I believe the same holds true for your order also.$B$BWhen your business in Darnassus is complete, I would seek out your High Priestess for further training.
94826.objectivesText: Speak to High Priestess Mims in Ironforge.
94826.title: Confounding Flash

94842.description:
We make our own fertilizer out here. It's a special formula of mine that reeks like hell, but grows trees like they're weeds.

It's a 1:1:2 ratio of crawfish shells, manure, and murloc heads. Tasty, right?

The manure's easy enough. We've got the ranch to the south for that. The heads and shells? Those you're going to have to go wading in the river for.

If you feel like lending a hand, we could sure use your help getting some fertilizer ingredients.
94842.objectivesText: Gather 4 Jumbo Crawfish Shells, 4 pieces of Fresh Manure, and 8 Mudfin Murloc Heads for Halligan Turner.
94842.title: Unsavory Plant Food

94864.description:
You've proven yourself by taming a boar and a wolf. Now it's time for your final challenge. Elwynn's balance depends on respect and skill. Take this Taming Rod and seek out a Young Forest Bear. Show that you can earn the trust of even the mightiest companion. 

Completing this lesson will deepen your attunement to beasts.
94864.objectivesText: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Young Forest Bear. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Josephine Carson.
94864.title: Taming the Beast

94873.description:
Either dominant centaur clan is likely to pose a good ally, but I ought to offer a word of caution regarding the Gelkis.

I have trustworthy intel that suggests, between the Magram and the Gelkis, the latter are very much on the losing side. This may work to our advantage--desperation may push the isolated clan into opening up to outside help.

I have prepared a tote of totems for you to take to their quartermaster, assuming they have one, in Gelkis Village. This may work in our favor.
94873.objectivesText: Bring the Totem Tote to the Gelkis Quartermaster at Gelkis Village in the Desolace to significantly increase your reputation with that clan.  You must be of at least Neutral standing with the Gelkis Clan Centaur.
94873.title: Buying Friendship: Gelkis

94877.description:
When you look around you, what do you see? A broken home and a tired people.

Stormwind has left us to fend for ourselves, and we have less to do that with every day. Many within these walls are refugees who barely escaped tragedy without so much as even their own families.

Farholde is no Stormwind, stranger. We lost a settlement in the northwest to the Twilight's Hammer, but we will not let them keep it. If you wish to fight, go to Sunnyglade and purge those savages from our lands.
94877.objectivesText: Defeat $1oa Twilight Raiders, $2oa Twilight Shadowmancers, and $3oa Twilight Neophytes within Sunnyglade for Demar Brant.
94877.title: Saving Sunnyglade

94879.description:
You've seen the ruined city to the north, yes? Sunnyglade? Demar tries sending troops, but we're no closer to reclaiming it. I have a better idea.

In truth, this attack by the Twilight's Hammer is not the first. They seem to be coordinating from a centralized location, and I would know where. While you're out doing what you adventurers do best, see if you can't keep an eye out for any documents they may have misplaced. With enough of them, I should be able to piece together their intentions.
94879.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Twilight Pages from within Sunnyglade for Ashe Amberall in Farholde Keep.
94879.title: Scraps of Knowledge

94884.description:
I've had enough of this cave. Once you clear your way out, I'll slip out amidst the chaos.

I'm afraid I'm in too weak of condition to carry those samples, however. Their energy is overwhelming, and I've been trapped down here for Light knows how long. Once we get out of here, please take them to Lady Amberhall immediately. I must rest.
94884.objectivesText: Bring the Filled Crystal Catalyst to Ashe Amberhall in Farholde Keep.
94884.title: An Unsettling Discovery

94885.description:
The log is full of meticulous recordings on the comings and goings of Twilight's Hammer forces throughout the Riverglades. 

The author is nowhere to be found, but this information could help shed light on enemy movements.

Someone in Farholde will want to see this.
94885.objectivesText: Deliver the Field Marshal's Log to Demar Brant in Farholde Keep.
94885.title: Field Marshal's Log

94886.completionText: Find Sergeant Riftan near the Twilight's Shroud to the west.
94886.description:
As helpful as you've been here in Farholde, I believe your talents could be put to better use elsewhere.

A patrol of ours went missing some time ago. They were in charge of our western borders, but with the information Miss Amberhall has uncovered, I fear they walked right into the Twilight Hammer's central encampment.

We can handle the cleanup in Sunnyglade ourselves. If the good lady is right, it's critical that we check on our wayward sergeant. He could use all the help he can get.
94886.objectivesText: Find Sergeant Riftan near the Twilight's Shroud to the west.
94886.title: The Western Front

94891.description:
Seems like things are quieting down around here for now, but I want to keep an eye out. You want to send Amberhall a report? Send her this.

<Sergeant Riftan tosses Kilgar's head back to you.>

That ought to shut her up. At least for a while. Good work out there.
94891.objectivesText: Return to Ashe Amberhall in Farholde Keep.
94891.title: News to Farholde

94892.completionText: Return to Knight Commander Demar Brant in Farholde Keep.
94892.description:
It's too late for me, stranger. I'm not going to be making it out of this one. Take my crest to the Knight Commander. Warn him...

<Ryan's eyes begin to glaze over as he mumbles to himself.>

I'm sorry. I should have come home. Abigail...
94892.objectivesText: Return Marshal Ryan's crest to Knight Commander Demar Brant in Farholde Keep.
94892.title: Dying Wish

94893.completionText: Deliver Marshal Ryan's Crest to Terry Lawrence in the Cathedral Square of Stormwind City.
94893.description:
So, his final thoughts were of Abigail?

I know this is not your business, friend, but I must ask you to deliver the news of the Marshal's passing on my behalf. Ryan's betrothed, Abigail Lawson, did not join us when we established Farholde Keep. The two of them apparently had a disagreement, and while I do not know the specifics, I do know that she now resides within Stormwind City.

Please take the Marshal's crest to Terry for me. I don't think my presence would be a welcome one.
94893.objectivesText: Deliver Marshal Ryan's Crest to Abigail Lawson in the Cathedral Square of Stormwind City.
94893.title: Delivering Closure

94894.completionText: Deliver Kilgar's Head to Bolvar Fordragon within Stormwind Keep in Stormwind City.
94894.description:
Lady Amberhall told me of your exploits with the Twilight's Hammer. I'm impressed. But concerned.

Farholde started its campaign originally to remove the Horde from our homeland. While that remains our primary goal, we cannot take this sudden surge in cultist activity lightly. If our pleas to Stormwind remain unheard, we will be overwhelmed as we face foes on two fronts alone.

With the evidence you carry, perhaps they can set aside their pride long enough to listen. At this point it's our only option.
94894.objectivesText: Deliver Kilgar's Head to Bolvar Fordragon within Stormwind Keep in Stormwind City.
94894.title: The Twilight Threat

94896.description:
You look like a capable adventurer. Do you happen to be headed towards Shadowgale Forest? Ban'aethal lies deep in the forest; that's where we're all from.

<Ealaane gestures to the other refugees.>

We've recently had to evacuate Ban'aethal, as it began to fall into the sky. It was sudden and in the middle of the night. If you are headed that way, would you please look for any belongings left behind? The forest and village are far too dangerous for us to return to now.
94896.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Abandoned Belongings from the ruins of Ban'aethal.
94896.title: Aid For The Refugees

94897.description:
If you are traveling to Ban'aethal, I have a selfish request. My love, Resaan... I believe is no longer a part of this world. He had tried to go back to get supplies even though I begged him to stay. It has been over a week already and I fear the worst.

Please, if you find him, bring him home. If he has perished then I beg you to please bring me his heirloom.
94897.objectivesText: Find Resaan in the Ruins of Ban'aethal.
94897.title: The Fate of a Loved One

94911.description:
Greetings, young $r. I can see that you have much promise in the druidic arts. There is one who you may want to speak with in the city of Thunder Bluff by the name of Turak Runetotem. He will teach you how to reach the stronghold of the Cenarion Circle on Kalimdor, Moonglade. 

You will be welcomed there, and the druids of the circle will impart their knowledge upon you. 

As your people would say--go with the wind's blessing, young one. I wish you good fortune in your adventures.
94911.objectivesText: Speak with Turak Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.
94911.title: Child of Nature

94914.description: All druids are welcomed to the sacred lands of Moonglade. Keeper Remulos--Moonglade's guardian--keeps watch over all druids who hibernate there. I'll teach you the spell that lets you transport yourself there. Cast it whenever you seek Moonglade's knowledge or solace.$B$BAs for your first lesson here on Azeroth, travel to Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze in Nighthaven about the path you're now on. Good luck, young druid.
94914.objectivesText: Use the spell "Teleport: Moonglade" to travel to Moonglade. When you arrive, speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven.
94914.title: Moonglade

94923.description:
<Robbie leans in to talk to you, as if sharing a grave secret.>

Psst! Hey $gmister:miss;, I need your help!

My sister got me a hat for my birthday but I lost it playing in the river. I'm not allowed to be down there because of the murlocs so I can't ask Dad or Ellie for help because then they'll know where I was!

It's a good hat. I bet one of those murlocs found it and kept it for himself!
94923.objectivesText: Find Robbie's Hat somewhere along the river near the murlocs.
94923.title: Hats Off

94926.description:
Like most ogre weaponry, this hammer is large, unwieldy, and well-worn. A creature of any other race could hardly swing it at all.

To you, it is of little more use than a trophy, but perhaps someone at Farholde would appreciate knowing of Komuk's demise.
94926.objectivesText: Take Komuk's Maul to Farholde Keep as proof of the ogre's demise.
94926.title: Drop the Hammer

94928.description:
These hides are to be delivered to Powderfuse Port. It is a goblin-run port to the northeast.

When you get there, deliver the hides to Friz Frazzlespark. Tell her they're from Cornelius. The details of our trade have already been worked out, so she'll know what they are for.
94928.objectivesText: Deliver the Bundle of Lion Hides to Friz Frazzlespark at Powderfuse Port.
94928.title: A Few Furs for Friz

94929.description:
I know I said that was it, but I promise, I wouldn't ask this if it weren't important. It's a shipment of utmost urgency.

An old acquaintance resides in a keep within the Riverglades. To get there, travel northeast through the bogs avoiding the deadly creatures within. Along the northeastern hillside sits an old path. Travel its road all the way through the hills and when you hit the fork in the road stay north, then east. You should see Farholde along the eastern shore.

I thank you for your aid.
94929.objectivesText: Bring the Shipment to Demar Brant at Farholde Keep in the Riverglades.
94929.title: Deliver the Second Shipment

94930.description:
