<A handwritten label appears on the side of the crate. On the right side is a map with a large red circle along a southeastern shoreline north of a poorly drawn temple surrounded by water and some kind of winged creatures. On the left is a note in massive font.>

PROPERTY OF FRIZ FRAZZLESPARK

POWDERFUSE PORT

WARNING: NOT for tampering. Do NOT open without supervision.

<An additional note appears at the bottom of the label.>

If lost, return to Friz Frazzlespark. Powderfuse Port. Riverglades.
94930.objectivesText: Deliver the Lost Shipping Crate to Friz Frazzlespark at Powderfuse Port in the Riverglades.
94930.title: Lost Shipping Crate

94968.description:
Of the few that managed to infiltrate the cave, most have perished. It seems these Twilight have a foothold much larger than we thought. We will not stand by while these cultists continue to ravage these lands and make sacrifices of our allies. We end this now, $n.

Infiltrate this stronghold, slaughter their forces and bring me proof of their leader's demise.
94968.objectivesText: Infiltrate Krol'dok Stronghold and return to Krom'rosh with proof of their leader's demise.
94968.title: Eye of Mugg

94969.description:
Don't ask. You wouldn't believe me if I told you.

Let's just focus on getting me out of here! Oh, and you as well, of course.
94969.title: Krol'dok No More!

94971.description:
One of the most important parts of a paladin's arsenal has always been their warhorse. These specially consecrated animals bear paladins and their arms into battle, and are as fearless and bold as the best of us.

While our situation has changed, our need for steeds to bear us into battle has not. It's time that you had such a mount for yourself.
94971.objectivesText: Speak with Danitha Morr to learn to summon your Warhorse.
94971.title: A Paladin's Steed

94972.description:
With their location revealed, it is likely that within this stronghold are secrets kept well hidden from those we have encountered thus far. It would be wise for us to locate and recover any information that may be of use to our fight against these cultists.

See what you can uncover, $n. I await your return.
94972.objectivesText: Recover the Tome of Twilight from Krol'dok Stronghold.
94972.title: Tome of Twilight

94973.description: <The moulding appears to be for a key.>
94973.objectivesText: Find someone in Rog'mar who may know about the mould.
94973.title: Krol'dok Moulding

94975.description:
Our work here is not finished, $n. These cultists have inflicted unimaginable pain upon our allies and rendered these lands for their taking.

We will not tolerate these actions any longer.

To the north lies a hidden cave network, masked by the rugged terrain. Our scouts spoke of cultist movement under the veil of darkness.

Seek out this cave and find where these cultists are hiding. It's time we deliver a message they won't soon forget.
94975.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Cultist Ears from the Twilight's Hammer in Krol'dok Stronghold.
94975.title: A Token of Vengeance

94979.description:
You've proven you can tame the river's crawler. Now it's time to test your skill on open ground. The plains of Zephras echo with the cries of the galestrider, a proud, winged hunter that runs like the wind.

Take this Taming Rod and seek one out. Travel to the lowlands and earn its trust.

Show you're ready for the trials yet to come.
94979.objectivesText:
Use the Taming Rod to tame an Ornery Galestrider in the Gustberry Lowlands. 
Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Quel'ana Quickgale in Valanaar.
94979.title: Taming the Beast

94980.description: <The moulding appears to be for a key.>
94980.objectivesText: Find someone in Farholde Keep who may know about the mould.
94980.title: Krol'dok Moulding

94982.description:
Our scouts mentioned a network of caves to the northwest along the mountains, hidden by natural surroundings. Most who sought information from deep within have yet to return. I fear they may be lost.

Those watching from a distance mentioned a Twilight presence moving in and out of the caves, often in darkness.

Locate this stronghold. If it is what I think it is we must deliver a deathly blow to their leader. Only then may we continue our efforts to remove them from these lands.
94982.objectivesText: Infiltrate Krol'dok Stronghold and return to Commander Brant with proof of their leader's demise.
94982.title: Eye of Mugg

94983.description:
The stories our scouts shared were quite horrid. I'll spare you the gruesome details. What we've discovered confirms previous reports of a cultist hideout.

To the north lies a cave, well hidden by its surroundings. This cave leads to... well, a place we've yet to infiltrate. We believe it's a foothold, nestled deep within the mountains.

It's time we repay the cultists for their actions against our allies.

Venture north, seek out our enemies, and return to me with proof of their demise.
94983.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Cultist Bangles from the Twilight's Hammer in Krol'dok Stronghold.
94983.title: Twilight Mementos

94984.description:
No matter our efforts, the Twilight forces persist. We've deduced they must be coming from somewhere else.

With the new pet you brought me, I was able to politely ask our dear Twilight Thrall if it knew anything about where its former masters were coming from. Of note was mention of shadow magics and an ogre by the name of Nar'gurk in a hidden stronghold north of Sunnyglade.

Seek him out. Kill him and recover what you can. There must be something we can learn from these efforts.
94984.objectivesText: Kill Nar'gurk within Krol'dok Stronghold and recover any valuable information.
94984.title: Tome of Twilight

94997.description:
We mustn't linger. Take these to the keep at once.

Find Ashe Amberhall. She may be a pain, but she's well respected in her field of study. Perhaps she can shed some light on what energies are contained within these objects.
94997.objectivesText: Bring the Satchel of Cursed Mementos to Ashe Amberhall in Farholde Keep.
94997.title: Lingering Essence

95026.description:
Escapin' war don't mean we be safe here. Dem creatures to da east been plaguin' da area all dis time.

Maybe you be ready for a challenge, eh?

Strike 'em down. Ain't nobody gonna be missin' dem after all.
95026.objectivesText: Eliminate $1oa Forgotten Soldiers and $2oa Fleshflay Raveners.
95026.title: Blight No More

95027.description:
We always need more arrows for hunting and fighting, and for feathers, we use the white feathers of the Hyjal owl. They're naturally fluffy and soft, but I stiffen them up with a mixture designed to make them perfect for fletching.

You can get feathers from the owls, of course, but they also leave behind feathers in their nests, which you can find all over to the south of here.

Bring back a bundle of feathers, all right?
95027.objectivesText: Head south into the valley and collect owl feathers from their nests.
95027.title: Feathers in Flight

95034.description:
I think you should know that it wasn't actually the Gnolls who attacked us on the road.

We were actually attacked by a giant, wolf-like creature that I now know as a "worgen". It dispatched our guards and came for me, but Banon threw himself in its path. I managed to get a spell off which startled the creature, causing it to flee, but Banon was already badly bitten. He insisted I leave him there but I refused.

We were limping back here when the gnolls found us. What came next was terrifying...
95034.objectivesText: Speak with Lumina Windsinger in the Sepulcher.
95034.title: The Debt

95036.description:
Trevan tells me that the worgen are a major threat to the citizens of Silverpine Forest. Despite their strength and resilience they can be killed, but there is one in particular that just doesn't ever seem to stay dead due to unknown magic.

That's the one that attacked us. He is known as Old Fire-Eye and he is the biggest and meanest of their kind. To put him down, we'll need a special kind of weapon.

Speak with Trevan and he will supply you with a list of what is needed to forge such a weapon.
95036.objectivesText: Speak with Trevan Rol in the Sepulcher and bring him the materials he requires.
95036.title: A Moon-Kissed Blade

95059.description:
Time for a special delivery.

Knight Commander Demar Brant at Farholde is waiting for this. For some reason he always makes me say his full name. What an odd fella.

Anywho, you can find him holed up in the keep southwest of here. Massive stone fortress. Ya can't miss it.
95059.objectivesText: Deliver Frazzlespark's Crate to Knight Commander Demar Brant in Farholde Keep.
95059.title: Frazzlespark's Crate

95063.description:
Ok, listen up. You've showed quite a bit of prowess in the ring. You've managed to upset Chub'chob more than words can explain. Sure glad I ain't you right now.

Just in case you was wonderin', I should remind you that your entry fee does not cover accidental death.

It's been great knowin' ya, but you're on your own from here on out, bub.

Best of luck to ya.
95063.objectivesText: Defeat Chub'chob, Bloodmaster of Bolder'ok, in the Bloodmaster's Ring, then share the news of becoming the newly crowned champion of the Bloodmaster's Ring with Clugfist at Bolder'ok.
95063.title: Bloodmaster's Ring

95107.description:
One chief of the Deadwood, Deeproar, barks in the depths of their den. He was once of no burrow, and in a night of bad blood, he fell sway to their spells.

Now, he feeds on their sour sap, with twice the cursed roar.

Go. End his foul ways. Take his staff and bring it here, so I know he holds it no more.
95107.objectivesText: Kill Chieftain Deeproar and return his staff to Elder Pinespeaker in Barkskin Burrow.
95107.title: Deeproar Down

95108.description:
With far sight, we have seen their den. Deadwood brew dark rites in their pots. They feed this foul mix to their young, so bad roots take. Then they learn to fight with vile ways.

Go, stop this spread. Slay the dark ones and smash their stew.
95108.objectivesText: Kill two Deadwood Death Mystics and destroy two Deadwood Cauldrons within Deadwood Den.
95108.title: Mystic Mix

95111.description:
In Tarren Mill there is a weaponsmith known as Ott. By all accounts he is an unremarkable smith, selling simple blades to travelers. I purchased a sword from him myself, and when I took it to the undercity for maintenance some time later, the smiths there were surprised at its quality. They assumed it came from a well-known master smith, but no, it was just Ott.

I'd like to give this orc a chance to do something truly special. Take the materials to Ott in Tarren Mill and offer him the commission.
95111.objectivesText: Speak with Ott and ask him to forge your blade.
95111.title: An Underrated Talent

95118.description:
Murlocs, murlocs, murlocs! That's all I ever hear about; from the sailors, the fishermen, even my own kids! Everyone's on my case about 'em! They're a nuisance, I admit, but I got a port to run here!

Help a guy out, would ya? Kill a couple 'a those things and I'll make it worth your time.
95118.objectivesText: Kill 8 Murloc Oracles and 8 Murloc Warriors along the Eastwind Shore.
95118.title: Saltwater Savages

95119.description:
You know the Eastsea crew? Real unsavory bunch, and that's coming from the guy running a place called "Powderfuse Port".

They're destructive, bloodthirsty, and, worst of all, cutting into my bottom line. They steal cargo, and sink ships, both of which end up costing me the big bucks!

We gotta take down their whole operation, starting with the ones closest to here. You can find 'em along the beaches to the north.
95119.objectivesText: Kill $1oa Eastsea Buccaneers and $2oa Eastsea Musketeers along the Eastwind Shore, north of Powderfuse Port.
95119.title: Unfriendly Competition

95121.description:
Welcome to Fimbo's cafe on the water! Today's menu is roasted boar, and roasted fish...same as every day...

This menu needs a shake up, badly. I've had my eye on a new seafood stew recipe, but I'm gonna need some fresh meat. A few murloc eyes and some crab meat oughta do.

You can find both along the beaches nearby. Can't beat some good ol' fashioned local ingredients!
95121.objectivesText: Gather 12 Murloc Eyes and 6 pieces of Sand Crawler Meat for Fimbo Greasemitz.
95121.title: A Taste of the Sea

95125.description:
These are some truly fine materials, $c. You honor me by allowing me to forge this blade for you and I only hope that I can live up to your expectations.

Please, stand back so that I may begin the forging process.
95125.objectivesText: Watch as Ott forges your blade.
95125.title: Ott's Masterwork

95126.description: Here's the blade. You said that a paladin named Trevan sent you? Please extend my thanks to him for this opportunity when you next see him. Go with honor, friend.
95126.objectivesText: Bring Ott's Masterwork to Trevan Rol in Silverpine Forest.
95126.title: The Moonsilver Blade

95140.description:
I see that you have your weapon now, $c. I pray that it will not fail you.

The locals tell me that Old Fire-Eye hunts in a large area south of here and you can generally find him near the gates to Gilneas. Find him, and use your new blade to end him. When it is done, return and you will have the gratitude of the Windshapers.
95140.objectivesText: Use the Moonsilver Blade to destroy Old Fire-Eye in Silverpine Forest.
95140.title: Old Fire-Eye

95141.description:
Far to the northeast beyond Stonard lies an embattled land along the eastern coast known as the Riverglades.

Many have sought to lay claim to these lands, but few have succeeded. There is one, however, whose experience battling our enemies proved enough to settle a small outpost known as Rog'mar. Through countless attacks, it still remains.

As ruthless as Krom'rosh may be, his will has served our allies greatly. If it's battle you seek, head northeast to seek out this old friend of ours.
95141.objectivesText: Report to Krom'rosh at the Rog'mar outpost in the Riverglades.
95141.title: Report to Rog'mar

95144.description:
Hey, bub. Got a package that needs to go to an old friend of mine. Whatever you do--

DO NOT OPEN THE PACKAGE!

Take this--carefully--to Friz Frazzlespark across the seas over to our sister port in the Riverglades. And before you ask, no I would not suggest swimming. Didn't work out so well for the last guy. Oh, and don't tilt it, shake it, or make any sudden movements.

I recommend heading east to Steamwheedle Port. The ship from there usually provides safe passage.

Best of luck to ya!
95144.objectivesText: Deliver Fizzgrimble's Mysterious Crate to Friz Frazzlespark at Powderfuse Port in the Riverglades.
95144.title: Overseas Delivery

95148.description:
As much as I'd like to deliver the blood-soaked message to the knight commander himself, I'd also like to keep my post. I've cleaned it up a bit so it's less... well, bloody.

Given the recent gnoll uprisings, I'm afraid the task of delivering the news falls upon you.
95148.objectivesText: Deliver the Southern Watch Gnoll Report to the knight commander at Farholde Keep.
95148.title: Southern Watch Gnoll Report

95161.description:
If you're looking for Jeremy Heartweaver, your best bet is to talk to his newly adopted mother, Avette Fellwood out in Duskwood. Sweet woman. Likely needs another pair of hands for her work, but it beats staying in the orphanage.

If you see little Jeremy, do be sure to tell him we're all thinking of him, won't you?
95161.objectivesText: Deliver the Blood-Stained Letter to Avette Fellwood in Duskwood.
95161.title: Remember That I Love You

95183.description:
You want ogre weapon? Me know no. You small. Can't hold good.

You bring Hamur more rocks, me make you tiny weapon. Good for tiny creature.

Find good rocks for good weapon. Hamur has discerning eye. Not just any rock will do. Find rocks near river outside Bolder'ok.
95183.objectivesText: Gather $1oa Good Rocks for Hamur in Bolder'ok.
95183.title: Step One: Rock

95184.description:
The rigors of training for battle are one thing, but these trainees don't yet understand the difference between a training sword and the well-kept blade of a seasoned veteran.

I think it's time we show our recruits how a sharpened blade can be the difference between victory and death.

If you can find us a few sharpening stones, we'll put them to good use. There are certain craftsmen known to study this trade. I'd suggest starting there.
95184.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Solid Sharpening Stones to Ember Bladewhisper at the Farholde training grounds.
95184.title: The Sharpest of Blades

95189.completionText: Return the Crest of Lordaeron to Lady Dena Kennedy in Stormwind City.
95189.description: <A weathered crest depicting the mark of Lordaeron. With so few relics left after the kingdom's fall, someone in Stormwind would be very keen to get their hands on this.>
95189.objectivesText: Return the Crest of Lordaeron to Lady Dena Kennedy in Stormwind City.
95189.title: Crest of Lordaeron

95195.description: <The old Alliance insignia appears to have belonged to a soldier of Lordaeron. These ruins are likely filled with similar medals that living relatives would be grateful to have returned to them.>
95195.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Bloodied Insignias and take them to General Marcus Jonathan in Stormwind City.
95195.title: Bloodied Insignia

95204.description: <A weathered crest depicting the mark of Lordaeron. With so few relics left after the kingdom's fall, someone in the Undercity would be very keen to get their hands on this.>
95204.objectivesText: Bring the Crest of Lordaeron to Oran Snakewrithe in Undercity.
95204.title: Crest of Lordaeron

95212.description:
We're getting ready to send a team of rams to reinforce the Alterac expedition, but we've run out of material to make their saddles.

Collect pelts from the largest, fiercest leopards to the east and bring them to me. It's biting cold up there and our forces deserve nothing but the finest pelts to keep them warm!
95212.objectivesText: Collect 6 Pristine Leopard Pelts and deliver them to Amberstill Ranch.
95212.title: Never Saddle on Quality

95216.description:
Welcome to the most vital organ of the Undercity: The Apothecarium! Here we experiment on the most virulent of Azeroth's exotic specimens.

You've caught me in a good mood, so I will let you in on my latest investigation. It appears there is a particularly venomous arthropod stalking the ruins above our fair city. Its toxins are said to eat through even undead flesh. How exhilarating!

I wish to validate these claims. Should you find yourself withering away from its bite, I should love a sample.
95216.objectivesText: Collect the Highly Toxic Strain from Witherfang in Ruins of Lordaeron for Theodore Griffs in Undercity.
95216.title: The New Plague

95217.description:
So you're looking to learn the blacksmith's trade? Maybe we can help each other.

The supply shipment's late, and I need materials for some repairs around the camp. If you get me what I need, I'll teach you some of my techniques. Sound fair?
95217.objectivesText: Collect 12 Copper Bars and 4 Toughened Boar Hides and deliver them to Frast Dokner.
95217.title: The Quarry's Smith

conditionalDescriptions.text:
Ah, a fellow human. It's about time Lordaeron sent reinforcements.

My master has already charged into the fray and has ordered me to maintain my post. It has been quite some time, however.

I don't dare trust this task to any of these filthy half breeds, but if I could impose on you a favor, I beg of you to find me the Grand Marshal. He is the tallest, most statuesque hero you've ever laid eyes on. You'll know him when you see him.

95250.description:
What do you want, $r? Can't you see there is a war to be won?

My master has already charged into the fray and has ordered me to maintain my post. It has been quite some time, however.

I doubt you'll survive ten minutes in combat, but if it keeps your simple mind busy, why don't you seek out the Grand Marshal. He is the tallest, most statuesque hero you've ever laid eyes on. You'll know him when you see him.
95250.objectivesText: Collect the Head of the Baron in the Ruins of Lordaeron and bring it back to Captain Truman.
95250.title: Abominable Creatures

95254.description:
Calling all anglers!

I'm in the market for some crab meat. Not just the usual shreds either, I'm talking whole claw. I've seen a big one crawling around under the docks, stealing bait and cutting lines.

I'll pay a reward to anyone who brings me that thing's pincer. You'll also get a helping of the dish I whip up.

-- Fimbo Greasemitz
95254.objectivesText: Bring Trapclaw's Pincer to Fimbo Greasemitz.
95254.title: WANTED: Trapclaw

95261.description:
That monster...with the long neck, just like you said. I've seen 'im around those islands -- out on my boat. I tried <hic> tellin' folks, but ohh nooo, you can't <hic> believe ol' Argo. He's just some...some...drunkard fisherman! Makin' up stories!

We'll show 'em...soon as I get some bait...

Hey! Quit standin' around! I'm gonna need entrails, a LOT of 'em. Any beast from around here. The smellier <hic> the better. I'm also gonna need some Rotflesh mushrooms. Those grow in that cave by Windstead.
95261.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Beast Entrails and $2oa Rotflesh Mushrooms for Argo Brinewhistle.
95261.title: It Takes Guts

95262.description:
Can't say I've ever thought much about Alcaz. Near as I can tell, it's an abandoned outpost from the third war of little significance. Never heard nuthin' about a prison there. 

Well, there's nothing for it--we've got to get you in there and see what you can see, especially if there's a chance that the king is there.

objectives.text: Learn what became of Varian Wrynn

95262.objectivesText: Enter Alcaz Prison and learn what became of the King of Stormwind.
95262.title: The Secret Prison

95263.description: <The King is dead--killed in an escape attempt just before the Naga attacked. This is devastating news and will shake Stormwind to its core. You need to return to Sully and tell him what you've learned as quickly as possible.>
95263.objectivesText: Return to Sully McCleary in Dustwallow Marsh.
95263.title: Somber News

95264.description: Shaw needs to know as soon as possible. Head back to Stormwind and deliver the news. Please, I beg ye, tell no one else. This could be disastrous for Stormwind and it needs to be handled delicately.
95264.objectivesText: Bring the news to Matthias Shaw in Stormwind.
95264.title: Shaw Needs To Know

95267.description:
The last part's <hic> easy...just take that big ball 'a guts, aaand chuck it in the water! Er...not here though...that'd be a disaster.

Go to those <hic> murloc islands, where ya found the drawing. Look for fresh wreckage in the water. That's where you gotta throw the bait.

Soon as that thing sticks its head up, chop it off! We'll make a decoration of it...for the boat!
95267.objectivesText: Use the Big Ball o' Bait to lure out the sea monster. Then, bring its head to Argo Brinewhistle.
95267.title: The Monster Surfaces

95283.description:
Lok-tar, $n. I find myself in need of assistance with a serious matter. 

Some time ago we dispatched a contingent of Kor'kron Elite to Dustwallow Marsh on a special mission. The problem is, we are far past their scheduled check-in with no word from them.

Head down to Brackenwall Village in Dustwallow Marsh and speak with an orc named Nazeer Bloodspike. No one is more knowledgeable about the state of Dustwallow than he. Find out what you can.
95283.objectivesText: Speak with Nazeer Bloodspike in Brackenwall Village.
95283.title: The Missing Kor'kron

95284.description:
A small force of Kor'kron soldiers passed through here a few days ago. Never told me why they were here, and I didn't ask. They bought supplies, took a bit of rest, then moved on.

The Kor'kron are the elite of the elite and tougher than elekk hooves, but I can't help feeling that something went wrong.

I did overhear one of them mention "the island", and there's an island called Alcaz just off the coast. It's a really nasty place. Get some friends and look into what befell these Kor'kron.
95284.title: The Elite of the Elite

95285.description:
<Sergeant Ulka struggles to sit up to speak with you. You offer your hand in aid, but she merely swats it away.>

Alright recruit... let's get you caught up.
95285.objectivesText: Speak with Sergeant Ulka to learn more about the situation on Alcaz Isle.
95285.title: Right Place, Wrong Time

95294.description:
Friz sure knows how to get her point across. Well, you won't hear any objections from me. The Eastsea pirates won't interfere with her business. In exchange, maybe we can come to an arrangement. Pirating's a little difficult when you've got a scorned goblin sending marauding adventurers after you all day.

Run along back to your master, $c. Let Friz know there's a new captain in charge, and he foresees a profitable relationship in our future.
95294.objectivesText: Return to Friz Frazzlespark in Powderfuse Port.
95294.title: Smuggler's Bargain

95314.description:
Before the Scourge invasion, the reclusive village of Shadowvale was known for its Whispering Elixir. Distilled from herbs found only in Tyr's Fall, the elixir was sought by apothecaries, mystics, and poisoners alike even after being banned in the city.

I've had requests from a number of buyers eager to get their hands on some elixir. Travel to the ruins of Shadowvale deep in the Whispering Forest to the west. I'm prepared to offer significant compensation if you can recover some bottles for me.
95314.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Bottles of Whispering Elixir from Shadowvale, then return to Carolai Anise in Brill.
95314.title: That Shadowvale Green Elixir

95315.description:
Word from one of our scouts suggests a large force of enemies amassing to the far, far south, well beyond the Wetlands.

Even more curious is there appears to be an alliance settlement out there. Farholde? The name sounds familiar.

Let's not wait on this. Best to begin the conversation before it's too late. We're dealing with enough here as it is.

Take this correspondence and deliver it to whoever claims to be the leader of this detachment.
95315.objectivesText: Deliver Captain Nials' Correspondence to Demar Brant at Farholde Keep along the southeastern coast in the Riverglades.
95315.title: The Riverglades Report

95318.description:
So in order to really disrupt operations here and get me out of this cage, we're going to have to kill four very powerful mortals. This cage has demonic wards on it that won't be dispelled until all four are dead, and that key can't be used until the wards are down.

Look, you seem like |5$r that can hold your own but I'm going to need a bit more convincing that you can actually take on these stupid warlocks before I give you any good info.

Like killing a ton of these warlocks for starters. Easy, no?
95318.title: Taste of Ash

95319.description:
Listen, I know you can smell the fel blood pools behind me and I'm sure you've seen the crystals that grow out of them. These crystals have special properties from the ashes of Archimonde that rain down on this side of the hill.

Something about how they are formed makes them especially good at draining fel energies, which is a big problem for someone like me, but they can still have their uses.

I want you to gather some for me. Try and get a few kinds. I'll know what I need when I see it.
95319.objectivesText: Gather $1oa Fel-Slime Crystals and $2oa Pristine Fel-Slime Crystal.
95319.title: Crystalline Collection

95322.description:
Your timin' couldn't be better, friend. I was just on my way to collect my shipment from the Bloodsail Buccaneers. They're good friends of mine. Always happy to supply anything Friz is willin' to pay for.

But, ahem, just in case, it couldn't hurt for you to be my liaison. A good caravaneer knows it doesn't hurt to show off a little muscle. Just as a deterrent, of course.

They said they left my stuff in a chest on the hill outside of town for safekeepin'. Why don't you take a look for me, eh?
95322.objectivesText: Find the Bloodsail Trunk outside of Booty Bay in Stranglethorn Vale.
95322.title: Get the Goods

95325.description:
I already spent good coin on that crate. We ain't just going to let them have it!

You want your shipment? Go to the Venture Co's camp up north and find out who's responsible for this backstabbin'! This ain't about money anymore, $n. This is about justice! And maybe a little about the money.
95325.objectivesText: Find the Venture Co. Ledger in the Venture Co. Camp near Lake Nezferiti in Stranglethorn.
95325.title: We've Been Robbed!

95327.description:
Looks like a deal's a deal. The Venture Co. got their comeuppance, Friz gets her loot, and everybody's happy. Overall a pretty smooth transaction if I do say so myself.

Now scram, I got another shipment comin' in soon from some Southsea Pirates.
95327.objectivesText: Return to Friz Frazzlespark at Powderfuse Port in the Riverglades.
95327.title: All's Well That Ends Well

95378.description:
It is time to cut off the heads of this hydra, if you catch my meaning.

There are three leaders who need to be killed in order to slow the operations here. Conveniently, they also need to be slain to remove the wards on my cage.

Tyaeha can be found in the House of Diseases by the creepy tree. Dazka is in the Alchemist ward with all the potions, and that fool Frezzlie is undoubtedly next to the slime pits along the northern ridge of the encampment.

Go slay them and bring me their bones!
95378.objectivesText: Retrieve the bones of Frezzlie Popwhiz, Tyaeha Darkoath and Dazka Shadowsleep.
95378.title: The Hydra's Head

95379.description:
Brashann Grimdark, Master of Vessels.

<Felflick's mouth curls into a snarl.>

He was the one to subjugate me at the summit. HE is the reason I am here in the first place.

His work with these fel-ash crystals are the backbone of this operation. He's been obsessively experimenting with anchoring souls in these crystals and his work has not gone unnoticed by those Blackthorne creeps.

Use this pristine crystal to drain his power, then put an end to him and bring me his soulstone.
95379.objectivesText: Slay Brashann Grimdark and search his body for his soulstone.
95379.title: A Revenge So Sweet

95383.description:
<Wharfmaster Steamfizzle inspects the coin you offered him.>

Whoa-ho! Ol' Friz sure is training the new generation right. Apologies for the delay, $Gsir:ma'am;. You're here to deliver a crate to someone in town, right? I don't know anythin' about that, but if I did, I'd go talk with Tazzik on the dock. He seems to be interested in things like that.

But be quick about it though, yeah? Don't need folks gettin' the wrong idea, ya know.
95383.objectivesText: Deliver Friz's Secret Stash to Tazzik in Steamwheedle Port.
95383.title: Shipping and Handling

95384.description: <The strange symbols on the magical scroll confound you. Though you do not speak the language recorded, you don't sense any particularly volatile forces within. Perhaps a collector of odd magics would find some use for the scroll.>
95384.objectivesText: Bring the partial scroll to Dudd Fizzlescroll in Booty Bay.
95384.title: Partial Mystical Notes

95385.description: <Faint magic emanates from the scrap of scroll. The language is unfamiliar, though you intuit that it is not dangerous. Most would find the parchment useless, but there may be a unique collector that may find some use out of it.>
95385.objectivesText: Bring the partial scroll to Dudd Fizzlescroll in Booty Bay.
95385.title: Torn Mystical Scroll

95417.description:
Clubtoe see friends go. Some no come back. Some come back purple. Dat weird. Purple ones no act like friends no more.

Where others go? Why they no come back? Make Clubtoe think.

You hit hard. Maybe you go find friends in cave? Maybe you turn purple. Dat weird too.
95417.objectivesText: Find missing ogres in the caves beneath Sunnyglade for Clubtoe.
95417.title: The Purple Ones

95418.description:
Me done with Twilight. Clubtoe free ogre now.

Me go find Clugfist. He biggestest ogre Clubtoe ever see. He leave Twilight. Take many friends with him. It Clubtoe's turn. Me join free ogres. They go to the hills. Clubtoe miss hills. No more smashing rocks. Maybe you come sometime?

Me stay here till coast is clear. You take Chogg'Zac's heads back to friends. Well. Maybe one head. Me get one too. Fair trade.
95418.objectivesText: Deliver the head of Chogg to Tran'gul in Rog'mar.
95418.title: Spread the Word

95420.description:
Clearly these wayward ogres are no friends to the Twilight's Hammer. We orcs have an honored history fighting alongside ogres, and it may be time to call upon those old alliances again. And this head may be the key.

There have been reports of ogre activity in the hills far to the north. If this Clubtoe is to be believed, that must be where this clan calls home. Go to their stronghold and offer this trophy as a token of our friendship. With luck, they will listen to your proposal before they step on you.
95420.objectivesText: Deliver Chogg's head to the ogre city to the north.
95420.title: Land of Giants

95424.description:
Here ogres value strength and blood.

Weak ones leave Bolder'ok. Go back to Twilight's Hammer.

You no big. Maybe you strong. Show Clugfist strength and smash weak ogres. If tiny creature can.
95424.objectivesText: Kill $1oa Twilight Maulers and $2oa Twilight Firecallers for Clugfist in Bolder'ok.
95424.title: Might Makes Right

95425.description:
Klunk once Clugfist's greatest champion. Him strong. Me give Klunk mighty weapon.

But Clugfist wrong. Klunk weak like others. He leave Bolder'ok. Return to Twilight's Hammer. Take ogres with him to cave east to water. Take mighty weapon with him!

That Clugfist weapon! Bash Klunk's skull and take back Skullbasher. He nobody's champion!
95425.objectivesText: Collect Skullthumper from Klunk for Clugfist in Bolder'ok.
95425.title: Unworthy Champion

95431.description:
As I've shadowed our enemy's movements, I have discovered a weakness among their ranks. Ogre dissidents have begun to rebel, seeking the same freedom as their Bolder'ok kin. Word of your deeds has spread. We must exploit this.

I spied a Bolder'ok warrior heading to the caves west of here in search of his brothers and sisters. Find him, and join his efforts to rally his people.
95431.objectivesText: Look for the Bolder'ok ogre in the nearby cave.
95431.title: Rumblings of Discontent

95432.description:
When Crag'rog hear $r-ling free ogres, Crag'og want free ogres too.

With tiny $c here, we smash Twilight together. Break them bones. Make them scream. Free ogres! Then be home in time for stew.
95432.title: Rise Up!

95494.description:
I need someone with a strong sword arm and some extra time on their hands to help me gather some lion hides. It stings my pride to ask a stranger for this aid, but I took an injury to my leg recently. Until I heal, I'm in no shape to go hunting myself but I have obligations to keep.

The big ones in this area generally have the best hides, so start with those first.
95494.objectivesText: Collect 6 Savannah Lion Hides from the Savannah Matriarchs and Savannah Patriarchs in the Barrens.
95494.title: Bruised Pride and Lion Hides

95495.description:
These hides are bound for a tanner who I often trade with. He is something of a hermit and he lives alone on the top of the ridge behind me. Climbing up a steep hillside isn't something I can manage easily right now so I'd be in your debt if you could make this delivery for me.

Oh, and about this tanner's... appearance. You need not be alarmed. In spite of his looks, he is no threat. I swear this is true.
95495.objectivesText: Bring the Bundle of Hides to the hermit on the ridge overlooking the Dry Hills in the Barrens.
95495.title: The Hermit Tanner

95508.description:
Yes, I used to be a member of the Kul Tiras navy. After Lord Admiral took Theramore and started his campaign in Durotar, I had... "objections" to his methods. Particularly the methods involving executing civilians.

There's more to the story but... wait... what's that?

There's a group of men coming up the ridge!
95508.objectivesText: Help Walton survive the encounter with Terry Longdrink and the Kul Tiras marines.
95508.title: Unwelcome Guests

95534.description:
<The note is singed in places, but is still readable.>

Rumor has it those old bellows have a mind of their own, springing to life when no one is watching. I don't care if it's a ghost story, you'd better get to the bottom of it before I return.

There's great power in Strahnbrad, I know it.

< The rest of the note is singed and torn, as if burnt by fire magic. >

objectives.text: Discover the fiery mystery of Strahnbrad

95534.objectivesText: Solve the mystery of Strahnbrad and report your findings in town in Hillsbrad.
95534.title: Strahnbrad Mystery

95561.description:
<The loud cries of baby Dawnbright echo through Farholde Keep. Tessa looks at you with a tired smile.>

Oh, hello there adventurer. Sorry for the noise. Little Emma here seems to be quite fussy today, but I'm not sure why. Maybe some food will help.

Do you think you could help me find something for her to eat? My husband stepped out to get some supplies so my hands are a little too full to get them myself. If you could find a few apples around here I could make a lovely mash for her.
95561.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Fresh Apples for Tessa Dawnbright in Farholde Keep.
95561.title: Apple of My Eye

95569.description:
The owls are under threat by the fel corruption that afflicts the mountainside, and the creatures poisoned and enraged by those energies. Many owls have abandoned their nests for safer places higher up the mountain. Others have fallen in defense of their young.

For the owls to have a future, their eggs must be protected and their fledglings nurtured. Bring the abandoned eggs to me. You may find eggs in abandoned nests at the base of trees north and east of here.
95569.objectivesText: Rescue $1oa Hyjal Owl Eggs and bring them to Ketharas.
95569.title: Hope for Hatchlings

95601.description:
<This dead ogre must be one of the friends Clubtoe was looking for. The Twilight's Hammer seem to be conducting rituals on their members, empowering some and killing more.

These ritualists and their monstrosities must be stopped before they spread.>
95601.objectivesText: Kill $1oa Empowered Brutes and $2oa Twilight Ritualists then return to Clubtoe in Sunnyglade.
95601.title: The Purple Ones

95602.description:
Me hate smashing rock. All day me smash. Chogg'Zac say so. He big boss. Say we smash tinies, but now we work for tinies. That stupid.

Why smash rock? Me no know. Find shiny light in rocks. Chogg'Zac like shiny, me guess. Are you here for shiny light too? Others won't like that. They really like light. They draw pictures with it.

Clubtoe not get it. Light make Clubtoe feel sick. Me hate light. Me want SMASH shiny pictures! But Chogg'Zac be mad. Squish Clubtoe. That bad. But someone should.
95602.objectivesText: Destroy $1oa Twilight Ritual Circles found throughout the caves underneath Sunnyglade.
95602.title: Sickening Lights

95603.description:
Since brother Lowley and I began serving Farholde in a more secular capacity, the church here has fallen into disuse. I'd like to think that once the fighting is over, we will be able to bring the Light back to this place. Although, I fear that may not be for a long while...

Still, we need to keep the church in working order, in the hope that day will come.

To that end, a colony of bats has taken to roosting in the upper stories of the church. It would be a great help if you could remove them.
95603.objectivesText: Kill 5 Roosting Duskbats in the Farholde Cathedral for Sister Rowland.
95603.title: Bats in the Belfry

95621.description:
This morning I spotted a group of humans searching for something in the valley below. I managed to use my rifle's scope for a better look, and it was clear that they were soldiers sporting the livery of Kul Tiras. 

If you'd be willing to take work from me, travel to where these soldiers made camp near the wrecked caravan to the south. Kill any you find and try to learn why they are here.

objectives.text: Learn why the Kul Tirans are here

95621.objectivesText: Travel to the wrecked caravan and learn more about why the Kul Tirans are here.
95621.title: Trouble in the Valley

95642.description:
You there! Thank the light you've come. Did Amberhall send you to find me?

No? Figures as much. Ashe Amberhall sent me down here to investigate the Twilight's Hammer. As you can see, they are digging for something within the Riverglades, but I need a sample of their witchcraft to figure out what.

It's imperative Farholde gets those samples. Please, $c. Take this catalyst. It's enchanted to absorb the powers of the cult. Runes, cultists, it doesn't matter. Just hold it aloft and it will do the rest.
95642.objectivesText: Absorb $1oa samples into the Crystal Catalyst from Twilight's Hammer cultists and Twilight Ritual Circles in the cave underneath Sunnyglade for Apprentice Claire.
95642.title: Abominable Magics

95643.description:
As Lady Amberhall's apprentice in the dark arts, I may not look it but I'm usually quite capable of handling things on my own. I did not, however, anticipate an entire cave of void-infused ogres.

If you managed to get all the way down here without being captured, you must be powerful yourself. I was not so lucky with those ogres and their masters roaming about. Do the world a favor and kill the hideous beasts. Nothing good comes from a fanatic with a purpose, empowered or otherwise.
95643.objectivesText: Kill $1oa Twilight Ritualists and $1oa Empowered Brutes within the caves underneath Sunnyglade.
95643.title: Indiscriminate Purge

95646.description:
These brackish wetlands hold a greater well of unsalted southern waters. It pains me, yet within my roots I sense a corruption seeping through that mountain gully.

The creatures, like those in our lowlands, react more bitterly to the taint. Lacking the sea's hardening salt since life's dawn, they have little strength against such evil.

Go to those highlands, and bring me the Highland Horror's root core.
95646.objectivesText: Kill a Highland Horror within Excavation Sites and bring its root core to Rethiel the Greenwarden in the Wetlands.
95646.title: Horrors in the Highland

95647.description:
My husband, Ardin, has a rare gift for sensing nature. He'll scale any peak to gather the herbs and flowers I need for my alchemy, keeping our shelves and pantry stocked.

But I fear he's wandered into trouble. An excavation crew passed through seeking supplies. They spoke, among other things, of towering grasses unlike anything they'd ever seen. Those were what he told me he had to go see for himself. He's been gone too long!

If you learn anything of him, I'd be grateful.

objectives.text: Learn what happened to Ardin Grassman

95647.objectivesText: Find Ardin Grassman in the Excavation Sites.
95647.title: Lost in the Thicket Things

95663.description:
The Dragonmaw are a formidable clan.

They're known for binding magic strong enough to make dragons serve, and rumor claims they're preparing some display of it in the Wetlands. Whether truth or bluster, the Deathstalkers can't act on half-formed whispers. Broken symbols carried only that much to me.

A deathstalker agent needs a hand in the hills above the Dragonmaw encampment. Meet her there. She'll reveal the next steps.
95663.objectivesText: Travel to the Wetlands and meet the Deathstalker Agent in the hills above the Dragonmaw camp.
95663.title: Dragonmaw Rumors

95697.description:
Zamja tells me we need more homestyle cooking.
If we start selling raptor, she thinks it'll draw in customers who don't usually visit Borstan's Firepit.

Her idea is not so bad. But I want something that rises above the smells of our birth villages. We're in Orgrimmar! Borstan should serve a grand take on their familiar favorites.

A hunter recently came back from the Wetlands with a giant talon from the thicket raptors in the Excavation Sites.

Up for a job?
95697.objectivesText: Enter the Excavation Sites in the Wetlands and bring back Thicket Raptor Meat.
95697.title: Changing Tastes

95737.description:
From time to time, I correspond with others in my craft--herbalists or eccentrics who study rare plants and local oddities. We trade discoveries, and sometimes warnings of what lies ahead.

One alchemist in the Wetlands wrote of an excavation team her husband was part of, uncovering signs of a long-lost primordial grass... but she never sent word of its abundance or accessibility.

If you can, check on Caitlin Grassman in Menethil Harbor.
95737.objectivesText: Speak with Caitlin Grassman in Menethil Harbor.
95737.title: Seeking Caitlin

95748.description:
This is odd. This piece of the tablet you have brought me refers to the lost city of I'lalai as if it is a massive sprawling civilization. But the ruins off of the reef are not large enough to be something of that size.

$n, to the north of the Vile Reef there is an ancient troll ruin on the hills along the coast. A tablet that contains legends of the lost troll city is within. I wish to study this legend further.

Take this hide and charcoal to create a rubbing of this tablet, then return to me.
95748.objectivesText: Use the hide and charcoal to create a rubbing of the Third Troll Legend tablet.
95748.title: The Gurubashi Legends of Old

95753.description:
<The totem pulses with wild magic. The image of a ghostly wolf appears in your mind, beckoning you. 

It appears to be offering you a challenge.

Another totem--a twin to the one that your hand now rests upon, appears in the distance just beyond the large sun-bleached skeleton nearby.>
95753.objectivesText: Reach the other Odd Totem at the end of the massive skeleton before time runs out.
95753.title: Challenge of the Desert Wolf

95766.description:
The cycle of renewal has finally begun. The ancients... shall rise again, and the power of the natural world take its course... to bloom.

You... have helped us tip the scales in nature's favor. Perhaps... we can yet make a larger impact... on a more dire situation.

Head west... where the land itself is ashen... and you may find an entity who can help. She may look like just a small bird... but her power is great.
95766.objectivesText: Find the strange bird in the corrupted lands on the southwest slope.
95766.title: Fine Feathered Friend

95769.description:
Every day be a challenge when you living rough like we do! Takes a toll on your tools, your clothes, your whole life. Good thing it can't take our spirit!

We be really hurting from our clothes and blankets wearing out. You do some tailoring, right? So maybe you can bring me some Bolts of Runecloth and I can fix a few holes?
95769.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Bolts of Runecloth to Mez'dan in Elderwild on Mount Hyjal.
95769.title: Threading a Solution

95770.description:
After rereading the legend, it doesn't seem like we are in the wrong place for the lost city, but perhaps there is yet some detail that has been overlooked.

In my younger years I used to dive in the Vile Reef ruins, but that was before the murlocs settled there. If memory serves there was a cavern there.

I have heard that there are now naga gathering in that region, which is unusual. I want to know what has lured them there.

Go and explore just west of the Vile Reef and return to me with any news.
95770.objectivesText: Explore the Vile Reef and find the cavern entrance.
95770.title: Locating the Lost City

95772.description:
Me brother tried draggin' me off tae the Wetlands with some diggin' crew out o' Loch Modan. Said they were headin' into hills no dwarf's ever set boot in for some sort o' excavation.

Aye, I'd 'ave gone, if I wasn't already behind on this pile o' girdles I've got to refit.

Daewyn normally writes after he sends off, though. Haven't heard a thing, gives me a strange feelin' this time.

If yer marchin' that way, mind checking in on me brother?
95772.objectivesText: Look for Dorin Songblade's brother, Daewyn, in Whelgar's Excavation Site.
95772.title: Songblade Search

95774.description:
The healer who saved me could not save her, and she has died in battle. Her name is Olgra, and I will never forget her.

You did not find her adornments on her body? She wore many jewels of polished bone.

Slay the Razormane Raiders near where she fell, and find her precious works of art!

I will place them with the memorial that I build in her memory.
95774.objectivesText: Slay quilboars and collect $1oa of Olgra's Adornments for Mankrik's memorial.
95774.title: Her Name Is Olgra

95775.description:
What I am about to ask you is no small feat, $c, and will likely require strong allies to accomplish.

I want to know more about the ruins on the other side of the cavern the naga are guarding. If my suspicions prove correct, it could indeed be the lost city of I'lalai. The amount of lost historical knowledge at our fingertips could be unrivaled, but I am too old to venture myself.

Enter the ruins and gather etchings of any tablets you find there, then return to me.
95775.objectivesText: Use the hide and charcoal to create rubbings of the tablets found in the Drowned City.
95775.title: The Drowned City

95776.description:
You have done well to slay the naga just off of our coast, but the fact that they are in our waters in such numbers means there is yet a larger threat.

I have spoken to Kin'weelay, and he thinks these Brinescale naga are infiltrating the ruins of the Drowned City. If the naga are there, then they are up to no good and are likely searching for something.

We can't let them get their hands on anything that could compromise us here and it is time to put an end to this. Slay their leader and return to me.
95776.objectivesText: Slay Var'Taka in the Drowned City.
95776.title: The Only Good Brinescale...

95787.description:
<Loremaster Dibbs' hands shake as he reads the scouting report and the troll legends.>

Could it be? By this account it sounds like the lost troll city of I'lalai has risen just off the coast of Stranglethorn! We must investigate immediately. Why, if my research is correct this could be the archeological discovery of the century!

Please, I know it is a long trek back to Stranglethorn but if you find yourself in this Drowned City, collect any legends you find there and return them to me.
95787.objectivesText: Use the hide and charcoal to create rubbings of the tablets found in the Drowned City.
95787.title: Take Two With Water

95788.description:
The Skullsplitter fetishes Brother Nimetz sent with you are indeed powerful, though I do not think they contributed to Kurzen's condition, or at least not directly.

Still, if the rumors are true and the lost troll city of I'lalai has indeed risen from its watery grave, it is possible the dark magics used to raise the doomed city may be related.

If you dare to venture into the Drowned City of I'lalai, please gather any troll fetishes you find and bring them here to me for further study.
95788.objectivesText: Collect $1oa I'lalai Fetishes from trolls in the Drowned City.
95788.title: Magics of the Drowned City

95789.description:
Hey pal, you look like you can handle yourself in a fight.

Baron Revilgaz has me keep'n my ear to the ground for magical objects. Word on the street is that a sunken troll ruin has mysteriously become, eh, un-sunk, which means there are a lot of unclaimed goods, if you catch my meaning.

Problem is, it's also caught the eye of pirates! Not just any pirates, the Saltseers specifically collect magical artifacts. I need you to go into the Drowned City, clear them out and take their stolen artifacts.
95789.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Voodoo Infused Artifacts from Saltseer pirates in the Drowned City.
95789.title: Shady Saltseers

95791.description:
The Saltseer pirates have been a thorn in my side recently and knowing they're in the Drowned City makes it worse! I mean they're always bad news, but there is one captain in particular I want outta the picture. That damned Captain Dreadrise!

He and his crew are very accomplished at gathering all the magical artifacts I've been after, and I'm tired of the competition.

I want you to remove Captain Dreadrise and his Saltseer Coroners from the picture. Permanently.
95791.objectivesText: Slay 3 Saltseer Coroners and Captain Dreadrise in the Drowned City.
95791.title: The Saltseer Captain

95793.description:
Ah, a $c. I see great strength and determination in you--qualities necessary to rid these lands of evil.

The demons that walked these lands during the great battle were defeated, yet some still remain. It is important to prevent them from escaping.

The ruins to the east are dangerous. Carry your strength into their den. Destroy the unwelcome before our lands perish.
95793.title: Stemming the Demon Tide

95795.description:
<You cover the dwarf's body with his cloak.>

Travel to Lakeshire and personally inform Dorin Songblade what became of his brother within the Excavation Sites.
95795.title: Fallen in the Fen

95798.description:
$n, I want you to take this I'lalai Fetish to my friend Abra in Dalaran. I would love to have her examine it if she has the time to do so.

She is also particularly interested in troll practices and magic, so I believe this discovery will be exciting for her to unravel.

Do be careful, though. The Kirin Tor can be a bit particular about who they let into their grand city. If you haven't already become a noteworthy visitor, you may need to find a way into their good graces.
95798.objectivesText: Bring the I'lalai Fetish to Abra Cadabra in Dalaran.
95798.title: The Web of Magic

95803.description:
Now that we've claimed the head of the tarnished commander, I need you to deliver it to the Undercity. Sylvanas Windrunner mistrusts us greatly, and all but openly disparages us.

Deliver Rudolph Gelhardt's head to the Dark Lady. Show her that we tend to our own house and are devoted to the prosperity of the forsaken.
95803.objectivesText: Bring the head of Rudolph Gelhardt to Sylvanas Windrunner in the Undercity.
95803.title: A Token of Good Faith

95809.description:
I need a moment to rest before I find my own way out.

<He pulls some reeds from his pack and quickly braids and bends them into a heart.>

Take this, and bring it back to Caitlin. Let her know I'll be home soon! Now that we have a path cleared out thanks to you, I'll gather my bushels and follow your trail.

Thank you.
95809.objectivesText: Return to Caitlin Grassman in Menethil Harbor.
95809.title: Heartwoven

95810.description:
You pick up a fractured piece of the rock-mech automaton. It has a texture unlike anything you've touched before, a composite material of unknown makeup. This is certainly bound to be more 'device' than 'debris.'

Prospector Whelgar himself at his excavation site might have something useful to share about the relic.
95810.objectivesText: Bring the Titan Relic to Prospector Whelgar in the Wetlands excavation site.
95810.title: Lost Relic Carry

95882.description:
An Alliance scouting party has been seen on a small island northeast of Rog'mar. They are led by a scoutmaster who has made tracking enemy movements increasingly difficult. The bastard even named his filthy pet after me as an open mockery. He knows I'm hunting him.

This human has eyes everywhere, and they need to be put out. I already claimed one before he managed to flee. Bring me his other as proof that the scoutmaster is no more. Show him he is not as untouchable as he thinks.

-- Neza Bloodsnout
95882.objectivesText: Bring the Scoutmaster's Eye to Neza Bloodsnout in Rog'mar.
95882.title: WANTED: Scoutmaster Vargas

95883.description:
<The preparations for a hastily-assembled ritual are gathered unceremoniously on the altar. According to the scrap of note, everything has been gathered. All that's missing are the offering of blood and the Tortured Soul.

The undead around you look tortured enough. They may have what you seek.>
95883.objectivesText: Collect a Tortured Soul from the nearby undead in Beren's Peril in Silverpine Forest.
95883.title: The Tortured Soul

95885.description:
<All that's left now is the offering of blood.

The note scrap mentioned a 'willing sacrifice.'

An intense sense of dread washes over you.>
95885.objectivesText: Use the Tortured Soul to give an offering of blood at the Offering Stone in Beren's Peril.
95885.title: The Offering of Blood

95924.description:
Ye there! Aye, I'm talkin' ta ye! We've made the discovery of a lifetime down in Un'Goro! Can ye believe it?

There's just one problem... our dig site's been overrun by voracious beasts of the killin' nature. Very unpleasant indeed.

With yer help, we can reclaim our camp and git back ta workin'. Now, what do ye say? I'll make it worth yer while.
95924.objectivesText: Slay 6 Ravasaur Matriarchs, 9 Ironhide Ravasaurs and Venomridge in Shaper's Terrace.
95924.title: Panic at the Digsite

95925.description:
$C, we've made the discovery of a lifetime! I can't believe it; the ruins in Un'Goro are open!

We've already sent a team but they have encountered... trouble. If you're headed in there anyway would ya be able to finish this map?

It sounds like there's an Achromatic Crystal in there and an unearthed watcher somewhere near a giant Western Gate that sounds interesting.

The other landmarks that would be helpful are the Pillar of Assimilation, the Western Gate and the Regrowth Vestibule.
95925.objectivesText: Find Interesting Landmarks in Shaper's Terrace and fill out the explorer's map at each.
95925.title: Mapping the Way Forward

95934.description:
My surveying tools show signs of a never-before-seen mineral in these caves. Cubic draconia, I call it. Probably worth a fortune.

Exciting as this is, no one's gonna come help me dig it up if I can't show 'em proof that it exists. Sure, I have the readings from my tools, but people like to hold a big shiny crystal, not look at charts.

I'm sure there's a few crystals poking up from the dirt in there. If you're willing to dodge a few dragons and get one, you'd really be helpin' a gal out.
95934.objectivesText: Find a piece of Cubic Draconia for Gelinda Coppergleam.
95934.title: Proof of Profit

95943.description:
G'day, $Glad:lass;. Name's Bertrand, Bertrand Ironbrow! At yer service.

<Bertrand extends a filthy hand.>

These fine folk contracted me tae oversee construction of this here keep. What they lack in experience they make up for in spirit! Problem is, I misplaced me tools.

Had a bit of a run in with a few Twilight in a small grove northwest o' here. Had to choose between me life or me tools. On one hand, I'm alive. On the other... ye see where this is goin'.

Think ye could help find me tools?
95943.objectivesText: Locate the Foreman's Crate and return it to Bertrand Ironbrow in Farholde Keep.
95943.title: Foreman's Plight

95951.description:
'Ey boss-$Gmon:lady;, ya need help from ol' Tan'jani? Don't worry about it, I fix you up good.

Orcs be good at hittin' humans with axes, but when you wanna stick 'em before dey see ya comin', that's when you call on the headhunters. You wanna learn to stick 'em too? I see it in your eyes, heheh.

First we get you your own spears. Dis one's mine. Go to the human camp to de west and take their wood. Take knife with ya. You can sharpen their lumber into good spears for stickin'. Den bring 'em back.
95951.objectivesText: Collect Wood Bundles from Peasant Woodpiles in Turner's Logging Camp then fletch them into $1oa Makeshift Stickin' Spears.
95951.title: Fetch 'n' Fletch

95955.description:
You got de spears, now ya gonna learn how to throw dem.

De Riverglades be full o' crocolisks. Nasty tings. Snap you up if ya ain't quick. Perfect for target practice, heheh.

Go stick yourself a bunch of dem. Den you come back to ol' Tran'jani for ya prize. If ya can stick a crocolisk, ya can stick any'ting.
95955.objectivesText: Impale $1oa Freshwater Crocolisks then return to Tran'jani in Rog'mar.
95955.title: Stick 'Em

95975.description:
Tess says little Emm can't sleep without me? And you did all that for them? A total stranger? Damn it. What was I thinking...

Even if I can't guarantee a perfect world for her, I still need to be a part of it. What am I even fighting for if I can't hope for a brighter future?

Thank you for helping my family in my absence, friend, but it's time for me to go home. If I could ask one more favor, can you pick some flowers and take them to Tess? Let her know I'll be home soon? I need to clean up first.
95975.objectivesText: Gather $1oa Wildflowers and deliver them to Tessa Dawnbright in Farholde Keep.
95975.title: Her World

95981.description:
Taking away their pendants is just the first step. If the Kirin Tor really are shipping a steady supply of relics from Dalaran, we must stop them at the source.

Search the roads around Ambermill for Dalaran's wizards and watchers. Their presence has allowed free access across our borders for too long. If we can cull their numbers, that should put a stop to these pendants making it into Silverpine Forest in the first place.
95981.objectivesText: Slay $1oa Dalaran Wizards and $2oa Dalaran Watchers for Shadow Priest Allister in the Sepulcher.
95981.title: Watching the Roads

95982.description:
Folks keep dumpin' their furry friends here like I know what I'm doin'. And then they blame me if they come back and their horse or wolf or... whatever they brought is dead or ran off. What do I look like, I'm runnin' a charity?

You look like you know your way around a trough. Mind whippin' me up some grub I can use to keep these beasties in check?

If you can't make it yourself, someone might be willin' to sell you some. And hurry! Last thing I need is a stampede of hungry animals.
95982.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Briny Seafood Stew to Jasper Geartoggle in Powderfuse Port.
95982.title: Not My Circus

95983.description:
The skeleton is badly mangled. Deep markings on its limbs vaguely match patterns of teeth and claws. Many days beneath the beating sun have made the bones pale and brittle as well. The brutality of both the attacker and the weather have rendered the victim's identity a mystery.

You can't take the whole skeleton with you, but you could bring its skull to the nearby watchman and see what he knows.
95983.objectivesText: Bring the Gnawed Skull to Watcher Cornelius at Terral's Watch.
95983.title: A Feast for Buzzards

95986.description:
The whistle's made, $n. 

Take it, and go to the top of the hill where the lions are. Should be just north of here.

Once you're there, blow the whistle, and our man-eater should appear. I'd tell you not to come back if you don't manage to kill him, but you'll probably be dead anyhow.

Now then, off with you. Let's see if you fare better than our skeletal friend.
95986.objectivesText: Use the Tallstrider Call to call forth the leader of the lion pride. Slay the beast and retrieve its hide for Watcher Cornelius at Terral's Watch.
95986.title: King of the Wild Plains

95992.description:
Dese waters be treacherous. My headhunters keep the paths clear as dey can, but there be a beasty stalkin' de rivers even we cannot catch. Excitin', eh?

Boss say we gotta clear it out, so we got a little competition goin'. Find de white one patrollin' de rivers and bring me its fang. Whoever sticks this slippery crocolisk win de whole pot. Just don't get snapped yourself, heheh!

-- Tan'jani
95992.objectivesText: Bring Ghostmaw's Fang to Tan'jani in Rog'mar.
95992.title: WANTED: Ghostmaw

95998.description:
Well howdy there, $c. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. Good for you. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

It's a big wide world out there and you'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful. Not sure how your outdoorsman skills are but I reckon I could teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire, get comfy. I'll walk you through it.
95998.objectivesText: Sit near Sam's Basic Campfire and wait until you receive the Boosted Rest buff.
95998.title: The Great Outdoors

95999.description:
Wanted! Incinerator Gar'im, Leader of an orc incursion in Render's Valley. Purported to be working with the Blackrock of Stonewatch Keep.

Beware of Incinerator Gar'im. He and his Shadowcasters are extremely dangerous. A handsome reward will be given to any brave soul that can deliver proof of Incinerator Gar'im's demise to Magistrate Solomon.
95999.objectivesText: Deliver the Broken Staff of Incinerator Gar'im to Magistrate Solomon in Lakeshire.
95999.title: WANTED: Incinerator Gar'im

96010.description:
Although I am sure we can attribute the damage to both pylons to the reckless centaur stomping about, I suspect the timing of their rampage resulted in the shards being separated. I know little about their quarrels, but I do know there are at least two main factions that have trespassed into Shen'dralas: the ferocious Magram and the cunning Gelkis.

Keeping these treasures in the midst of a battlefield would be unwise. By now, I am assuming they have taken their trophies back to their own villages.
96010.objectivesText: Recover shards and fragments of the pylons, found guarded at the Magram and Gelkis villages. Return them to Mordent Evenshade.
96010.title: Fragments of the Pylons

96015.description:
We should be thankful that our foe is stupid. An army of ogres at their disposal, and the Twilight's Hammer have them working in the mines nowhere near the fight. I don't know if I chalk it up to mismanagement or an internal struggle, but either way they're in no position to defend themselves.

That's where we come in. With the cult's focus divided, we have an opportunity to strike the enemy while they're vulnerable and split them further. Go to this mine and sow some chaos among their ranks.
96015.objectivesText: Defeat $1oa Ogre Miners and $2oa Twilight Subjugators in the cave near the Twilight's Shroud for Sergeant Riftan.
96015.title: A Miner Problem

96026.description:
Dese good rock. Now need finishing touch. More rock.

Only rock can make rock stronger. Dat the way of rocks.

Me see some tinies make extra heavy rock. Bring me heavy rocks and me make weapon.
96026.objectivesText: Deliver $1oa Heavy Weightstones to Hamur in Bolder'ok.
96026.title: Step Two: More Rock

96031.description:
You've become a leatherworker. Good for you, $c. I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to make yourself a tent that will keep you cool on hot days, and dry on rainy days.

With a good tent over your head, you'll ensure that you get all the rest you need to stay sharp on your travels.
96031.objectivesText: Speak with Gretta Finespindle in Ironforge to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
96031.title: Camping 101: Leatherworking

96047.description:
So you've taken up First Aid? That's an honorable... and pragmatic pursuit as a $c.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a First Aid Kit for your camp. Injuries are a reality in the world of adventuring and offering some much-needed healing at your camp could even save lives.

objectives.text: Raise your first aid skill to 20

96047.objectivesText: Speak with Thamner Pol in Kharanos to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
96047.title: Camping 101: First Aid

96055.description:
Looks to me like you've gained some skill in herbalism. Picking flowers isn't just for dilly-dallying, you know. It can be useful... and profitable.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Incense Candle for your camp. High spirits are a key component to keeping healers and spellcasters in the fight, and an Incense Candle can provide a boost that magic users will surely appreciate.
96055.objectivesText: Speak with Reyna Stonebranch in Ironforge to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
96055.title: Camping 101: Herbalism

96059.description:
Now that you've begun your journey into being an enchanter, I reckon I can teach you how to craft an Enchanted Lute for your camp once you've learned the ropes.

It's so important to find entertainment during your downtime, and this bit of magic can help ensure you are ready to weather all sorts of challenges when you hit the old dusty trail once again.
96059.objectivesText: Speak with Thonys Pillarstone in Ironforge to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
96059.title: Camping 101: Enchanting

96067.areaDescription: Fight G45-B4G in a stress test of Sleebo's engine.
96067.description:
You may have noticed my mechanical companion here, G45-B4G. Whirlin' around in that burlap chest of his is the one, and only, working prototype of my gas-powered engine.

I figure it's in need of some stress testing. How'd you like to take him on in a fight? I can power him up with the gas you've collected.

Oh, and don't worry about hurting him. He can't feel a thing!
96067.title: Rock 'em and Sock 'em

conditionalDescriptions.text:
$n, you know our tribe keeps our traditions alive by oral storytelling and passing legends such as these to the next generation. No doubt you yourself have learned lessons and heard such cautionary tales in your youth.

These etchings must be taken to our spiritual leader, Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village. I am sure he would be happy to see you again, and he will wish to hear the truth of this tale.

I have prepared an extra copy of this tale for you as well. If you ever lose your copy I would be happy to create another, for a small fee.

96078.description:
$n, we Darkspear keep much of our traditions alive by oral storytelling. We pass legends such as these to the next generation, teaching lessons and weaving cautionary tales to our younglings.

These etchings must be taken to our spiritual leader, Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village. He is one of the wisest Darkspear and he will wish to hear the truth of this tale.

I have prepared an extra copy of this tale for you as well. If you ever lose your copy, I would be happy to create another, for a small fee.
96078.objectivesText: Take the tablet etchings to Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village in Durotar.
96078.title: A Tale Spun Around the Fire

96082.description:
I will fashion the cloth you've given me into bandages. In the meantime, please take these ones that I have already made, and dress the wounds of the soldiers who need it. It should be a matter of basic first aid.

Your assistance here is both necessary, and highly appreciated. I simply cannot be everywhere at once.
96082.objectivesText: Bandage up 3 Wounded Soldiers for Brother Lowley.
96082.title: Doctor's Orderly

96084.description:
I will spare you the grisly details, but these soldiers are violently ill. The nature of their sickness leads me to believe there is an issue with either their food or their water.

I've already checked the crops coming in from the nearby farms, so this only leaves the water, which comes from the local rivers. The best place to collect a sample is from the pools in the plains to the north. Nearly every river runs through the area, so it would be wise to check for contamination there.
96084.objectivesText: Collect a sample of drinking water from the plains for Sister Rowland at the chapel in Farholde Keep.
96084.title: Something's in the Water

96101.description:
Greetings, $c. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

You'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.
96101.objectivesText: Sit near Raan's Basic Campfire and wait until you receive the Boosted Rest buff.
96101.title: The Great Outdoors

96102.description:
Tailoring is a surprisingly potent tradeskill to invest in, and I'm sure it'll serve you well.

I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Faction Banner for your camp, provided you have the skill for it. Inspiration and morale are a key part of success on any battlefield, and an inspirational banner can go a long way to keeping you energized.
96102.objectivesText: Speak with Snang in Orgrimmar to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
96102.title: Camping 101: Tailoring

96104.description:
These markings are from a lion. By the look of them, this one is especially large--the leader of the nearby pride.

I would gladly hunt the beast myself, but you have first claim. Instead, I will aid you.

I can make a whistle that mimics the call of a wounded tallstrider. You can use it to lure the lion out. I'll just need one of their beaks to give it the right sound.

There are tallstriders all over the plains. Find me a beak and the hunt can begin!
96104.objectivesText: Bring an Intact Tallstrider Beak to Neza Bloodsnout at Rog'mar.
96104.title: Song of the Strider

96105.description:
The whistle is made, $n.

Take it and go to the top of the hill south where the lions dwell.

Once you are ready to face your quarry, blow the whistle and the beast should appear.

I wish you luck in your hunt. May you return in glory.
96105.objectivesText: Use the Tallstrider Call to call forth the leader of the lion pride. Slay the beast and retrieve its hide for Neza Bloodsnout at Rog'mar.
96105.title: King of the Wild Plains

96108.description:
Arrows are always essential, but sometimes you need something more potent to take down your prey.

This is where poison coatings come into play. They ruin the meat, but if you need something dead, they do the job.

Poisons can either be brewed or, if you are brave, gathered. You strike me as the latter.

The vipers by the pools to the south produce a powerful venom. If I have estimated you correctly, I think you could collect some of it.
96108.objectivesText: Bring 4 samples of Glade Viper Venom to Neza Bloodsnout at Rog'mar.
96108.title: Poison Tips

96125.description:
Now that the lion hides have been collected, and the orcish poachers culled, I can finally get a break.

At least, that's what I would say, if the man who was supposed to relieve me of my watch wasn't missing.

Dunston Willis, explorer extraordinaire, went to investigate the ogre settlement to the north a few days ago. He said he'd take over my post upon his return.

Find him. If he's alive, bring him back here. If he's hanging up on meat hooks, bring me proof so Demar can send me someone else.
96125.objectivesText: Find Dunston Willis somewhere among the ogres in Bolder'ok.
96125.title: In Need of Relief

96135.description:
Euck, just bein' around these blasted totems is givin' me the willies--but that's good. This much twisted corruption will be exactly what we need tae summon the quilboar's elementals.

Go to the Thousand Needles and find a suitable spot for your defenses. The steam pools should work. They're rich with fire, earth, water, and air alike. Place these totems and be ready for a fight. The Razormane won't take too kindly to yer interference.
96135.objectivesText: Use the Twisted Totems to put an end to the quilboar ritual.
96135.title: Heed My Call

96137.description:
A small dagger belonging to the self-appointed ranger, Ira, who kept the forests safe by preventing the beasts within from attacking travelers.

With Ira's spirit still wandering the woods, perhaps her unfinished business was to clear out the worg that continue to claim victims throughout the forest.
96137.objectivesText: Defeat $1oa Young Black Ravagers and $2oa Black Ravagers then return to Sirra Von'Indi in Darkshire for more information.
96137.title: Ira's Dagger

96138.description:
A bow left by the spirit of Merrick Valor, famed Watcher who prided himself on keeping the roads safe from encroaching enemies.

With Merrick's spirit still wandering the roads, perhaps his unfinished business was to clear out invaders near his home in Raven Hill. The ogres south of town may be what's troubling his spirit.
96138.objectivesText: Defeat $1oa Splinter Fist Warriors and $2oa Splinter Fist Taskmasters then return to Sirra Von'Indi in Darkshire for more information.
96138.title: Merrick's Bow

96139.description:
In dark times like these, it's important we remember our heroes as much as our foes. Darkshire would not still be standing if it weren't for the bravery of folk like the good Lady Althea or those who lost their lives at Raven Hill.

Have you read much on Raven Hill? No, of course not. Its history was wiped out along with its people. My library, impressive as it is, has little on the subject.

If you happen to find anything, I'd appreciate it if you brought it here. Those folk deserve to be remembered.
96139.objectivesText: Search Raven Hill for anything of interest and return to Sirra Von'Indi in Darkshire.
96139.title: The Valor Family

96204.description:
Now that I'm free I'm going to make these vile creatures regret ever laying eyes on a Windshaper.

Let's get out of here, $c.
96204.objectivesText: Accompany Lumina Windsinger and help her escape Fenris Keep.
96204.title: The Windshaper's Wrath

96209.description:
The ancient, Orokai, stands vigil just outside of town. Take this to him. The ancients are wondrous and wise. Provided this branch has not been separated from its parent tree for too long, he will be able to "speak" with it to learn what tales it has to tell.

You can find Orokai to the southwest of the town, not too far away.
96209.title: The Ancient, Orokai

96260.description:
Have you heard what befell the burial ground at Gloomrise? Giant spiders--rumored to have a venom so strong that it can wake the dead--have spread like wildfire. Nasty business, if you ask me.

One of the scouts dispatched to investigate returned half dead and covered in an incredibly resilient, crystalline spider silk. I harvested what I could, but I would highly value more samples of this silk for additional study.

Bring me more of this crystalline silk and I will reward you.
96260.objectivesText: Gather $1oa strands of Crystalline Silk from Gloomrise Spinners.
96260.title: Stronger than Steel

96261.description:
As is often the case with infestations such as the one we are facing at Gloomrise, a single powerful matriarch often leads to the rapid spread of a hostile spider population.

If we wish to drive these beasts off for good, we'll need to seek out the progenitor and end her. When you go to Gloomrise, seek out the broodmother there and destroy her. I'd advise you to bring allies, and be ready for anything. These seem to be no ordinary spiders.
96261.title: The Broodmother

96264.completionText: Bring the Tattered Note to Veyric Thunderhame in Arathi Highlands.
96264.description:
So yer a big shot shaman now, eh? Ye've mastered the elements and want tae put 'em to good use? I think I got just the thing.
