If ye want the elements' respect, ye gotta repay yer debts to 'em. They help you, you help them. And right now they need all the help they can get from those who would abuse their power.

Earth's rumblin', $n. It speaks of the quilboar amassin' for some ritual of terrible power. We need tae go investigate their kraul and see what they're up to. Bring me back whatever ye find.
96264.objectivesText: Defeat Charlga Razorflank in Razorfen Kraul and collect information on the quilboar's plans.
96264.title: Elemental Aid

96296.description:
<The second you near the pulsing nodule it falls from the tree, exposing a weeping green sap. It seems the tree has corruption within its bark that has spread deep, but the tree is not yet dead.

Looking around it is clear it has spread to some of the surrounding trees, but not all suffer from the same level of corruption.

Perhaps it is not too late to save the infected trees nearby.

Surely the Highfeathers would be grateful if you remove as many corrupted knots as you can find.>
96296.objectivesText: Find and remove $1oa Corrupted Knots from the trees nearby.
96296.title: Fetid Corruption

96321.description:
I... don't have much time, mortal. You must take this staff, a branch of the world tree... corrupted... wrong. I carried it here...

The Wild Gods... they must know. Take it to her. The... crow...

<The dying Wild God grows still and his eyes stare blankly ahead. What little is left of his corporeal form seems to break apart and drift away. There is a faintly glowing branch on the ground, with a sickly green crystal affixed to its head.>
96321.objectivesText: Find someone on Mount Hyjal who may be interested in the Faintly Glowing Staff.
96321.title: The Dying God

96335.description:
Wow! That was impressive. The way you took down that dragon was really something!

While you are here... do you think you might be able to help me get out of this ball and chain?

If he hasn't fled or been killed already, the torturer they call 'The Questioner' should have the keys to these shackles. Get the key from that sadist and bring it to me.

I promise that I'll make it well worth your while if you do.
96335.objectivesText: Recover the Alcaz Shackle Key from The Questioner in Alcaz Prison.
96335.title: The Man in the Iron Chains

96337.description:
I told you that I'd make it worth your while to free me. I don't have any gold for you, but I have something better.

Take this. It will help you find a treasure more valuable than gold. Do what you want with it, but if anyone asks you where you got it, tell them that the person who gave it to you died. 

Tell them he was vaporized by dragonfire... blown out to sea.
96337.objectivesText: Use the note provided by Mason Connery to find his hidden treasure.
96337.title: More Valuable Than Gold

96381.description:
Was spyin' on the shore of Alcaz with my trusty lookin' glass whilst you were off eavesdroppin' on Lady Proudmoore. I think the island may be under attack. I saw naga--lots of them, chargin' onto shore. 

The enemy of my enemy is certainly not my friend when it comes to naga, so let's do the world a favor and take some of them out. I also spied what looks to be the leader--a spellcaster type barkin' orders. Take her out as well, if you can.
96381.objectivesText: Enter the Alcaz Prison and slay $1oa  Strashasz Soldiers, $2oa Strashaz Enchantresses, and bring the head of Tidemistress Ca'zass to Sully McCleary.
96381.title: A Bit of Wet Work

96390.description:
Dark Iron spies have infiltrated Dun Morogh. To what end I canna' be sure, but this is a problem we need to nip in the bud before it is allowed to grow.

Head eastward to Ironband's Compound and kill the Dark Iron spies that you find there.
96390.objectivesText: Slay $1oa Dark Iron Spies in Dun Morogh.
96390.title: Nip 'Em in the Bud

conditionalDescriptions.text:
The map you are holding seems to show a complex series of underground tunnels and highways that all seem to converge on a point underneath Ironforge itself.

You can't be sure what the runes say as they are written in the ugly jagged rune language of the Dark Iron dwarves, but you can guess at the purpose of these tunnels. As you are reading the map, a gust of wind washes over you and you can faintly hear a dwarven voice carried on it, urging you to seek out an Earthseer named "Farsen".

96391.description:
The map you are holding seems to show a complex series of underground tunnels and highways that all seem to converge on a point underneath Ironforge itself.

You can't be sure what the runes say as they are written in the ugly jagged rune language of the Dark Iron dwarves, but you can guess at the purpose of these tunnels. As you are reading the map, a gust of wind washes over you and you can faintly hear a dwarven voice carried on it. Earthseer Farsen needs to see this.
96391.objectivesText: Deliver the Dark Iron Map to Earthseer Farsen in Dun Morogh.
96391.title: Underground Map

96392.description:
Greetings to ye, friend. My name is Earthseer Farsen and I'm visiting Dun Morogh from Aerie Peak. As I was travelin', I couldn't help but notice that we have, well... a bit o' a Dark Iron Dwarf problem.

If ye have a moment, I can show ye what I mean. I've got a bit o' magic that should do the trick.
96392.objectivesText: Speak with Earthseer Farsen and ask him to lend you his far sight to observe the Dark Iron threat.
96392.title: Farsen's Watch

96393.description:
Gather some allies and head down into the caverns beneath Old Ironforge. Enter the Hall of Thanes there and push to the lower vaults. 

My Dark Iron is a bit rusty, but I can make out a name--one Durgen Dirgehammer. It's likely that he's the commander. Take his head and deliver it to King Magni Bronzebeard. 

Oh, and when you do, tell him his old friend Farsen sends his regards!
96393.objectivesText: Enter the Hall of Thanes beneath Old Ironforge and claim the Head of Durgen Dirgehammer.
96393.title: Old Ironforge Incursion

96394.description:
Something has disturbed the tombs down in the Hall of Thanes, and strange noises have been heard coming from deep within the vaults. The spirits of the dead are light sleepers, and whatever is going on down there seems to have startled them.

Head down there and see what you can do about that for us. If any of the dead are awake--well, put them back down!
96394.objectivesText: Kill $1oa Enraged Apparitions, $2oa Tormented Souls and put the spirit of Anvilmar to rest.
96394.title: The Restless Dead

96395.description:
The... Thane... my mighty... Thane... he... needs to... rest.

Please... help him... help him... rest...

Consumed... by... ancient... grudge... No... rest...
96395.objectivesText: Put the spirit of Faldrim Anvilmar to rest and then return to the Ghostly Attendant in the Hall of Thanes.
96395.title: An Ancient Grudge

96403.description:
You there, adventurer... I could really use your aid.

I was sneaking--uh... 'patrolling' in the vaults when a force of Dark Iron dwarves emerged from the depths in mole machines! I don't know what they are here for, but there is priceless loot--uh or, rather... I mean, 'important cultural heirlooms' down there! Please, recover any such relics you see and return them here.

I assure you that anything you recover will be catalogued and returned to its proper place of honor.
96403.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Dwarven Heirlooms from the Hall of Thanes.
96403.title: Important Heirlooms

96408.description:
Last night one of our mountaineers spotted a campfire on a hillside to the east. It looks to be pretty high up, overlooking the Gol'Bolar Quarry.

It's probably nothing, but I'd like you to go check on that camp. If they are friendly, no harm done. If they aren't friendly... well, you know what to do.
96408.objectivesText: Investigate the campsite overlooking the Gol'Bolar Quarry.
96408.title: A Visitor to Dun Morogh

96494.description:
With the perimeter scouted, you've proven useful and trustworthy enough to bring into the fold.

I'm here representing SI:7's efforts to gain crucial information important to the Alliance. Not just anyone is privy to this knowledge. Mind your discretion.

A druidic cult known as the Blackthorne Pact has taken root nearby, operating in service to something they call the Wild King.

Find the domain of this "Wild King" and mark it. Then we can report back to Stormwind with certainty.

objectives.text: Find the entrance to Hyjal Summit

96494.objectivesText: Find the Blackthorne reinforcement point at the entrance to Hyjal Summit.
96494.title: Gathering Storm

96550.description:
The aged scabbard is embellished with carved designs and markings. This matches the description spoken by the war veteran. A dramatic view of the land below is a breathtaking sight.

Perhaps simply holding the scabbard in your hand while remembering the veteran's words will beckon the spirit to this memory.
96550.objectivesText: Use the Embroidered Scabbard to speak with the war veteran and hear his story at the overlook in Elderwild.
96550.title: Battle Recall

96559.description:
Every Gnomish test pilot knows that one must be prepared for the worst-case scenario when taking to our great skies!

That's why we never leave the hangar without our pilot survival kits. They have a self-activating beacon attached that will radio our position home as soon as you open it. Not to mention being stuffed full of other useful supplies.

If you can find that pack wherever it fell, by all means open it immediately and help yourself to the contents. You'll still be doing me a favor!
96559.objectivesText: Locate Fenwick Togglespring's Pilot Survival Kit.
96559.title: Supply Drop

96561.description:
<You unfold the simple parchment.>

To my Rowdy Redridge Rebels,

The lumberjacks here say the gulpers in that pond are biting like they're racing each other to the bait. Good fish, better eating. After this war is over, we're due an angling competition between friends.

The setting is simple: we stand on the center island and fish till the sun slips behind Hyjal's highest peak.

Whoever catches the most, doesn't have to gut 'em for our dinner!

-- Tobin --
96561.objectivesText: Find the fishing pond near the destroyed Alliance lumbermill in the Cradle of Tranquility.
96561.title: Last Wishes

96604.description:
Lok-tar, $c. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

You'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.
96604.objectivesText: Sit near Brakk's Basic Campfire and wait until you receive the Boosted Rest buff.
96604.title: The Great Outdoors

96605.description:
Greetings, $c. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

You'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.
96605.objectivesText: Sit near Kaga's Basic Campfire and wait until you receive the Boosted Rest buff.
96605.title: The Great Outdoors

Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.
96608.objectivesText: Sit near Eric's Basic Campfire and wait until you receive the Boosted Rest buff.
96608.title: The Great Outdoors

96609.description:
Are you familiar with Silvermoon Shimmerwine? It has a delicate flavor that is entirely unique to the vineyards of Eversong and it is the one thing I truly miss from my homeland.

Unfortunately, it is extremely hard to find on this side of the Thalassian Gate.

I had a patron bring me a bottle that he claimed to have "liberated" from blood elves in northern Azshara. If your adventures take you to that region and you can recover more bottles for me, I would handsomely reward your efforts.
96609.objectivesText: Bring $1oa bottles of Silvermoon Shimmerwine to Arille Azuregaze in Dalaran city.
96609.title: A Taste of Home

96626.description:
So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, $c. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.

objectives.text: Learn cooking from Tomas in Goldshire

96626.objectivesText: Speak with Tomas in Goldshire to learn to become a cook.
96626.title: Camping 101: Cooking

96627.description:
$n, you have proven your competence as a protector thus far. That is why I am now entrusting you with an unusual task.

I've heard of a new adventurer down the road by Goldshire. Go and see what he's doing.
96627.objectivesText: Speak to Sam Sarsparilla near Goldshire.
96627.title: The Adventurer

96628.description:
Wait, $n. I have another ask of you, before you brave that tunnel.

My mountaineers have reported an adventurer that's shown up just outside of Kharanos. Could you deliver these supplies to him?
96628.objectivesText: Deliver the Supply Bundle to Eric Brighthammer near Kharanos.
96628.title: The Adventurer

96629.description:
So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, $c. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.

objectives.text: Learn cooking from Gremlock Pilsnor in Kharanos

96629.objectivesText: Speak with Gremlock Pilsnor in Kharanos to learn to become a cook.
96629.title: Camping 101: Cooking

96630.description:
<The journal appears to be quite plain, detailing the life and adventures of someone you've never heard of.

There are multiple entries mentioning camping. It seems to be quite... fun.>
96630.objectivesText: Bring the journal to Lyreena Duskblade near Dolanaar.
96630.title: The Adventurer

96634.description:
So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, $c. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.

objectives.text: Learn cooking from Zarrin in Dolanaar

96634.objectivesText: Speak with Zarrin in Dolanaar to learn to become a cook.
96634.title: Camping 101: Cooking

96638.description:
More and more adventurers like yourself have been seeking glory and fortune outside of the safety of Thendal Grove. There's one such adventurer who has made a camp outside of Shen'dar Village, along the road leading southwest out of Thendal Grove.

Seek him out and see what you can learn from him that may help you in your own travels.
96638.objectivesText: Speak to Raan Wildwind near Shen'dar Village.
96638.title: The Adventurer

96646.description:
So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, $c. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.

objectives.text: Learn cooking from Zerril Softbreeze in Shen'dar Village

96646.objectivesText: Speak with Zerril Softbreeze in Shen'dar Village to learn to become a cook.
96646.title: Camping 101: Cooking

96652.description:
<The journal appears to be quite plain, detailing the life and adventures of someone you've never heard of.

There are multiple entries mentioning camping. It seems to be quite... fun.>
96652.objectivesText: Bring the journal to Brakk near Razor Hill.
96652.title: The Adventurer

96655.description:
So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, $c. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.

objectives.text: Learn cooking from Cook Torka in Razor Hill

96655.objectivesText: Speak with Cook Torka in Razor Hill to learn to become a cook.
96655.title: Camping 101: Cooking

96656.description:
$n, you have proven yourself trustworthy in your endeavors against the Scarlet Crusade so far. That is why I am now entrusting you with an unusual task.

I've heard of a new adventurer down the road by Brill. Go and see what she's doing.
96656.objectivesText: Speak to Eleanor Shackleton near Brill.
96656.title: The Adventurer

96658.description:
So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, $c. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.

objectives.text: Learn cooking from William Pickman in Brill

96658.objectivesText: Speak with William Pickman in Brill to learn to become a cook.
96658.title: Camping 101: Cooking

96659.description:
Wait, $n. I have another ask of you, before you leave us.

There is an adventurer by the name of Kaga Wildhoof who has made camp just outside of Bloodhoof Village. She has greatly helped me in the past, and now I see my chance to repay her. Could you deliver these supplies to her?
96659.objectivesText: Deliver the Supply Bundle to Kaga Wildhoof near Bloodhoof Village.
96659.title: The Adventurer

96661.description:
So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, $c. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.

objectives.text: Learn cooking from Pyall Silentstride in Bloodhoof Village

96661.objectivesText: Speak with Pyall Silentstride in Bloodhoof Village to learn to become a cook.
96661.title: Camping 101: Cooking

96676.description:
Well, informant, you're being promoted.

Take these updated orders to Johun at his base camp in Hyjal. There's some additional equipment in here that he'll be needing for our operations in the Summit.

Your assistance in these matters is pivotal to our overall strategy in Kalimdor, $n. Tarry not.

You are dismissed.
96676.objectivesText: Bring the Alliance Equipment to Johun "Punchy" Dillas in Hyjal.
96676.title: Unsealing Blackthorne Pact

96771.description:
In the region known as the Riverglades to the southeast, there is a place called the Krol'dok Stronghold. A highborne known as Zalfan Moonshadow has been seen there in the company of the Twilight's Hammer.

I'd pay handsomely if you'd rid the world of this cretin for me. He brings shame to the proud lineage of the highborne by consorting with fanatics and using stolen arcane knowledge in their service. There are few enough of us left without worms like him sullying our good name.
96771.objectivesText: Travel to Krol'dok Stronghold and slay Zalfan Moonshadow.
96771.title: Vengeance of the Highborne

96772.description:
Timear and I have been scrying the area on Kalimdor known as Alcaz Island and we've all but confirmed the presence of a powerful magic user there. The mage in question was able to dispel our probes, but before she did, I was able to glean an image of a tome of some sort. I believe it was a journal, written in ancient draconic script.

I don't know what is in that book, but I'd like to study it. We want you to travel to the hidden prison beneath Alcaz Island and recover that book for us.
96772.objectivesText: Recover Zarla's Journal from the depths of Alcaz Prison.
96772.title: The Dragon's Journal

96773.description:
There is a servant of the Lich King that makes his home deep in the quilboar lair known as Razorfen Downs. It is known to us that he makes use of a scrying orb known as "The Coldbringer's Eye" to direct the movements of his lesser minions elsewhere.

Go into Razorfen Downs and retrieve the Coldbringer's Eye on our behalf, $c. The Kirin Tor would pay handsomely to obtain this artifact so that we may study it and understand its inner workings.
96773.objectivesText: Recover The Coldbringer's Eye from Razorfen Downs.
96773.title: The Coldbringer's Eye

96775.description:
Ol' Mazu'kon got a bone to pick with a Witch Doctor that go by the name of Zum'rah and I be thinkin' you can help me out with that. 

Zum'rah practice all his bad voodoo in the Sandfury city of Zul'Farrak, far to the south in the deserts of Tanaris. Go there. Kill Zum'rah, and bring me his head.

Trust me mon, the world be a better place with his head stuck on pike outside my hut than it be sittin' on his shoulders.
96775.objectivesText: Slay Witch Doctor Zum'rah and bring Zum'rah's Head to Mazu'kon in Mulgore.
96775.title: Zum'rah's Head

96779.description:
Sometimes, $r, a single cut in the right place will drop a foe dead. The same is often true of organizations.

Our agents have identified a key target among the ranks of the Syndicate: a man by the name of Lord Tomas.

He plays an instrumental role in the functions of Durnholde Keep, in Hillsbrad Foothills. If you wish to be of service to Ravenholdt, go to Durnholde and eliminate him. The quicker, and quieter, the better.
96779.objectivesText: Find Lord Tomas inside Durnholde Keep, in Hillsbrad Foothills, and kill him. Then, return to Myrokos Silentform.
96779.title: Syndicate Sabotage

96781.description:
We have noticed a Syndicate scouting party prowling around the ruins of Alterac, led by a man named Barton.

They're clearly searching for something, but I cannot know what without reading his scouting reports.

I ask that you pickpocket the report from him, rather than killing him outright. Barton's death will tip off the Syndicate that we're on to them, and they will certainly take counter-measures to cover their tracks.

If you hope to find him, he is most likely among the Syndicate at Strahnbrad.
96781.objectivesText: Steal Barton's Scouting Report by pickpocketing it from him. Then, bring the report to Myrokos Silentform at Ravenholdt Manor.
96781.title: What's the Big Idea?

96782.description:
It seems our friend Barton here has made this very easy for us. He is after two heirlooms of the Perenolde family within the ruins of Alterac. The Blade of House Perenolde, a sword, and the Royal Aegis of Perenolde, a shield.

From the report, it seems these armaments are within two towers among the ruins. Best we acquire them before the Syndicate does.

The ogres occupying the ruins are fierce, but I trust you should be able to sneak past them without needing to bloody your blade at all.
96782.objectivesText: Find the Blade of House Perenolde and the Royal Aegis of Perenolde among the ruins of Alterac. Then, bring them to Myrokos Silentform.
96782.title: Covert Extraction

96783.description:
Stromgarde Keep is one of the Syndicate's largest strongholds. Many of the organization's most important dealings take place behind its walls.

I have received word of a certain trade taking place between members of the Syndicate somewhere in Arathi Highlands, and I'm certain the details of this trade can be found somewhere in Stromgarde.

To infiltrate the keep without arousing suspicion, you'll need a disguise. See if you can find one among the Syndicate outside the keep, at Northfold Manor.
96783.objectivesText: Steal a Syndicate uniform from Northfold Manor to infiltrate Stromgarde Keep.
96783.title: A Way In

96786.description:
Falconcrest sent some guys to do a handoff at the southern part of Thoradin's wall. I don't know what they're picking up. Must be good, because everyone involved has kept it a total secret. I don't think the guys picking it up even know what it is.

That's all I've got. Don't make me regret telling you that.
96786.objectivesText: Break up the secret deal, and take the object being traded to the Syndicate. Then, return to Myrokos Silentform at Ravenholdt Manor.
96786.title: The Syndicate Sting

96799.description:
<Lieutenant Connar listens as you tell him the reason you are here.>

So, Danneth has an orphaned nephew in Dalaran? If you haven't spoken to him about this yet, I'd suggest you do so. He doesn't exactly seem like the parenting type, but he might surprise me.

If he does want to go and collect the boy once he's recovered, he has my blessing to take leave for that.
96799.objectivesText: Speak with Sergeant Danneth at Nethergarde Keep.
96799.title: A Heavy Responsibility

96800.description:
You there, $c. I have a matter I could use assistance with.

I just so happen to be writing a thesis on the ancient Wildhammer runemasters of Grim Batol, and there's a particular tome I need to complete my research. According to our ledgers, a mage by the name of Doan checked the book out of the old Dalaran library before the Third War and never returned it!

Arcanist Doan is now holed up in the Scarlet Monastery in Tirisfal Glades. Retrieve this book for me and you'll be well rewarded.
96800.objectivesText: Retrieve the book The Lost Magic of the Runemasters from the Scarlet Monastery.
96800.title: Past Due

96821.description:
We see fewer and fewer travelers from Razor Hill these days. The scorpids were never much fun, but now I hear there are spiders making their nest along the road.

If your travels take you up north, kill some of the spiders on your way. Then, let Razor Hill know the path's a bit safer for them.
96821.objectivesText: Kill 6 Ridgeshade Creepers and 6 Ridgeshade Lurkers in southern Durotar, then report to Gar'thok in Razor Hill.
96821.title: Legging It

96822.description:
We lost many brave warriors of the Horde when we sacked Tiragarde Keep. Now that the humans have reinforced the ruins, we cannot collect their remains to properly honor their deaths.

Go to the ruins surrounding the keep, and search for the weapons left by our fallen kin. We will display them in a place of honor.
96822.objectivesText: Collect the Raider's Battleaxe, Raider's Bow, and Raider's Shield from the Tiragarde Keep outskirts, then return them to Turroc in Razor Hill.
96822.title: For Honor

96833.description:
Gh... Ghan. Sur... Okk... Ghansurok. That's the fel chimaera's name. I thought I could manage out here... ugh... alone. No chance. Picked me clean into the air.

Stuck my dagger through its closest eye I could find, and I fell farther than the tree tops.

I wasn't the only one who bit off more than I could chew this time. Haha--agh... I shouldn't make myself laugh, this hurts bad enough.

Broken bones we could mend, but... the venom... is too vile.

Pass on a warning. I beg you!
96833.objectivesText: Pass on the warning of the aggressive chimaera known as Ghansurok to others on the mountain.
96833.title: Venom Maws

96873.description:
The trolls east of here have lost their will to the witchdoctor, Zalazane. He uses many cruel magics to keep hold of his prisoners' minds, but one of his favorite tricks is to make them wear pendants wrapped in evil binding spells.

Practice your enchanting skills by stripping the magic from these pendants, and bring me the results. And don't accidentally put one around your neck, if you value your freedom!
96873.objectivesText: Pa'zula in Sen'jin Village wants you to collect 3 Luminous Residue. Luminous Residue can be obtained by disenchanting Hexed Pendants dropped by trolls in the Echo Isles.
96873.title: A Pain in the Neck

96875.description:
Orgrimmar is always expanding, $c. And when the peons need hides to line the walls and roofs of our new buildings, they come to me!

The hides of the lizards in Thunder Ridge are typically too thick for armor, but they make excellent building material. Bring me some of their hides, along with a few lighter cured hides. Let's see your skill with leather!
96875.objectivesText: Kamari in Orgrimmar wants you to collect 5 Rough Lizard Hide from beasts in Thunder Ridge, along with 2 Cured Light Hides.
96875.title: Beasts of Thunder Ridge

96877.description: The enormous hoof serves as proof of your victory over the mighty lizard.
96877.title: Halikor's Hoof

96895.description:
Not sure if you heard, but two emissaries of the Argent Dawn just passed through here. I don't mind the Argent Dawn, but I don't like them poking around Tirisfal unsupervised either. They were both Forsaken... but that doesn't make me any less nervous.

One of them just passed by here, headed southeast. There's a group of scourge cultists snooping around the outskirts of the city in that direction. If those two heard about them, there's no doubt that would have caught their attention.
96895.objectivesText: Find the Argent Dawn member near the entrance to the Undercity.
96895.title: The Argent Emissary

96896.description:
Danitha and I fought against the Scourge in the defense of the Undercity when Naxxramas attacked. We lost many good friends that day, including the hero after which this keep was named--Garek Bandarion.

He might just have been the first Forsaken to rediscover how to wield the Light as a paladin. I am encouraged to see his legacy and potential live on here with Danitha and her cohort.

If only the rest of the Forsaken felt the same way...
96896.objectivesText: Observe the conversation between Danitha Morr and Leonid Barthalomew the Revered.
96896.title: A Righteous Cause

96897.description: The Scourge are a blight on our lands, and their living servants are the worst of them. The people of Tirisfal have enough to deal with between the mindless dead and the Scarlet Crusade. If you wish to do some good, help me put an end to this scum.
96897.objectivesText: Kill $1oa Dark Neophytes and $2oa Dark Enforcers in Tirisfal Glades.
96897.title: The Cult of the Damned

96898.description:
It wasn't long ago that the citadel of Naxxramas bore down upon this city, intent on wiping the Forsaken off the map. Both the Forsaken and the Argent Dawn lost much that day to secure the future of the Forsaken.

During the battle, the great necrotic focusing crystal mounted atop Naxxramas was shattered and its fragments were scattered all over this area. I suspect that is what the cultists are here for. Help me recover the fragments and deprive the Scourge of them.
96898.objectivesText: Gather $1oa Necrotic Crystal Fragments in Tirisfal Glades.
96898.title: Remnants of War

96899.description:
You've done a great thing for the cause of the Argent Dawn here today, and I thank you. I don't know how familiar you are with the fortress of Bandarion Keep, but my commander and I were headed that way to meet with the paladins that reside there. That was before we learned of the presence of the Cult of the Damned.

If you'd like to learn more about the Argent Dawn and our mission, seek out my commander at Bandarion Keep, to the northwest of here. I'll remain here to mop up the rest of this mess.
96899.objectivesText: Meet Leonid Barthalomew at Bandarion Keep in Tirisfal Glades.
96899.title: Bandarion Keep

96912.description:
Heya pal, step right up! You look like you know which end of the sword goes where! 

It just so happens that I have a long list of challenges that only the most elite fighters will be able to accomplish. Wanna take a stab at it?
96912.title: Field of Honor: Week 1

96913.description: You again, eh? Ready for the next test? I hope you aren't squeamish. You might need to bleed for this one... or preferably make the other guys bleed first.
96913.title: Field of Honor: Week 2

96959.description:
War.

By the time I heeded the call of our clans, the battle had passed, and only ashes answered my blade.

My purpose is forged anew.

This mountain remembers strength--ancient power riding its winds and holding its water. I would earn the right to walk its spine, to reach the fallen stronghold that lies upon the road to the summit.

Demons profane these graves. Before I fight at your side, I must know you stand capable. Light the two bonfires and return to me. Their flames draw our enemy out.
96959.objectivesText: Light the two bonfires in Dae'gun and return to Yashiro.
96959.title: Blademaster's Bonfires

96964.description:
If the hermit truly wants his little gambit to leave the nest and fly, it will likely need a potent energy source. One that can sustain itself without collapse.

<Jereman looks to the sky and clacks her beak together as she considers.>

Ah, yes. I know just the clever creature we can consult. Go north into the area you mortals refer to as Dae'gun, the one with the demons, and seek out the fox Wild God Renalard. I believe he will have a solution to our little puzzle.
96964.objectivesText: Speak to the Wild God Renalard.
96964.title: A Clever Creature

96971.description:
Say, while you're out and about prancing in my lands, would you mind doing me a favor?

Once the war had been won, many of the various armies up and left. For whatever reason, they decided some of their supplies were not worth taking. That, or they all died. Who could say?

Regardless, these supplies are of use to my kits and me. Unfortunately they also tend to be where the demons are. Take this tuft of fur with you and use it on the demons to distract them while you grab the tools.
96971.title: To Outfox a Demon

96983.description:
You're capable, fast, fearless. Fire will draw the demons from their hiding places, and with them, their warlords. They will come seeking dominance. Instead, they will find vengeance waiting. This is the moment where the will of the mountain speaks through us.

Come, let us carve a path through these hellspawn and end their reign. My blade yearns to cleave through their ranks.
96983.objectivesText: Fight your way through Dae'gun with Yashiro.
96983.title: Yashiro's Windwalk

96984.description:
You may not have our best interests at heart, but I won't deny an extra pair of hands. And if Dalaran falls, it takes everything with it--including your Undercity.

So, your benefactor wants in? Fine. I'll imbue your key to work past my wards so you can enter the city. Once you're in, meet me at the Violet Citadel where this all began. With everything going on the Kirin Tor will be too busy to stop you.

Scavenge what you will, but whatever happens, our first priority is to prevent a catastrophe.
96984.objectivesText: Collect the Arcane Mote in the City of Dalaran for Magus Wordeen Voidglare in Tarren Mill.
96984.title: Heart of Disruption

96986.description:
Within the underbelly of the mage city to the north is a traitor to our kind. A necromancer of disturbing talent. He raises an army of undeath right under the Kirin Tor's nose.

I care not for the fate of the mage city, $n, but this grave knight spits in the face of everything we Forsaken stand for. Put an end to him. Show him no one is beyond the reach of the Dark Lady.
96986.objectivesText: Defeat Atrexis the Grave Knight in the City of Dalaran for Melisara in Tarren Mill.
96986.title: The Grave Knight

96988.description:
With the city of Dalaran under siege by their own constructs, this is the perfect opportunity to, let's say, borrow a few samples.

Imagine an army of arcane-powered abominations. The Dark Lady would have no choice but to recognize my alchemical prowess. Maybe even grant me head of the Royal Apothecary Society?

Go to the city and find the constructs' cores. They are unlikely to give them willingly, so do what you must.
96988.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Cracked Sentry Cores in the City of Dalaran for Doctor Martin Felben in Undercity.
96988.title: Source of Power

conditionalDescriptions.text:
Ey, warlock! I must admit I be surprised to see one of your talents here at me stables.

If you are looking for a mount, ya have come to the right place, though they ain't the same as those felsteeds you are accustom to summoning.

Either way, you're welcome to take a look at our raptors, should ya want one. Most be underestimatin' how intelligent and savage these beasts be. Ya won't be findin' a better, faster or more lethal companion once ya be bonded with it.

Go an' take a look to see if any catch ya interest and return to me when ya made ya choice.

96989.description:
Ey mon! Today be a big day for ya, I see. Ya think you're ready to take de reins of one of these fierce creatures, huh?

Most be underestimatin' how intelligent and savage these beasts be. Ya won't be findin' a better, faster or more lethal companion once ya be bonded with it.

So, you be havin' an important choice to make. Ya raptor and you will be traversin' the world together, and the raptor will also be needin' to choose ya in return.

Go an' take a look and return to me when ya made ya choice.
96989.objectivesText: Inspect the riding raptors to choose your first mount.
96989.title: Your First Riding Raptor

96991.description:
The climb grows steeper from here, as you say. Even an empty pack weighs on tired legs. I would ask another kindness of you, traveler. Take my excess gear and carry it ahead to the Summit, where Marn Euhron aids in restoring a foothold near Nordrassil.

I will follow at my own pace when my ceremonies here are complete. When I arrive, I will reclaim them from him and assist him in their work. This way, we both honor the journey and gifts of the mountain.
96991.objectivesText: Deliver Galvinquam's Belongings to Marn Euhron in the Summit.
96991.title: Trail Assist

96992.description:
You know, they packed enough tools to get the essentials started, but there's never enough fastening material. Only so much cordage-winding my hands can take.

Resourcefulness is even better than being prepared.

Take an empty bag to the burned-down remains of the alliance buildings around the Cradle of Tranquility southwest of here, and fill it with as many nails and brackets as you can find in the ashes.
96992.objectivesText: Look through the burned buildings in the Cradle of Tranquility for $2oa Metal Brackets and $1oa Nails and return to Johun "Punchy" Dillas in Hyjal.
96992.title: Resupply

conditionalDescriptions.text:
<Ogunaro narrows his eyes as you approach.>

Lok'tar, warlock. I must admit I am surprised to see one of your... talents here.

If you are looking for a riding wolf, you have come to the right place, however know that riding and befriending a wolf is very different from the felsteeds you are accustomed to summoning.

The bond between orc and wolf is not one chosen by vanity. No, each orc and wolf forms a special bond that goes beyond a mere purchase.

If you are here to bond with a wolf, I would suggest going to each and examining them. Return to me if you sense a kinship with one.

96994.description:
Lok'tar, $c. Come to bond with your first wolf? Good.

There is no stronger bond than that of an orc and their wolf. They are no mere mount, but are a lifelong companion and friend.

Ours is not a bond chosen by vanity. No, each orc and wolf forms a special bond that goes beyond a mere purchase.

They will choose you as much as you will choose them. You will understand when you meet them.

Go and find which wolf speaks to you. Return to me when you have your answer.
96994.objectivesText: Inspect the riding wolves to choose your first mount.
96994.title: Your First Riding Wolf

96996.description:
Now that you have completed your training, it would seem the winds wish you to bond with your first strider.

These galestriders have been ridden by our ancestors for generations. Despite their wispy and slender appearance, they are steadfast and fierce mounts.

You and your strider will traverse the world together, so you have an important choice to make. Fear not, whatever choice you make will be the right one.

Go examine the striders and return to me when you have made your choice.
96996.objectivesText: Inspect the riding striders to choose your first mount.
96996.title: Your First Riding Galestrider

conditionalDescriptions.text:
Greetings, paladin. I must admit I am surprised to see one of your order here at my stables.

If you are looking for a mount, you have come to the right place, though they may pale in comparison to the chargers you are accustomed to.

Regardless, I encourage you to peruse our steeds, should you want one. Ours are some of the finest steeds in the land, and even though you radiate with holy power they should still bear you as faithfully and without issue.

Go examine the undead horses to see if any are to your liking and return to me when you have made your choice.

Greetings, warlock. I must admit I am surprised to see one of your talents here at my stables.

If you are looking for a mount, you have come to the right place, though they may pale in comparison to the felsteeds you are accustomed to summoning.

Regardless, I encourage you to peruse our steeds, should you want one. Ours are some of the finest steeds in the land, and they should still bear you as faithfully as your summoned infernal felsteed.

Though I would advise against lighting the skeletal horses on fire. That is an aesthetic best saved for the unholy creatures you and your council conjure.

Go examine the undead horses to see if any are to your liking and return to me when you have made your choice.

96997.description:
Greetings, $c. I imagine I can guess what has brought you to my stables today.

If you are looking for a mount, you have come to the right place. Be warned though, riding an undead steed is not for the faint of heart.

As such, you have an important choice to make. You and your undead steed will travel the world together for good or ill. Fear not, whatever choice you make will be the correct one.

Go examine the undead horses and return to me when you have made your choice.
96997.objectivesText: Inspect the undead riding horses to choose your first mount.
96997.title: A Steed in Death as They Were in Life

96999.description:
Whoever wore dis fought wit' purpose. An' Sen'jin be a small village... blood an' kin run close dere.

Somebody back home be missin' dis wrap--and da warrior who carried it.

When ya trek to Echo Isles, take dis wrap wit' ya. Bring it home to Sen'jin. Dey'll know who it belong to--and dey'll honor ya for seein' it returned.
96999.objectivesText: Take the War Paint Wrap to someone in Sen'jin Village.
96999.title: Wrap Return

97003.description:
You there, $c. I need your aid. There are rumors of a beast that makes its lair deep in a cave at Thorn Hill, northeast of here. The Razormane call it Chol'aruk or "The Ravener". It's supposedly five times the size of a normal quilboar with a thirst for blood that can never be sated.

Most don't believe the tales. But I do--because I've fought its like before.

Seek out its lair and slay Chol'aruk. Bring me its head. I warn you though--prepare well and do not go alone.

Blood and thunder, $c.
97003.objectivesText: Bring the head of Chol'aruk to Gur'ak in the Barrens.
97003.title: Chol'aruk the Ravener

97005.description:
There are rumors of a colossal abomination that makes its lair at a cave to the northwest of here, on the plateau known as Thorn Hill. The Razormane call it Chol'aruk or "The Ravener" and those that have seen it say it's so massive that it can swallow an orc whole.

Few believe such tales, but I do... because I've fought one like it myself. On the honor of those I lost to these things, this beast must die.

Gather strong allies and find the lair of Chol'aruk. Kill the abomination and bring me its head.
97005.objectivesText: Bring Chol'aruk's Head to Bainham in the Barrens.
97005.title: Chol'aruk the Ravener

conditionalDescriptions.text:
Ho there, paladin! I must admit I am surprised to see one of yer order here at my stables.

If you're looking for a mount, you have come to the right place, though they may pale in comparison to the chargers you are accustomed to.

Regardless, I encourage you to peruse our fine rams, should you want one. These rams are the most steadfast and sturdy in all of Azeroth. They're fiercely protective of their rider. Aye, you'll have a hard time finding a more and stalwart companion for your journeys.

Go see the rams and see if any are to your liking, then return to me when you've made yer choice.

97017.description:
Ah, it's a big day fer ya I see; here for yer first ram are ye?

These rams are the most steadfast and sturdy in all of Azeroth. They're fiercely protective of their rider. Aye, you'll have a hard time finding a more stalwart companion for yer journeys.

So, you have an important choice to make. You and yer ram will traverse the world together so choose wisely! Not to worry lad, whatever choice you make will be the right one.

Go see the rams and return to me when you've made yer choice.
97017.objectivesText: Inspect the riding rams to choose your first mount.
97017.title: Your First Riding Ram

97022.description: Danitha Morr has ordered you to report back to Bandarion Keep to receive additional training. Please make your way back to the keep as quickly as you are able.
97022.objectivesText: Speak with Danitha Morr at Bandarion Keep.
97022.title: Report to Danitha

conditionalDescriptions.text:
Greetings, paladin! I must admit I am surprised to see one of your order here at my stables.

If you are looking for a mount, you have come to the right place, though they may pale in comparison to the chargers you are accustomed to.

Regardless, I encourage you to peruse our steeds, should you want one. Ours are some of the finest steeds in the land. These steeds are descendants from both the historical Lordaeron stock and our own local horses. You won't find a more steadfast companion for your journeys.

Go examine the horses to see if any are to your liking and return to me when you have made your choice.

Greetings, warlock. I must admit I am surprised to see one of your talents here at my stables.

If you are looking for a mount, you have come to the right place, though they may pale in comparison to the felsteeds you are accustomed to summoning.

Regardless, I encourage you to peruse our steeds, should you want one. Ours are some of the finest steeds in the land, and they should still bear you as faithfully as your summoned infernal felsteed.

Go examine the horses to see if any are to your liking and return to me when you have made your choice.

97045.description:
Greetings! Are you here to examine our horses?

These steeds are descendants from both the historical Lordaeron stock and our own local horses. You won't find a more steadfast companion for your journeys.

Choosing one may be difficult as they are all excellent and trained to be steady even when in danger. Don't forget, you and your horse will traverse the world together. I'm sure whatever choice you make will suit you best.

Go examine the horses and return to me when you have made your choice.
97045.objectivesText: Inspect the riding horses to choose your first mount.
97045.title: Your First Horse

97048.description: Listen, I can't repay you right now, but I'm a cook on Captain Aransas' ship. I'll be sure to put in a good word for you when I get back to Booty Bay. You should speak to the captain when you get the chance. I'm sure she'll be grateful to have me back.
97048.objectivesText: Speak to Captain Aransas in Booty Bay.
97048.title: Returning to Port

97074.description:
Hello, $c! It would seem you are now seasoned enough as an adventurer for me to teach you how to ride a saber, for a fee of course.

Lelanai will provide you with a free mount once ye have trained with me, and after you will be able to purchase any additional mounts ye would like. There are many creatures out in the world, and each requires their own riding skill, but you will have to find trainers for each.

Speak to me when you have enough coin, and I will teach you all I know about riding sabers.
97074.objectivesText: Learn the Apprentice Riding skill from Jartsam.
97074.title: Learning to Ride

97119.description:
In addition to seeing to the spiritual needs of the people here, I feed them as well. I'm not exactly a trained cook, but after five years, I've learned a thing or two about preparing food!

I'm sure that folks here would love a taste of something different. I remember, before we assembled on the mountain, there was a goblin from Everlook who was serving platters of tiny, Savory Stag Sliders... I would love to taste one of those again. We have plenty of stags up here, too! Think you can cook some up?
97119.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Savory Stag Sliders to Ortak Lomgok in Elderwild.
97119.title: Now We're Cooking

97130.description:
Lan'dalock and I have been discussing a recent development in the south seas involving an ancient Gurubashi ruin that has suddenly appeared off the coast of Stranglethorn Vale.

Such a site has significant archeological value. We'd be highly interested in obtaining one of the idols that certain witch doctors amongst the ancient Gurubashi would use as a ritual focus for their blood magic.

Enter this "Drowned City" and recover one of these idols for us.
97130.objectivesText: Recover an Ancient Gurubashi Idol from the Drowned City.
97130.title: Ancient Gurubashi Secrets

97170.description:
Hello, $c! It would seem you are now seasoned enough as an adventurer for me to teach you how to ride a horse, for a fee of course.

Katie will provide you with a free mount once ye have trained with me, and after you will be able to purchase any additional mounts you would like. There are many creatures out in the world, and each requires their own riding skill, but you will have to find trainers for each.

Speak to me when you have enough coin, and I will teach you all I know about riding horses.
97170.objectivesText: Learn the Apprentice Riding skill from Randal Hunter.
97170.title: Learning to Ride

conditionalDescriptions.text:
Greetings, paladin! I must admit I am surprised to see one of your order here at my stables.

If you are looking for a mount, you have come to the right place, though they may pale in comparison to the chargers you are accustomed to.

Regardless, I encourage you to peruse our steeds, should you want one. Ours are some of the finest steeds in the land. These steeds are descendants from both the historical Lordaeron stock and our own local horses. You won't find a more steadfast companion for your journeys.

Go examine the horses to see if any are to your liking and return to me when you have made your choice.
