If you are looking for a mount, you have come to the right place, though they may pale in comparison to the felsteeds you are accustomed to summoning.

Regardless, I encourage you to peruse our steeds, should you want one. Ours are some of the finest steeds in the land, and they should still bear you as faithfully as your summoned infernal felsteed.

Go examine the horses to see if any are to your liking and return to me when you have made your choice.

97171.description:
Greetings! Are you here to examine our horses?

These steeds are descendants from both the historical Lordaeron stock and our own local horses. You won't find a more steadfast companion for your journeys.

Choosing one may be difficult as they are all excellent and trained to be steady even when in danger. Don't forget, you and your horse will traverse the world together. I'm sure whatever choice you make will suit you best.

Go examine the horses and return to me when you have made your choice.
97171.objectivesText: Inspect the riding horses to choose your first mount.
97171.title: Your First Horse

97173.description:
The Blackmaw furbolgs in the mountains overlooking Azshara have been dabbling in dark magic. While a primitive people being corrupted by demonic magic is nothing new for Azeroth, Lan'dalock and I would like to study their spell foci.

Travel to the stronghold known as Blackmaw Hold and recover one of the Blackmaw Ritual Totems for us. Only the most powerful of the Blackmaw's shamans will be carrying one of these, so bring allies and take care.
97173.objectivesText: Recover a Blackmaw Ritual Totem from Blackmaw Hold.
97173.title: Blackmaw Magic

97175.description:
No worthy endeavor is completed without some sacrifice, and this first task requires just that.

You must acquire High Priest Zayus's exorcism censer for your task. Even though its use will be for good reason, due compensation must be given for it.

Proceed to Orgrimmar and speak with the High Priest Zayus there. Zayus will seek a..."donation" for the loss of his censer. It will be a small price to pay when all is said and done.
97175.objectivesText: Travel to Orgrimmar and get High Priest Zayus's Exorcism Censer. You will need to make a donation of 150 gold in order to secure it.
97175.title: Due Sacrifice

97176.description:
I have added some dirt from the tainted ground of Terrordale in the Eastern Plaguelands to the censer. Go there and use this censer to find areas with the greatest signs of corruption. You'll know these areas by the green necrotic auras that rise up from the ground at the location where tormented souls congregate.

Use the censer to reveal these spirits. Free them from their torment. When you have put these souls to rest, return and we will discuss the next steps.
97176.objectivesText: Use the Exorcism Censer to drive out the tormented spirits in Terrordale. When you have destroyed 25 Terrordale Spirits, return to Danitha Morr at Bandarion Keep in Tirisfal Glades.
97176.title: Exorcising Terrordale

97177.description:
With the blessings of the loa, take the censer. I be usin' it more than once to exorcise bad voodoo spirits, and it should serve ya well for the trials what be comin'.

You best be headin' back to Danitha now, $n. Ya quest continues with her.
97177.objectivesText: Return the Exorcism Censer to Danitha Morr at Bandarion Keep in Tirisfal Glades.
97177.title: Acts of Mercy

97178.description:
A paladin's charger needs a proper barding or it is little more than a mindless beast. The barding used by your charger not only needs to be of the finest materials possible, but must also be suitable for attunement to the spirit realm.

There is a smith outside of Tarren Mill that has done great work for our paladins in the past. He is a modest and unassuming orc, but his work is superb and is well-suited to our needs. Seek him out and commission him for this task.
97178.objectivesText: Speak with Ott at the village of Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills.
97178.title: Ott of Tarren Mill

97185.description:
In this satchel you will find the items you will need for your trial. Use the divination scryer in the heart of the Great Ossuary's basement to bring forth accursed spirits to face justice. The power of your judgements will be extremely valuable in this battle, so use them wisely.

Once you have dispersed these spirits, Darkreaver will appear. Defeat him and claim the lost soul of the charger. Show it the path of justice and retribution that you walk and with luck, it will take its place at your side.
97185.objectivesText:
Use the Divination Scryer in the heart of the Great Ossuary's basement in the Scholomance.  Doing so will bring forth the spirits you must judge. Defeating these spirits will summon forth Death Knight Darkreaver.  Defeat him and reclaim the lost soul of the fallen charger.

Give the Spirit of Retribution and the Blessed Enchanted Barding to Darkreaver's Fallen Charger.
97185.title: Justice and Retribution

97188.description:
Greetings, $c! You are now seasoned enough as an adventurer for me to teach you how to pilot a mechanostrider, for a fee of course.

Milli will provide you with a free mount once you have trained with me, and after you will be able to purchase any additional mounts you would like. There are many creatures out in the world, and each requires their own riding skill, but you will have to find trainers for each.

Speak to me when you have enough gold, and I will teach you about riding mechanostriders!
97188.objectivesText: Learn the Apprentice Riding skill from Binjy Featherwhistle.
97188.title: Learning to Ride

97196.description:
There is a servant of the Lich King that makes his home deep in the Death's Head quilboar lair known as Razorfen Downs. It is known to us that he makes use of a scrying orb to observe and direct the movements of his minions elsewhere.

With this artifact, we'd be able to hunt down the covert agents of the Scourge and put an end to them and the threat they pose to Kalimdor forever.

Go into Razorfen Downs to the lair of Amnennar the Coldbringer and retrieve the orb known as the Coldbringer's Eye for me.
97196.objectivesText: Recover The Coldbringer's Eye from Razorfen Downs.
97196.title: The Coldbringer's Eye

97198.description:
The Blackmaw furbolgs in the mountains overlooking Azshara have been corrupted by dark and sinister magic. We do not know the full extent of the corruption and what impact it may have upon the elements in the area, but we hope to understand it better.

Travel to the stronghold known as Blackmaw Hold and recover one of the Blackmaw Ritual Totems for us. Only the most powerful of the Blackmaw's shamans will be carrying one of these, so bring allies and prepare for a difficult battle.
97198.objectivesText: Recover a Blackmaw Ritual Totem from Blackmaw Hold.
97198.title: Blackmaw Magic

97200.description:
Ey, welcome $c! Ya now be seasoned enough as an adventurer for me to teach you how to ride one of our raptors, for a fee of course.

Zjolnir will provide ya with a free mount once you have trained with me, and after you will be able to purchase any additional mounts ya would like. There are many creatures out in the world, and each requires their own riding skill, but ya will have to find trainers for each.

Speak to me when ya have enough gold, and I will teach ya about raptor riding.
97200.objectivesText: Learn the Apprentice Riding skill from Xar'ti.
97200.title: Learning to Ride

97203.description:
Greetings, $c. It would seem you are now seasoned enough as an adventurer for me to teach you how to ride a skeletal steed, for a fee.

Zachariah will provide you with a free mount once you have trained with me, and after you will be able to purchase any additional mounts you desire. There are many creatures out in the world, and each requires their own riding skill, but you will have to find trainers for each.

Speak to me when you have enough coin, and I will teach you about skeletal horses.
97203.objectivesText: Learn the Apprentice Riding skill from Velma Warnam.
97203.title: Learning to Ride

97204.description:
Greetings, $c. It would seem you are now seasoned enough as an adventurer for me to teach you how to ride a kodo, for a fee of course.

Harb will provide you with a free mount once ye have trained with me, and after you will be able to purchase any additional mounts you would like. There are many creatures out in the world, and each requires their own riding skill, but you will have to find trainers for each.

Speak to me when you have enough coin, and I will teach you about riding the noble kodo.
97204.objectivesText: Learn the Apprentice Riding skill from Kar Stormsinger.
97204.title: Learning to Ride

97205.description:
Hello, $c! It would seem you are now seasoned enough as an adventurer for me to teach you how to ride a galestrider, for a fee of course.

I will provide you with a free mount once ye have trained with me, and after you will be able to purchase any additional mounts you would like. There are many creatures out in the world, and each requires their own riding skill, but you will have to find trainers for each.

Speak to me when you have enough coin, and I will teach you about riding galestriders.
97205.objectivesText: Learn the Apprentice Riding skill from Genn Fairweather.
97205.title: Learning to Ride

97225.description:
When we fled the isles that Zalazane and his ilk now inhabit, we left behind many precious idols that help us commune with spirits we worship: our loa. They are of grave importance to our tribe.

The followers of Zalazane show no reverence for our loa and have scattered these idols across the largest of the isles.

This is an action that will not go unnoticed if we are not able to collect these idols, and offending a loa is a grave matter.

Go, find as many loa idols as you can and return them to me.
97225.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Forgotten Loa Idols from the Echo Isles. Bring them to Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village.
97225.title: Forgotten Loa Idols

97236.description: A fresh specimen from a beast of this size is quite a find. Perhaps someone in Aldrassil familiar with the study of spiders would be interested in the fang.
97236.objectivesText: Deliver the Fang of Githyiss to someone interested in the study of spiders in Aldrassil.
97236.title: Fang of Githyiss

97242.description:
Yelmak doesn't want his apprentice breaking anything. Well, anything more than he already has.

He told me the young mixer in training has too much pride to ask for help when he really needs it. Yelmak wants to give him a taste of a particular home-brewed recipe.

Gather a mix of cattail and speargrass cuttings taken from the plants growing around the water in the Valley of Honor. I'd get them myself, but if I left the shop, Whuut would surely know we're catering to his mood.
97242.objectivesText: Take some cuttings from the Cattails and Speargrass growing around the water flows in the Valley of Honor and return to Kor'geld in Yelmak's Alchemy and Potions.
97242.title: Yelmak's Medley

97243.description:
Even though we are in the realm of Skywall, this is still the elemental plane. The spirits of all four elements speak to us, if we deign to listen. One among us Windshapers is in particular attunement with the element of fire. A shen'dorei by the name of Olariaan Swiftburn.

Bring this to him at the Shrine of Flames in the Gustberry Lowlands. You'll find it tucked away along the edge of the island, west of Valanaar.
97243.objectivesText: Bring the Torch of Dormant Flame to Olariaan Swiftburn at the Shrine of Flames in the Gustberry Lowlands.
97243.title: Call of Fire

97244.description:
There is an Al'Aketh Skypriest called Faladiel. He was once a caller of the flame and a stalwart Windshaper. Like so many Al'Aketh, he mortgaged his loyalty for power and his hands are now stained with the blood of his former brothers and sisters.

You will find Skypriest Faladiel at the farm to the northeast past Valanaar, just to the south of the Shrine of Akir. Kill the betrayer. Bring me his heart. It is a gruesome task, but it is needed for the ritual we are to perform.
97244.objectivesText: Slay Skypriest Faladiel in the Gustberry Lowlands and collect Faladiel's Heart.
97244.title: Call of Fire

97245.description:
The residents of the Shen'dar Highlands speak of an ancient forest sprite called Kuramaa. They say it lives inside of a twisted stump at the summit of a hill near the highlands Anchor Pylon.

Go to the highlands and find this stump. Rap your fist upon the bark and Kuramaa will appear. Best the spirit in combat, and bring me its wooden mask.

Be warned however, this entity will be exceptionally resistant to much of your magic. Only the touch of flame will lay low the spirit.
97245.objectivesText: Find the home of Kuramaa in the Shen'dar Highlands, and defeat the spirit in combat. Bring Kuramaa's Mask to Olariaan Swiftburn in the Gustberry Lowlands when you are victorious.
97245.title: Call of Fire

97246.description:
My son, Migi, always takes off to play with his friends all day. I tell him to pick up a lunch at Borstan's, but I know he almost never does, because he comes home starving. These kids think their games are more important than their own bodies!

Please, stop at Borstan's Firepit and tell him you're there to deliver Migi's lunch. You can almost certainly find Migi behind Grommash Hold with the rest of his friends.

Duties keep me here during the day and I can't watch over his every meal.
97246.objectivesText: Visit Borstan's Firepit and tell him Thatog wants you to deliver Migi's lunch to him personally.
97246.title: Meal Appeal

97249.description:
Now that I know his parents worry about how much he's actually filling that belly, I've got an idea. 

They made me promise not to pack the same meal every day, so Migi grows a taste for more than one thing. Still, whenever the smoker's full and we're making sweetglazed hog belly sandwiches, he always shows up for lunch. We've started crumbling the leftover crispy glazed bits as a topping--something we can add daily. 

Take this to him. Maybe he'll start showing up early and bringing friends!
97249.objectivesText: Bring Migi's Lunch to him behind Grommash Hold.
97249.title: Favorite Food

97250.description:
Traveler, have you plans to head toward Dustwallow Marsh? I have heard mutterings that a few human soldiers have taken a stand at its border and are toppling the landmarks left behind by our tauren pathfinders.

Rumor has it that a favored tavern has burned to the ground, and in typical Alliance fashion, they immediately cast their blame onto the Horde! I cannot know whether there is any truth to their claim, but their incursion onto OUR land must not stand.

Kill first, investigate later!
97250.objectivesText: Slay Alliance soldiers encroaching into the Barrens at the border to Dustwallow Marsh, then return to Grunt Logmar at Camp Taurajo.
97250.title: Wrongly Blamed, Justly Corrected

97270.description: There must be more to the Maul than this!$B$BPerhaps the loud Spectator who oversees the event at Dire Maul will know!
97270.objectivesText: Speak with Griniblix the Spectator above the Maul in Dire Maul.
97270.title: Brawl at the Maul

97275.description:
Whuut is a prodigy. That much is true. But he doesn't yet have the experience, wisdom, and time on the stirring rod to know how to respect alchemical processes.

He is exhausting all of the rarest and most exotic reagents we have available without pausing to practice and refine his basic skills.

Give him this potion I've brewed with a quick tonic method. He'll reconsider everything he's doing when he learns how local remedies and careful touch are the first true mastery.
97275.title: Whuut's the Rush

97277.description:
Oi, had me back turned gettin' the boar roast ready when I heard me pal Gozwin screamin' fer his life!

Wicked fangs and a blur are all I saw when I turned. Such huge paws! A snow leopard was draggin' its gnomish catch away. I grabbed me shotgun and fired above the beast. It dropped him and sprinted off.

Luckily, it hadn't done more than give ol' Goz some deep scratches.

Head back to camp in the northwestern hills and retrieve Gozwin's Mechanic's Log. Kill that snow leopard too if you see it!
97277.objectivesText: Find Grund and Gozwin's camp in the hills to the northwest. Recover Gozwin's Mechanic's Log and kill the Snow Leopard Prowler.
97277.title: Grund and Gozwin

97279.description:
With an influx of new recruits like yourself, it's been hard to keep our weapons supplied. Our weaponsmith, Kzan, is running low on training weapons and I'd like to see what kinds of skills you possess to get an idea of what I have to work with. Luckily for you, I have a solution to both.

While you're out there cutting your teeth on boars, salvage six abandoned training weapons. Our failed recruits left them laying on the ground. Once you do, return them to our weaponsmith Kzan behind me in the Den.
97279.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Abandoned Training Weapons, then return to Kzan Thornslash in the Den.
97279.title: Wayward Weapons

97281.description:
<Before you is a strange orb with a dull surface. When picked up a small electrical current seems to vibrate from within. Upon closer inspection, it looks as if a dark mist swirls within and every so often a small electrical spark can be seen.

It is clear the harpy was using it for some purpose. Perhaps Rezlak would be interested in this object?>
97281.objectivesText: Bring the Dull Stormy Orb to Rezlak near Drygulch Ravine.
97281.title: A Simmering Storm

97287.description:
You have done well to infiltrate the city of mages, but I believe it is time for us to be more... negotiatory.

As much as it pains me to admit, there is no other place on Azeroth with such a vast knowledge of the arcane. My brilliant work still pales in comparison to the ancient wisdom the Kirin Tor have amassed over the years. I think it's high time we are granted access to this exclusive order, don't you think?

Take the mote you acquired. They will surely give anything to get it back. Anything.
97287.objectivesText: Speak with the Image of Archmage Modera near Dalaran.
97287.title: Shrewd Negotiations

97288.areaDescription: Deliver the Abominable Head to someone within the Undercity.
97288.description:
<As the creature falls, its head comes toppling off. It seems as if it has been reattached several times, and the connection gets weaker with each reconnection.

Someone in the Undercity would know more about this unique abomination.>
97288.objectivesText: Deliver the Abominable Head to Master Apothecary Faranell within the Undercity.
97288.title: Unending Torment

97289.description:
We craft abomination heads all the time, but this one is special. It belonged to a Grand Marshal of the Alliance once. A particularly unpleasant one. Othmar, I believe its name was. The Dark Lady had the pleasure of dispatching this one herself.

Ooh the secrets it could tell if it could talk. And it can! If we reattach it to an appropriate host.

Go ahead and place it next to the available body in the next room. But don't attach it. Not yet.
97289.objectivesText: Bring the Head of the Baron to the body of Othmar in the Undercity.
97289.title: Unending Torment

97290.description:
You... abomination...

Why should... help you...

Be gone...
97290.objectivesText: Report your findings to Master Apothecary Faranell in Undercity.
97290.title: Unending Torment

97291.description:
With the head reattached, all we need now is to bind it to the Dark Lady's will. This should not be a problem. The beast barely has brains left as it is after all the beatings it's taken.

We simply need to motivate it.

Fetch me a Toxic Skullcap from Miss Grisette in the Trade Quarter. Oh, and some Blisterweed from our local herbalist trainers, the Alliestars. Feel free to just take some, they owe me. And lastly a bit of Essence of Agony. Any old poison vendor should do.

We have a potion to make!
97291.objectivesText: Collect a Toxic Skullcap from Tawny Grisette in the Trade Quarter, Blisterweed near the Herbalism Trainer, and Essence of Agony from the poison vendor in the Rogues' Quarter for Master Apothecary Faranell in Undercity.
97291.title: Unending Torment

97292.description:
I have concocted a lovely serum that our new guest is sure to find quite... stimulating.

Take this. Feed it into the workings dripping from above him. Let's see if we can't show him why it's in his best interest to serve loyally.

And try not to drop it. I can't afford a new assistant.
97292.objectivesText: Inject the Hissing Serum into the system above Othmar's body for Master Apothecary Faranell.
97292.title: Unending Torment

97326.description:
Hey! You've got time to help us out! I know you do, I can tell by the way you smiled watching the game we're playing.

This spot behind Grommash Hold is nice because it's clear enough for us to set up our figures. But what stinks is we don't have enough rocks for chairs or tables.

You're big and strong... d'ya think you could carry back some medium-sized rocks, smooth enough to sit on if we need a rest?
97326.objectivesText: Return $1oa Smooth Boulders to Thra behind Grommash Hold.
97326.title: Rocks to Rests

97327.description:
It breaks my heart to admit, but my brothers and sisters inside Blackmaw Hold are irreparably corrupted.

If you bring me some of their personal belongings, I can at least give their families something to remember them by. Every bundle you recover will serve as a symbol of your service to my people.
97327.objectivesText: Enter Blackmaw Hold and recover $1oa Blackmaw Pouches for Ekkal at the Ruins of Eldarath in Azshara.
97327.title: Blackmaw Pouches

97328.description:
<As you sift through the debris left behind by a horrible zeppelin crash directly above, you find evidence of a hefty shipment of supplies that has long since been plundered of all its value. Even the shipping labels have been torn and shredded, leaving only the words 'Booty Bay' barely legible on one.

Countless two-toed footprints and several patches of divotted earth all lead toward ruins in the northwest.>
97328.objectivesText: Recover $1oa Stolen Shipments from the Ruins of Zul'Kunda in Stranglethorn Vale and return your haul to someone in Booty Bay.
97328.title: Anything of Value

97378.description:
$n, you have proven you are a strong and dutiful hunter and I am impressed by your bravery. It is only because of this I offer you this hunt.

A wind serpent hunts along a road off the coast of Feralas and has been ambushing travelers, and leaving their corpses strewn about the road. It is clear she does not hunt out of necessity. This is a creature that no longer shares the Earthmother's blessing.

The windserpent Mirrorscale makes her lair at the bottom of the waterfall along the coast of Feralas.
97378.objectivesText: Bring Mirrorscale's Wing to Melor Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff.
97378.title: Mirrorscale

97386.description:
$n! Your arrival is timely, as always.

You have provided valuable assistance to the defense of Grom'gol, and we are grateful. After your recent push against the ogres nearby, we sent out a scout to see if there are more out there that may try to enact vengeance against us. As it turns out, there is a cave far to the east that they have claimed as their hovel.

Gather a friend or two and make it very clear that we will not tolerate another threat to our settlement, now or ever!
97386.objectivesText: Commander Aggro'gosh of the Grom'gol base camp wants you to kill ogres at the Mosh'Ogg Ogre Mount.
97386.title: The Offense of Grom'gol

97404.description:
There are two old matriarchs, long aged past their cub rearing cycles. Perhaps they are sisters. They could also be two kindred bears who've shared a similar passing of seasons.

Regardless of what has brought them together, they still have a ferocity and will to live that demands respect. Attempting to set up a camp like this one has been difficult for us, with these two grizzled Shardtooths.

Bring back the heads of Kuroma and Kamuro, and try to end them swiftly, skillfully, and with mercy.
97404.objectivesText: Kill the old shardtooth matriarchs, Kuroma and Kamuro, and return their heads to Sarna Brownhorn.
97404.title: Too Bad to Bear

97413.description: Valthalak's soul was stored in this amulet. In our greed we foolishly split it into three parts, not knowing the curse that would await us.$B$BThe only way to stop Valthalak's spell is to put the amulet back together. Return to Mokvar and tell him that Bodley is his only hope for finding the remaining pieces.  Speak to him about any rewards you've arranged for.$B$BI, for once, shall rest in peace. I wish you the best of luck; you shall need every bit of it!
97413.objectivesText: Return to Mokvar in Orgrimmar with a set of Lightforge Boots, Lightforge Legplates and Lightforge Spaulders.
97413.title: Anthion's Parting Words

97420.description:
I have a favor to ask of someone, and you look helpful!

You see this baby here? Ain't she a beaut? This is my newest racer, designed and built all by myself, because SOMEONE wouldn't help. I plan on taking this to the races in Thousand Needles, but it needs a little extra kick.

Now, I'm too handsome to be a goblin, and I know better than to trust their tech, but I know the Venture Co struck liquid gold over at the lake. I'm sure they won't mind if you, erm, borrowed some? They won't even notice!
97420.objectivesText: Acquire $1oa Drums of Crude Oil from the Venture Co. operations at Lake Nazferiti, then return to Knaz Blunderflame in Stranglethorn Vale.
97420.title: Reduce, Reuse, Reconcile

97446.description:
Ah, I've been expecting you $c. It would seem the winds have brought you to me this day. You have come seeking a kodo, correct?

The kodo is a noble beast that is slow to anger, and you would be hard pressed to find a more dependable companion.

Today you have an important choice to make. You and your kodo will travel the world together, so find which one speaks to you. Fear not, whatever choice you make will be the right one.

Go examine the kodos and return to me when you have made your choice.
97446.objectivesText: Inspect the riding kodos to choose your first mount.
97446.title: Your First Riding Kodo

97447.description: Well met, $c. I've something that might interest you.$B$BI have in my possession a set of armor much like the one worn by those of your profession, but of much higher quality. I'd be willing to trade the bracers for ordinary ones in exchange for a small favor.$B$BThe blood of the frostsabers and bears that inhabit Winterspring has properties I'm in need of at the moment. Bring me a sizeable sample of it along with the bracers and a small amount of gold. You shall find the effort worth your while.
97447.objectivesText: Acquire 15 Winterspring Blood Samples and 20 gold and bring them along with a set of Bindings of the Elements to Deliana in Ironforge.
97447.title: An Earnest Proposition

97448.description: You kept your word and brought the device built by Mux. I believe a reward is in order if I'm to keep you interested in saving my skin. Bring me the belt and set of gauntlets that you wish to upgrade. I promise the ones I give you in return will be far superior.
97448.objectivesText: Bring a Cord of the Elements and a set of Gauntlets of the Elements to Deliana in Ironforge.
97448.title: Just Compensation

97449.description: Valthalak's soul was stored in this amulet. In our greed we foolishly split it into three parts, not knowing the curse that would await us.$B$BThe only way to stop Valthalak's spell is to put the medallion back together. Return to Deliana and tell her that Bodley is her only hope for finding the remaining pieces. Speak to her about any rewards you've arranged for.$B$BI, for once, shall rest in peace. I wish you the best of luck; you shall need every bit of it!
97449.objectivesText: Return to Deliana in Ironforge with a set of Boots of Elements, Kilt of Elements and Pauldrons of Elements.
97449.title: Anthion's Parting Words

conditionalDescriptions.text:
Blessings of An'she, child.

We have a tradition of scattering incense to the winds, and I was wondering if you'd be interested in honoring our tradition.

You will need to craft the incense by purchasing herbs from Nida, cedar from Nata, sinew thread from Mahu in the mid rise, and ceremonial flint and tinder from Naal on the upper rise. Once you have these items, combine them and spread them off the south facing cliff of Hunter's Rise.

You will find a mat and incense at the ceremonial site.

97485.description:
Blessings of An'she, friend.

We tauren have a tradition of scattering incense to the winds and I was hoping you'd be interested in honoring this tradition.

You will need to craft the incense by purchasing herbs from Nida, cedar from Nata, sinew thread from Mahu in the mid rise, and ceremonial flint and tinder from Naal on the upper rise. Once you have these items, combine them and spread them off the south facing cliff of Hunter's Rise.

You will find a mat and incense at the ceremonial site.
97485.objectivesText:
Purchase a Bundle of Herbs from Nida the herbalist, a Bundle of Cedar Twigs from Nata the enchanting supplier, and Sinew Thread from Mahu the leatherworking supplier and Ceremonial Flint and Tinder from Naal the cooking supplier.

Combine the items and sprinkle the incense off of Hunter's Rise.
97485.title: Traditions of the Bluff

97530.description:
A merchant caravan took a wrong turn through the desert and got jumped by the Dunemaul ogres. Only reason they made it out alive is 'cause they tossed some cargo overboard to distract the brutes.

Must be this merchant's got friends with the nobs runnin' ships and zeppelins, 'cause now they want ME pickin' up what got lost.

I'm stuck here working. But if YOU see a nice shiny bangle while you're beatin' on ogres, I'll make it worth ya while.
97530.objectivesText: Security Chief Bilgewhizzle of Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris wants you to recover a particularly shiny bangle bracelet lost near the Dunemaul ogre compound.
97530.title: Dunemaul Dues

97534.description:
Pssst, wanna know somethin'? It's easier to make profit in a place like this than you think... it's all about knowing how to market! I've seen what these tech-heads do when they get their hands on something they think they can turn into a fuel cell.

Even better if it's still glowin' or sputtering steam.

Why don't we strike a deal? Bring back some of the parts that fall off their machines in the desert, and I'll kick you back a share of the coin I get from selling the salvage back to the junkers!
97534.objectivesText: Quinn wants you to recover $1oa  pieces of Desert Debris and return to her in Gadgetzan.
97534.title: Gritty Business

97539.description:
This encampment is being left to rot. The siege damage stands, unrepaired, as if neglect were policy. I won't permit that same decay here. The infirmary answers to me, and I intend to keep it functional.

We are nearly out of supplies. I'm going to need more equipment--enough to keep the workers and guards on their feet.

Under pressure, we can make quite an effective field suture using twisted spider silk.

$C, bring me some from the spiders that stalk these highlands.
97539.objectivesText: Return 12 Surgical Spidersilk to Doctor Gregory Victor in Hammerfall, Arathi Highlands.
97539.title: Silky Sutures

97558.description:
One part of undeath no one mentions is what happens when we are injured. How does the skin of an undead heal itself?

Well, it doesn't.

Ours is a cursed life, $n. We must take from the living to further our own existence.

When we sustain an injury, we must replace our skin which usually means animal hides. Since different hide thicknesses are better for different places on our bodies a variety is key!

Bring me wing membranes of a duskbat, hides from a darkhound and skin of a Vile Fin murloc.
97558.objectivesText: Bring Shelene Rhobart $1oa Duskbat Wing Membranes, $2oa Darkhound Hides and $3oa Vile Fin Murloc Skin.
97558.title: Hides for the Forsaken

conditionalDescriptions.text:
You look like a well-preserved Forsaken, all things considered. I am looking for someone to travel to Sunnyglade, in the Riverglades just north of the Redridge Mountains.

My family owned an armory there, once. Now I imagine it is a burnt husk, but I would have you retrieve a tome containing my family's ancestral armor crafting techniques. It was originally in the basement, so hopefully it has not succumbed to the elements just yet.

97884.description:
You look like a healthy, able-bodied $r. I am looking for someone to travel to Sunnyglade, in the Riverglades just north of the Redridge Mountains.

My family owned an armory there, once. Now I imagine it is a burnt husk, but I would have you retrieve a tome containing my family's ancestral armor crafting techniques. It was originally in the basement, so hopefully it has not succumbed to the elements just yet.
97884.objectivesText: Travel to Sunnyglade in the Riverglades and recover the tome of Tremayne Family Blacksmithing Techniques.
97884.title: Armory of Sunnyglade

97891.description:
You! Quickly, I need you to bring this potion across the slime canal to Doctor Martin Felben in the Apothecarium!

It has a very limited shelf life, and no I can't go myself, my knees rattle and pop out if I attempt to run.

Just another lovely side effect of undeath, apparently.

But we're wasting time! Here, take this and go!

<Alessandro makes a shooing motion.>
97891.objectivesText: Bring the Unstable Potion to Doctor Martin Felben in the Apothecarium within the time limit.
97891.title: Prompt Potion Runner

97901.description:
Enchanters make everything better and are always welcome at any camp out in the wilds.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Enchanted Lute for your camp. It's so important to find entertainment during your downtime, and this bit of magic can help ensure you are ready to weather all sorts of challenges when you hit the old dusty trail once again.
97901.objectivesText: Speak with Jhag in Orgrimmar to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97901.title: Camping 101: Enchanting

97902.description:
Engineers like yourself can cook up all sorts of bits, bots, and bombs for fun and profit.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Reagent Bot for your camp. This helpful automaton can help keep you well-supplied so that you and your allies never run out of the materials needed to fuel your spells.
97902.objectivesText: Speak with Mukdrak in Razor Hill to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97902.title: Camping 101: Engineering

97903.description:
So you've taken up First Aid? That's an honorable... and pragmatic pursuit as a $c.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a First Aid Kit for your camp. Injuries are a reality in the world of adventuring and offering some much-needed healing at your camp could even save lives.

objectives.text: Raise your first aid skill to 20

97903.objectivesText: Speak with Rawrk in Razor Hill to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97903.title: Camping 101: First Aid

97905.description:
Looks to me like you've gained some skill in herbalism. Picking flowers isn't just for dilly-dallying, you know. It can be useful... and profitable.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Incense Candle for your camp. High spirits are a key component to keeping healers and spellcasters in the fight, and an Incense Candle can provide a boost that magic users will surely appreciate.
97905.objectivesText: Speak with Jandi in Orgrimmar to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97905.title: Camping 101: Herbalism

97906.description:
You've become a leatherworker. Good for you, $c. I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to make yourself a tent that will keep you cool on hot days, and dry on rainy days.

With a good tent over your head, you'll ensure that you get all the rest you need to stay sharp on your travels.
97906.objectivesText: Speak with Karolek in Orgrimmar to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97906.title: Camping 101: Leatherworking

97907.description:
Mining isn't the most glamorous, but it's good honest work and a fine profession for you to explore.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Lodestone for your camp. Build one of these and everyone who wants to swing a sword will be eager to gather round your fire and soak up the extra "oomph" it can provide to increase their combat prowess.
97907.objectivesText: Speak with Krunn in Razor Hill to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97907.title: Camping 101: Mining

97914.description:
Auberdine is a humble place, $c. You won't hear its name spoken in the boughs of Darnassus. Most reference only what the Sundering took from us--the thriving cities of Ameth'Aran, Bashal'Aran, and... Lathar'Lazal.

Yet Auberdine remains in their shadow.

I would see our work here recognized. A new vessel connects us to the kingdom of Stormwind, bringing life and supplies to our shores. I beseech you to join its next voyage, and bring this letter to a human called Baros Alexston.

Make our home known.
97914.objectivesText:
Bring Thundris' Letter to Baros Alexston in Stormwind.

Thundris mentioned a boat in Auberdine that can take you there.
97914.title: Expanding Horizons

97915.description:
So, you chose to cook up brews and potions as an Alchemist. I'm sure that'll come in handy in your travels.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Mana Well for your camp. Build one of these and all of the healers and spellcaster types will come running to get a refreshing taste.
97915.objectivesText: Speak with Alchemist Mallory in Elwynn Forest near Stormwind to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97915.title: Camping 101: Alchemy

97922.title: Camping 101: Leatherworking

97926.description:
I wish it was that easy to help, $c. I really do.

Should you choose to spend more time in our lands, you will find that many are without. Stormwind's coffers are not what they once were, and what remains is spread thin.

Give this reply to the elder the next time you see him. It's not what he's hoping for, but it's all I have to offer right now.
97926.objectivesText: Bring Alexston's Reply to Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine in Darkshore.
97926.title: Making Do

97930.description:
Engineers like yourself can cook up all sorts of bits, bots, and bombs for fun and profit.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Reagent Bot for your camp. This helpful automaton can help keep you well-supplied so that you and your allies never run out of the materials needed to fuel your spells.
97930.objectivesText: Speak with Twizwick Sprocketgrind in the Venture Co. Mine in Mulgore to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97930.title: Camping 101: Engineering

97931.objectivesText: Speak with Vira Younghoof in Bloodhoof Village to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97931.title: Camping 101: First Aid

97932.description:
You might not think so, but your skill as a fisherman can actually come in handy at camp.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Fish Bowl for your camp. You can use this fixture to help provide a bit of joy to yourself and your fellow adventurers. A happy adventurer is a strong adventurer and I'm sure your combat capabilities will reflect that.
97932.objectivesText: Speak with Uthan Stillwater in Bloodhoof Village to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97932.title: Camping 101: Fishing

97934.objectivesText: Speak with Chaw Stronghide in Bloodhoof Village to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97934.title: Camping 101: Leatherworking

97938.objectivesText: Speak with Cyndra Kindwhisper in Dolanaar to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97938.title: Camping 101: Alchemy

97939.description:
So, you've become a Blacksmith. That's a great choice if you want to make sure your blades never dull.

I reckon I know someone that can help with that by teaching you how to craft a Sharpening Wheel. Bring one of these out at your camp and all the warriors and rogues in the area will be lining up to hone their weapons.
97939.objectivesText: Speak with Elisa Steelhand in Auberdine in Darkshore to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97939.title: Camping 101: Blacksmithing

97940.description:
Enchanters make everything better and are always welcome at any camp out in the wilds.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Enchanted Lute for your camp. It's so important to find entertainment during your downtime, and this bit of magic can help ensure you are ready to weather all sorts of challenges when you hit the old dusty trail once again.
97940.objectivesText: Speak with Alanna Raveneye in the Oracle Glade in Teldrassil to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97940.title: Camping 101: Enchanting

97942.description:
So you've taken up First Aid? That's an honorable... and pragmatic pursuit as a $c.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a First Aid Kit for your camp. Injuries are a reality in the world of adventuring and offering some much-needed healing at your camp could even save lives.

objectives.text: Raise your first aid skill to 20

97942.objectivesText: Speak with Byancie in Dolanaar to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97942.title: Camping 101: First Aid

97944.description:
Looks to me like you've gained some skill in herbalism. Picking flowers isn't just for dilly-dallying, you know. It can be useful... and profitable.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Incense Candle for your camp. High spirits are a key component to keeping healers and spellcasters in the fight, and an Incense Candle can provide a boost that magic users will surely appreciate.
97944.objectivesText: Speak with Malorne Bladeleaf in Dolanaar to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97944.title: Camping 101: Herbalism

97946.description:
You've become a leatherworker. Good for you, $c. I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to make yourself a tent that will keep you cool on hot days, and dry on rainy days.

With a good tent over your head, you'll ensure that you get all the rest you need to stay sharp on your travels.
97946.objectivesText: Speak with Nadyia Maneweaver on the road to Darnassus from Dolanaar to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97946.title: Camping 101: Leatherworking

97949.description:
Being able to skillfully harvest the skins and hides of fallen beasts is one of the more valuable skills an adventurer can possess.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Camp Chair for your camp. Sometimes it's important to just take a load off, and you can use some of those hides you've gathered to make a comfy chair to sit in. A bit of relaxation can help ensure that you are at your peak condition and can strike where it counts the next time you find yourself in a dust-up.
97949.objectivesText: Speak with Radnaal Maneweaver on the road to Darnassus from Dolanaar to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97949.title: Camping 101: Skinning

97950.description:
Tailoring is a surprisingly potent tradeskill to invest in, and I'm sure it'll serve you well.

I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Faction Banner for your camp, provided you have the skill for it. Inspiration and morale are a key part of success on any battlefield, and an inspirational banner can go a long way to keeping you energized.
97950.objectivesText: Speak with Trianna in Darnassus to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97950.title: Camping 101: Tailoring

97954.description:
Engineers like yourself can cook up all sorts of bits, bots, and bombs for fun and profit.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Reagent Bot for your camp. This helpful automaton can help keep you well-supplied so that you and your allies never run out of the materials needed to fuel your spells.
97954.objectivesText: Speak with Graham Van Talen in Undercity to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97954.title: Camping 101: Engineering

97959.description:
Mining isn't the most glamorous, but it's good honest work and a fine profession for you to explore.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Lodestone for your camp. Build one of these and everyone who wants to swing a sword will be eager to gather round your fire and soak up the extra "oomph" it can provide to increase their combat prowess.
97959.objectivesText: Speak with Brom Killian in Undercity to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97959.title: Camping 101: Mining
